Abilities.Ability_BloodSplatter_Descript:
Blood Splatter is a physical spell dealing damage to other enemies around the target, but not the original target. 

Added damage applies at 50% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_BoneNova_Description: Bones fly out in all directions, impaling enemies.
Abilities.Ability_BoneNova_AltText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SummonBloodWraith_Desc: Summons a Blood Wraith that rapidly fades from this world, but will seek and attack your foes while it remains.
Abilities.Ability_SummonBloodWraith_AltT: You are limited to 13 active Blood Wraiths. This is separate from your limit for the Summon Wraith skill.
Abilities.Ability_MarrowShards_Descripti: Fires sharpened bones from your body. The bones pierce through enemies inflicting physical damage. Instead of mana, this spell costs 9% of your current health.
Abilities.Ability_MarrowShards_AltText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SummonRevenant_Descrip: Summons a revenant that rapidly fades from this world, but will seek and attack your foes while it remains.
Abilities.Ability_SummonWraith_Descripti: Summons a wraith that rapidly fades from this world, but will seek and attack your foes while it remains.
Abilities.Ability_SummonWraith_AltText:
You are limited to 6 active wraiths.

Wraiths have 60 base health.
Abilities.Ability_WanderingSpirits_Descr:
Reveals wandering spirits around you for 6 seconds. The spirits wander at random dealing necrotic damage over time to enemies they pass through.

4 spirits are revealed immediately after casting the skill and 17 more are revealed over the next 6 seconds.

The spirits individually last up to 4 seconds, but all remaining spirits fade once the reveal duration ends.
Abilities.Ability_WanderingSpirits_AltTe:
Added spell damage applies to each spirit''s damage at 200% effectiveness per second.

Increased Area stats affect the area of effect of each individual spirit, but not the area in which spirits are revealed.
Abilities.Ability_FlameReave_Description: A melee attack that releases a wave of flames from your weapon, cleaving through enemies in a cone in front of you. Deals less damage as it expands, up to 50% less at maximum distance.
Abilities.Ability_SummonBoneGolem_Descri: Summons a bone golem, which attacks slowly, but has a 15% chance to retaliate with Bone Shatter when hit.
Abilities.Ability_BoneShatter_Descriptio: Bones fly out in all directions, impaling enemies.
Abilities.Ability_BoneShatter_AltText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_BlackHoleEnd_Descripti: A wave of cold energy that erupts from Black Hole. Has a freeze rate of 240.
Abilities.Ability_BlackHoleEnd_AltText: Added spell damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Bone Golem 10 Freezing: Creates a nova around the caster that deals cold damage and has a freeze rate of 200.
Abilities.Ability_Bone Golem 09 Blood Or:
Launches an orb of blood that hits up to 3 nearby enemies 6 times over 2 seconds.

Added spell damage applies at 300% effectiveness to each hit.
Abilities.Ability_Fire Lich Boss 01 Fire: Cast a ball of fire towards the target. Added spell damage applies at 125% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Fire Lich Boss 02 Necr: Freezes enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_FireAura_Description: Deals fire damage in an area around you. Each stack lasts for 4 seconds. Can be converted to cold or lightning.
Abilities.Ability_FireAura_AltText: Added spell damage is applied at 140% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_SnapFreeze_Description:
Freezes enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you freeze an enemy, including with Snap Freeze itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.
Abilities.Ability_ShatterStrike_Descript:
A sweeping melee attack of 2 arcs that strikes enemies in a circle around you dealing cold damage and instantly kills frozen enemies below 10% health.

Enemies in the middle of the attack are hit twice, where the arcs overlap.
Abilities.Ability_ShatterStrike_AltText:
Has a freeze rate of 50.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SummonSabertooth_Descr:
Summons a primal sabertooth cat that leaps into combat. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The sabertooth cat counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
Abilities.Ability_SummonSabertooth_AltTe: The sabertooth has 240 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.
Abilities.Ability_Sabertooth Ability_Des:
The companion ability of your Primal Sabertooth.

Releases three swipes in rapid succession
Abilities.Ability_Sabertooth Ability_Alt: Scales with your sabertooth''s stats rather than yours
Abilities.Ability_ArcaneLightning_Descri: Hurl a bolt of lightning at the target.
Abilities.Ability_ArcaneLightning_AltTex: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Retribution_Descriptio: A melee physical attack that hits nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_Retribution_AltText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_AxeThrow_Description: Throws an axe at a nearby enemy.
Abilities.Ability_AxeThrow_AltText:
This is a throwing attack that scales with throwing attack damage and throwing attack speed. It is not a melee attack or spell.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Ring Of Shields_Descri:
Manifests a ring of shields around you.

Each shield has 75 base health and lasts up to 10 seconds. Shields draw enemy aggression and block projectiles.

Stats on your equipped shield also apply to the shields created by Ring of Shields
Abilities.Ability_Rebuke_Description:
Hold ability key to channel for up to 2 seconds. You take 80% less damage while channelling.

When you stop channelling the barrier breaks dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies. This deals 20 additional physical damage for each hit you received while channelling.
Abilities.Ability_Rebuke_AltText:
You cannot be stunned while channelling.

Added spell damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SmeltersWrath_Descript:
Channel to charge a powerful frontal cone attack, dealing fire and physical damage to all enemies hit. Charging for longer increases its range and power. 2 second maximum charge time.

Your armor is doubled while channelling Smelter''s Wrath.
Abilities.Ability_SmeltersWrath_AltText:
Deals up to 100% more damage at maximum charge.

Added damage is applied at 600% effectiveness.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats increase Smelter''s Wrath''s charge speed instead of its area.
Abilities.Ability_Focus_Description: Hold ability key to channel. While channelling you have 100% increased mana regen and gain 10 ward per second. After channelling for exactly one second you recover 10% of missing mana and gain a burst of 40 mana and ward.
Abilities.Ability_Teleport_AltText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills'' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.
Abilities.Ability_TeleportReturn_AltText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills'' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.
Abilities.Ability_Surge_Description: Quick fixed distance dash which hits all enemies in the path with a lightning melee attack.
Abilities.Ability_Surge_AltText:
Added melee damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills'' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.
Abilities.Ability_SummonBonePrison_Descr:
Summons a bone prison around a target area.

The '{'Bone Prison'}' is considered a minion and is made up of several small sections, each with 300 base health.
Abilities.Ability_SummonMirrorImage_Desc: Summon a mirror image to distract your foes.
Abilities.Ability_Harvest_Description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you, dealing double damage to those that are Cursed.
Abilities.Ability_Harvest_AltText: Unaffected by weapon range. Added damage applies at 70% effectiveness. Common curses include Marked for Death, Bone Curse and Spirit Plague.
Abilities.Ability_SigilsOfHope_Descripti:
Every 2 seconds, summons a symbol that orbits you, causing you and your allies'' attacks and spells to deal 3 additional fire damage and increasing health regeneration by 20%.

Activate to consume the symbols, granting 100 ward and 5% less damage taken per symbol for 3 seconds.

You can have up to 3 symbols at a time.
Abilities.Ability_HolyAura_Description: You and nearby allies passively gain 30% increased damage and +15% additional elemental resistance. Activating Holy Aura doubles the stat bonuses for 4 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_Eterras Blessing_Descr: The nearest allied target is healed for 100 health. If the target is one of your minions then the healing is tripled and the minion is energised for 4 seconds, increasing its size by 20% and its damage by 100%.
Abilities.Ability_SummonStormTotem_Descr:
Summons a totem that casts lightning storms around nearby enemies.

Storm totems last 8 seconds, and you cannot control more than 1 at once.
Abilities.Ability_Judgement_Description:
A powerful melee attack that leaves an area of '{'Consecrated Ground'}' for 4 seconds.

Allies on the '{'Consecrated Ground'}' are healed for 50 health each second.

Enemies on Consecrate Ground take fire damage over time that scales with spell damage. Consecrate Ground gains 1 spell damage per 5% increased healing effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Judgement_AltText:
Added melee damage applies to the attack at 350% effectiveness.

Added spell damage applies to Consecrated Ground at 375% effectiveness per second.

The melee attack''s damage does not scale with spell damage and Consecrated Ground''s damage does not scale with melee damage.
Abilities.Ability_ConsecratedGround_Desc:
Allies on the consecrated ground are healed for 50 health each second.

Enemies on Consecrate Ground take fire damage over time that scales with spell damage. Consecrate Ground gains 1 Spell Damage per 5% increased healing effectiveness.

Added spell damage applies at 375% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_EnchantWeapon_Descript:
Active: Enchant your weapon with elemental power. Your melee attacks deal 50% more elemental damage for 5 seconds.

Passive: Your melee attacks deal 15% more elemental damage.
Abilities.Ability_LightningWave_Descript: Release a wave of lightning in an area around you.
Abilities.Ability_LightningWave_AltText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Blizzard_Description: Repeatedly strikes around a target area with hail, wind and frozen objects.
Abilities.Ability_Blizzard_AltText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_WerebearRoar_Descripti:
Unleash a thunderous roar which knocks enemies back and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Rares and bosses are stunned for half as long.. All effects from your Warcry Skill Tree are applied to Roar.

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you stun (or freeze if Warcry is converted to cold) an enemy, including with Roar itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.
Abilities.Ability_WerebearSwipe1_Descrip: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range. Your Swipe Skill Tree applies to this ability.
Abilities.Ability_WerebearSwipe2_Descrip: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range.
Abilities.Ability_WerebearCharge_Descrip: Charge towards a target location dealing damage and knocking back enemies in your path.
Abilities.Ability_WerebearCharge_AltText: Rampage''s cooldown does not recover while you are using it.
Abilities.Ability_Avalanche_Description: Summon the might of winter and pummel your foes in ice and snow, unleashing a large boulder at the target followed by 10 smaller boulders around the area over 2 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_Avalanche_AltText:
Added damage is applied at 400% effectiveness. Each hit has a freeze rate of 80.
The large boulder deals 100% more damage and has 100% more area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Increased Area for Area Skills stats apply to the area of the individual boulders, but not to the area in which they fall.
Abilities.Ability_AvalancheSnowballAoE_D: Launches an icy boulder from the sky.
Abilities.Ability_AvalancheSnowballAoE_A: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_HolySymbol_Description: A triggered self heal that also grants ward every second over 3 seconds. It has a 3 second cooldown.
Abilities.Ability_DivineBolt_Description: Cast a bolt of divine fire towards the target.
Abilities.Ability_DivineBolt_AltText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_ShadowCascade_Descript:
Requires dual wielding.

A circular attack that''s also used by your shadows.
Abilities.Ability_ShadowCascade_AltText: Added damages is applied at 250% effectiveness. Base critical strike chance is 10%, instead of the normal 5%.
Abilities.Ability_WerebearForm_Descripti:
Transform into a ferocious werebear, increasing your physical capabilities and gaining 4 new abilities. 

Your mana is replaced with Rage while in werebear form. When your Rage reaches 0 you automatically transform back into your human form. Your starting Rage is equal to your maximum mana. Rage slowly decays over time at a constant rate.
Abilities.Ability_WerebearForm_AltText:
The four new abilities are: Rampage, Swipe, Maul and Roar. Swipe and Roar inherit all bonuses from your Swipe and Warcry skill trees.

While in bear form you have 50% increased melee damage and 15% increased health.

When returning to human form, your mana will return to the amount you had before shapeshifting, but you will have gained the mana you regenerated while shapeshifted. Other forms of mana recovery do not apply.
Abilities.Ability_WerebearToHumanForm_De: Return back to human form, returning your original stats and abilities.
Abilities.Ability_Werebear Maul Starter_: Jump forward a short distance and slam into the ground dealing damage to nearby enemies.
Added melee damage applies at 250% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Warcry_Description:
Unleash a mighty roar that knocks back nearby enemies and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Rares and bosses are stunned for half as long.

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you stun (or freeze if Warcry is converted to cold) an enemy, including with Warcry itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.
Abilities.Ability_ForgeStrike_Descriptio:
A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you.

25% chance on hit to summon a Forged Weapon which lasts for 20 seconds and is affected by the stats and attack rate of your weapon. You can control up to 6 Forged Weapons at once.
Abilities.Ability_ForgeStrike_AltText: Added melee damage applies at 600% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SummonWeapon_Descripti:
Summons a Forged Weapon which lasts for 20 seconds and is affected by the stats and attack rate of your weapon. You can control up to 6 Forged Weapons at once.

Forged Weapons have 220 based health.
Abilities.Ability_SummonWeapon_AltText: Press A to give your minions an attack command.
Abilities.Ability_ManifestArmor_Descript:
Manifests an animated set of heavy armor, which attacks slowly.

Stats granted by your body armor, helmet, gloves and boots also apply to your Manifest Armor.
Abilities.Ability_ManifestArmor_AltText:
Manifested Armors have 400 base health.

Manifest Armor has a 30% chance to retaliate with '{'Forge Nova'}' when hit. This effect deals 40 spell fire damage with added damage applying at 200% effectiveness, applies fire resistance shred to enemies hit and has a 2 second cooldown.
Abilities.Ability_SprigganForm_Descripti:
Transform into a forest spriggan, increasing your spell casting capabilities, and gaining 4 new abilities.

Your mana is replaced with Rage while in spriggan form. When your Rage reaches 0 you automatically transform back into your human form. Your starting Rage is equal to your maximum mana. Rage slowly decays over time at a constant rate.
Abilities.Ability_SprigganForm_AltText:
The four new abilities are: Spirit Thorns, Thorn Shield, Summon Vine and Summon Healing Totem.

While in spriggan form you have 50% increased spell damage and +300 armor.

When returning to human form, your mana will return to the amount you had before shapeshifting, but you will have gained the mana you regenerated while shapeshifted. Other forms of mana recovery do not apply.
Abilities.Ability_SprigganSummonVines_De:
Summons 3 poisonous vines around the target location.

Vines are melee minions that inflict poison on hit. You can have up to 12 vines.
Abilities.Ability_SummonSprigganHealingT: Summons a totem that heals nearby allies. Healing totems have 100 base health and last 6 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_Flurry_Description: A bow or melee attack that performs 3 rapid strikes. The last strike can be cancelled by moving.
Abilities.Ability_Flurry_AltText:
Added damage applies at 80% effectiveness to each strike and each strike has a 40% reduced chance to apply ailments on hit.

Increased Area for Area skills stats only affect the melee version of Flurry.
Abilities.Ability_Reap_Description: Dash a short distance in the target direction using your scythes to strike all enemies in your path. Restores 15 health for each enemy hit.
Abilities.Ability_Reap_AltText:
Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills'' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.
Abilities.Ability_Transplant_Description:
Creates a new body for you at the target location, then detonates your old body to deal physical damage to enemies around it.

Instead of mana, this spell costs 13% of your current health.
Abilities.Ability_Transplant_AltText:
Added damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills'' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.
Abilities.Ability_SummonMage_Description:
Summons a Skeletal Mage to assist you. You are limited to 2 Skeletal Mages at a time.
Skeletal Mages cast Dread Bolt, which has 150% added damage effectiveness and has a 50% chance to apply Damned on hit.
Abilities.Ability_SummonMage_AltText:
Skeletal Mages have 100 base health.

You will always summon the Skeletal Mage type you have the fewest of.
Abilities.Ability_ReaperForm_Description:
Take on the mantle of death itself and transform into a Reaper, temporarily gaining the Reap ability. 

While in Reaper Form, your health regen does not apply and your health decays over time. When your health reaches 0 instead of dying you transform back to human form and are healed to full health.
Abilities.Ability_ReaperForm_AltText:
Reap is a short ranged dash. It deals melee damage to enemies you pass through and heals you for each enemy hit. This healing scales with your increased healing effectiveness.

The rate at which your health decays in reaper form is not based on your current or maximum health.

The health decay accelerates while you remain in reaper form.

If you take more damage than your remaining health in Reaper Form, the excess damage will be dealt to your human form health.
Abilities.Ability_SoulEruption_Descripti: Creates 5 souls that target enemies and apply Marked for Death. Also applies Marked for Death to you.
Abilities.Ability_SummonScorpion_Descrip:
Summons a scorpion that follows you into combat. Its attacks with its tails inflict a long lasting poison. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The scorpion counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
Abilities.Ability_SummonScorpion_AltText: The scorpion has 400 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.
Abilities.Ability_ScorpionAbility_Descri:
The companion ability of your Primal Scorpion.

Releases a burst of venom that inflicts all enemies around the scorpion with 3 stacks of poison, and releases a spiral of projectiles that also inflict poison on hit.
Abilities.Ability_ScorpionAbility_AltTex: Scales with your scorpion''s stats rather than yours.
Abilities.Ability_IceBarrage_Description: Opens a rift that repeatedly shoots a barrage of ice shards in a target direction for 5 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_IceBarrage_AltText:
Ice Shards are cold projectiles that will curve to nearby targets.

The shards have a freeze rate of 40.

Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_FireExplosion_Descript: An explosion that deals fire damage in an area.
Abilities.Ability_EnergyWave_Description: Release a small wave of spell physical energy that has a set distance and travels through enemies.
Abilities.Ability_EnergyWave_AltText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_BloodPool_Description: Leave a pool for blood for 3 seconds that slows enemies.
Abilities.Ability_AuraOfDecay_Descriptio:
Toggles Aura of Decay, which poisons you every second, and leaves a trail of decay. Enemies near you or in the trail are poisoned four times a second, and your chance to poison on hit applies to each of these instances at 100% effectiveness.

While Aura of Decay is active you take 30% less poison damage. Additionally, you take 50% less damage from your own Aura of Decay.
Abilities.Ability_AuraOfDecay_AltText: Your chance to poison on hit does not increase the rate at which poison is applied to you.
Abilities.Ability_PutridBomb_Description:
Create a globule of poison that bursts after 1 second.

Your poison chance applies at 250% of its normal value to hits from this ability.
Abilities.Ability_Warlock 03 SoulFeast_D:
Feasts on the souls of '{'Cursed'}' enemies, dealing necrotic damage to them, and drawing fragments of their souls back to you. The soul fragments each grant 3 ward when they reach you.

Feasts on up to 13 enemies, prioritising those closest to you.
Abilities.Ability_Warlock 03 SoulFeast_A: Added spell damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Shurikens_AltText:
Added damage applies at 125% effectiveness.
Your shadows can imitate this ability when you directly use it.
Abilities.Ability_SummonRockElemental_De: Summon a coldstone elemental with decaying health to attack your enemies.
Abilities.Ability_ShieldThrow_Descriptio:
Throws a shield at a target enemy. The shield ricochets to up to 2 additional targets before returning to you.

You cannot throw a new shield until the current shield has returned to you.
Abilities.Ability_ShieldThrow_AltText:
The shield hits all enemies in its path, even those it does not ricochet from.

Added throwing attack damage is applied at 225% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_LavaBurst_Description: Cast a burst of molten lava, hitting the target and nearby enemies dealing spell fire damage.
Abilities.Ability_LavaBurst_AltText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_TempestStrike_Descript:
A melee combo attack that cycles through a cold strike, a physical strike, and a lightning strike that trigger elemental '{'Tempest'}' spells of the same damage type if the strikes hit at least one enemy.

Cold strike: Triggers a '{'Frigid Tempest'}', which is a cold projectile that pierces through enemies.
Physical strike: Triggers a '{'Wind Tempest'}', which is a small twister that lasts a short duration dealing physical damage per over time.
Lightning strike: Triggers a '{'Thunder Tempest'}', which is an expanding storm of lightning bolts.
Abilities.Ability_TempestStrike_AltText:
Added damage for the melee strikes apply at 100% effectiveness.

'{'Frigid Tempest'}': Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness.
'{'Wind Tempest'}': Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness per second.
'{'Thunder Tempest'}': Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Tempest Strike Frost S: Conjures a spear of frost that pierces enemies.
Abilities.Ability_TempestStrike combo2_D:
A melee combo attack that cycles through a cold strike, a physical strike, and a lightning strike that trigger elemental '{'Tempest'}' spells of the same damage type if the strikes hit at least one enemy.

Cold strike: Triggers a '{'Frigid Tempest'}', which is a cold projectile that pierces through enemies.
Physical strike: Triggers a '{'Wind Tempest'}', which is a small twister that lasts a short duration dealing physical damage per over time.
Lightning strike: Triggers a '{'Thunder Tempest'}', which is an expanding storm of lightning bolts.
Abilities.Ability_TempestStrike combo2_A:
Added damage for the melee strikes apply at 100% effectiveness.

'{'Frigid Tempest'}': Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness.
'{'Wind Tempest'}': Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness per second.
'{'Thunder Tempest'}': Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Tempest Strike Whirlwi: Conjures a whirlwind that moves a short distance forwards, dealing damage over time to enemies in its path.
Added damage applies to the damage over time at 150% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_TempestStrike combo3_D:
A melee combo attack that cycles through a cold strike, a physical strike, and a lightning strike that trigger elemental '{'Tempest'}' spells of the same damage type if the strikes hit at least one enemy.

Cold strike: Triggers a '{'Frigid Tempest'}', which is a cold projectile that pierces through enemies.
Physical strike: Triggers a '{'Wind Tempest'}', which is a small twister that lasts a short duration dealing physical damage per over time.
Lightning strike: Triggers a '{'Thunder Tempest'}', which is an expanding storm of lightning bolts.
Abilities.Ability_TempestStrike combo3_A:
Added damage for the melee strikes apply at 100% effectiveness.

'{'Frigid Tempest'}': Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness.
'{'Wind Tempest'}': Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness per second.
'{'Thunder Tempest'}': Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_TempestStrike Lightnin: Conjures a wave of lightning that damages all enemies around you.
Abilities.Ability_SummonStormSprite_Desc: Summons a storm sprite to defend your totem. Storm Sprites use lightning spells to damage nearby enemies and last for 6 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_DetonateGround_Descrip: After a short delay the ground erupts in a firey explosion.
Abilities.Ability_DetonateGround_AltText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SummonFrenzyTotem_Desc: Summons a totem that grants Frenzy to all nearby allies. Frenzy increases attack and cast speed by 20%.
Abilities.Ability_SummonFrenzyTotem_AltT: Frenzy totems have 120 base health and last 6 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_SummonValeSpirit_Descr: Creates a Vale Spirit which orbits you for a short time. During this time you automatically shoot nearby enemies with Spirit Thorns from the Vale Spirit.
Abilities.Ability_SummonValeSpirit_AltTe: The Spirit Thorns cast through Vale Spirit use your stats.
Abilities.Ability_SummonBoneMinion_Descr: Summon a Bone Minion to attack your enemies for 20 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_SummonDeathKnight_Desc: Summons a Skeleton Death Knight to assist you.
Abilities.Ability_SummonDeathKnight_AltT: Skeleton Death Knights have 200 base health and 15% base critical strike chance. Press A to give your minions an attack command.
Abilities.Ability_Skeletal Mages Cold Pr: Cast a razor sharp shard of ice at the target direction. Added spell damage applies at 150% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Skeletal Mages Fire Pr: Cast a ball of fire towards the target. Added spell damage applies at 175% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Static_Description:
Static charges up as you move or when you get hit. Activate Static to discharge what you have built up, striking up to 5 nearby enemies with lightning.

100 charges maximum. Deals 4% more damage per charge.
Abilities.Ability_Static_AltText:
By default static gains 5 charges per second while moving, and also gains 5 charges whenever you take a hit.

Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_OldDischarge_Descripti: Zaps up to five nearby enemies, dealing lightning damage.
Abilities.Ability_OldDischarge_AltText: Added damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_BloodTether_Descriptio:
Tethers an enemy, drawing blood from them to deal physical damage over time. Deals 1% more damage per bleed on the target.

3% of damage dealt is leeched as health.
Abilities.Ability_BloodTether_AltText:
An enemy cannot have more than one tether at a time. Tethers last 3 seconds.

Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_SummonNecroticWisp_Des: Summons a wisp which lasts 10 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_PhysicalNova_Descripti: Destroy your enemies so forcefully that they generate a burst of physical damage around them as they die.
Abilities.Ability_PhysicalNova_AltText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_PoisonPool_Description: Leave a pool of poison the ground for several seconds that poisons enemies within it each second.
Abilities.Ability_SummonBabyScorpion_Des: Summons baby scorpions which will follow your scorpion around and attack enemies. Baby scorpions receive the same stats as your scorpion.
Abilities.Ability_SummonBabyScorpion_Alt: The scorpion has 400 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks. Press A to give your minions an attack command.
Abilities.Ability_IceShard_Description: Cast a razor sharp shard of ice at the target direction.
Abilities.Ability_IceShard_AltText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Disintegrate_Descripti: Channel to create a beam of pure energy in the target direction. The beam deals fire and lightning damage to all enemies caught in it.
Abilities.Ability_Disintegrate_AltText: Added damage applies at 480% effectiveness each second. Damage reduces while rotating.
Abilities.Ability_TundraNova_Description: Cast a burst of frigid sleet to pelt enemies around the target.
Abilities.Ability_TundraNova_AltText: Tundra Nova has a freeze rate of 80.
Abilities.Ability_HolyEruption_Descripti: An eruption of holy power that deals spell fire damage to enemies and heals 80 health to nearby allies.
Abilities.Ability_Maelstrom_Description:
Surrounds you with a freezing Maelstrom that deals cold damage over time to nearby enemies.

Can be cast repeatedly to create multiple maelstroms at once. Each Maelstrom lasts 7 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_Maelstrom_AltText:
Each Maelstrom has a base freeze rate per second of 24.

Added spell damage applies to each Maelstrom at 100% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_Manifest Armor 02 Forg: Deals fire damage in a cone. Added spell damage applies a 350% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Tsunami_Description: Creates a frigid cascading Tsunami around you that deals cold damage in an area.
Abilities.Ability_Tsunami_AltText:
If cast by Maelstrom, the total damage is multiplied by the number of Maelstrom stacks you reached.

Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SummonRaptor_Descripti:
Summons a primal raptor that ferociously attacks your enemies. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The raptor counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
Abilities.Ability_SummonRaptor_AltText: The raptor has 240 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.
Abilities.Ability_Rampage_Description:
The companion ability of your Primal Raptor.

Sends your Raptor into a rampage. Your raptor gains 40% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 40% increased attack speed, cast speed, movement speed, and size for 4 seconds
Abilities.Ability_Rampage_AltText: Scales with your Raptor''s stats rather than yours
Abilities.Ability_Fire Fissure_Descripti: Open a fissure underneath your enemies, dealing spell fire damage over time for 3 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_Fire Fissure_AltText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness each second.
Abilities.Ability_RaptorScreech_Descript: Your raptor emits a vicious screech, dealing damage to and shredding the armor of nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_Manifest Armor 04 Char: Charge at a nearby enemy, knocking back and dealing physical damage to enemies hit along the path.
Abilities.Ability_Manifest Armor 03 Whir: The Manifest Armor quickly spins, hitting all enemies around it. Added damage applies at 300% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Earthquake_Description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area around you sending out tremors to nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_EarthquakeAftershock_D: Seeks out targets and erupts, damaging all nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_EarthquakeAftershock_A: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness
Abilities.Ability_DivineFlare_Descriptio: A holy blast which deals spell fire damage to nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_EarthquakeSlam_Descrip: Slam the ground with your weapon damaging enemies in a large area and creating 2 to 4 aftershocks nearby.
Abilities.Ability_EarthquakeSlam_AltText: Added melee damage applies at 700% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Shift_Description: Dash a short fixed distance in the target direction.
Abilities.Ability_Shift_AltText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills'' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.
Abilities.Ability_DetonatingArrow_Descri:
Requires a bow.

Fires an arrow that embeds itself in a target then explodes after 0.6 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_DetonatingArrow_AltTex: Added bow damage applies to the arrow at 125% effectiveness and to the explosion at 200% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_ArcaneAscendance_Descr: Toggle to prevent movement and drain 25 mana each second. Mana drain increases by 1 mana per second. All spells cost +5 mana to cast. 100% increased spell damage and 50% increased cast speed. Also deals lightning damage over time to surrounding enemies.
Abilities.Ability_ArcaneAscendance_AltTe: Added damage is applied at 45% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_ArcaneAscendanceExit_D: Toggle to prevent movement and drain 25 mana each second. Mana drain increases by 1 mana per second. All spells cost +5 mana to cast. 100% increased spell damage and 50% increased cast speed.
Abilities.Ability_SummonBee_Description: Summon a bee to destroy your enemies for 10 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_Furnace_Description:
Spews sweltering heat in a cone in front of you, dealing fire damage over time.

Added damage applies at 240% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_Squirrel Ability_Descr:
The companion ability of your Primal Squirrels.

Your squirrels are worked up into a Sciurine Rage and gain 40% increased movement and attack speed for 4 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_SummonAreksFlesh_Descr: Summon the remains of Arek to fight for you. Arek uses physical melee attacks.
Abilities.Ability_SummonAreksFlesh_AltTe: Press A to give your minions an attack command.
Abilities.Ability_TimeWave_Description: Release a torrent of time distortion around you, damaging nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_InfernalShade_Descript: Target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second. Each enemy can only have one Infernal Shade attached at a time. Expires after 5 seconds. Max 4 active shades.
Abilities.Ability_InfernalShade_AltText:
Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness each second.

Your maximum number of shades is shared with Dread Shade.
Abilities.Ability_AssembleAbomination_De:
Hold ability key to channel to absorb your Wraiths, Summoned Skeletons, Skeletal Mages, Golems, and Volatile Zombies in an area. When you release, summon a single hulking abomination with added health and more damage per minion absorbed.

The abomination remembers the minions absorbed to create it and will rapidly devour those minions to restore 10% of its maximum health.
Abilities.Ability_AssembleAbomination_Al:
Abomination gains health equal to the max health of minions consumed and 5% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per minion consumed (up to 20 minions).
All minions of the same type are devoured if any one of them are absorbed. For example, Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Archers are the same type of Summoned Skeleton.
Abilities.Ability_Abomination Melee_Desc: Attacks enemies in an area in front of the abomination.
Abilities.Ability_DrainLife_Description: Channelled spell that targets up to 3 enemies around the target location, dealing necrotic damage over time and leeching 30% of that damage back as health.
Abilities.Ability_DrainLife_AltText: Added spell damage applies at 360% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_RogueMultishot_Descrip:
Requires a bow.

A bow attack that fires a cone of 5 arrows in the target direction. Aiming the cursor further from your character reduces the spread.
Abilities.Ability_RogueMultishot_AltText: Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness
Abilities.Ability_FireTrail_Description: Leaves a wake of fire behind you that ignites enemies and lasts for 3 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_SummonBallista_Descrip: Summons a ballista that fires bolts at nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_SummonBallista_AltText: Ballistae have 1000 base health and last 10 seconds by default. Enemies rarely target ballistas.
Abilities.Ability_NecroticExplosion_Desc: Create a burst of necrotic damage in an area around the target.
Abilities.Ability_NecroticExplosion_AltT: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_TimeBubble_Description: Creates a bubble where time moves slower than the space around it. Slows enemies caught in the time bubble and shreds their void resistance.
Abilities.Ability_BurningGround_Descript: A Burning patch on the ground which ignites all enemies twice per second.
Abilities.Ability_DeathSeal_Description:
Toggle to seal your health, preventing it from going above its current value for 3 seconds. While sealed you take less damage equal to half your percent missing health, and 90% of hit damage taken is dealt over 4 seconds. 

Reactivate to unleash a Wave of Death dealing damage based on how long Death Seal has been active and your current percent missing health.
Abilities.Ability_DeathSeal_AltText:
The Wave of Death deals up to 20% more damage per second Death Seal has been active and deal 1% more damage per 1% missing health. Both effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

Added spell damage applies at 500% effectiveness to Wave of Death.

Hit damage that is dealt over 4 seconds cannot be altered after the hit and is unaffected by temporary immunity effects. It does not count as damage over time.
Abilities.Ability_DeathSealWave_Descript: Releases a Wave of Death dealing damage based on how long Death Seal has been actve and your current percent missing health.
Abilities.Ability_DeathSealExit_Descript: Releases a Wave of Death dealing damage based on how long Death Seal has been actve and your current percent missing health.
Abilities.Ability_SummonHealingTotem_Des: Summons a totem that repeatedly heals nearby allies for 100 health. Healing totems have 100 base health and last 6 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_VoidCleave_Description:
Requires a 2-handed sword or axe.

A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Can be echoed by Void Knights. Unaffected by weapon range.
Abilities.Ability_ShieldBash_Description:
Requires a shield.

A melee directional attack that stuns enemies for 1 second. 100% increased stun duration against non-boss enemies.

1.5% more damage per 1% block chance (up to 150%, multiplicative with other modifiers).

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you stun an enemy, including with Shield Bash itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.
Abilities.Ability_ShieldBash_AltText:
Increased attack speed has no effect for Shield Bash.

Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_DarkQuiver_Description:
Requires a bow.

Summons 7 Black Arrows that rain from the sky over 4 seconds, granting 100% increased damage to your next bow attack when retrieved.
Abilities.Ability_DarkQuiver_AltText: You can hold up to 3 Black Arrows at once, but can only expend one at a time.
Abilities.Ability_SummonVolatileZombie_D: Summons a Volatile Zombie which trudges towards the nearest enemy. When it reaches an enemy or dies, it explodes dealing physical and fire damage to surrounding enemies.
Abilities.Ability_SummonVolatileZombie_A:
You are limited to 6 active zombies. Summoning more will cause older ones to explode.

Volatile Zombies have 200 base health and their health decays at an accelerating rate. Their explosion has 600% effectiveness of added spell damage.
Abilities.Ability_SummonSkeletonVanguard: Summon a Skeleton Vanguard wielding a spear which fights for you.
Abilities.Ability_DreadShade_Description: Your minion''s health is drained for 3% of its max health per second for each second the shade has been active, but it and your minions around it deal +10 necrotic damage with spells and attacks and have 50% increased necrotic damage.
Abilities.Ability_DreadShade_AltText:
Each minion only benefits from one Dread Shade aura. Max 4 active shades.

Your maximum number of shades is shared with Infernal Shade.
Abilities.Ability_TailSlam_Description:
A melee physical hit followed by a powerful cascading explosion. The explosion counts as a fire spell and applies ignite on hit.

Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness to the melee hit and 200% effectiveness to the explosion.

Increased Area for Minion Area Skills applies to the melee hit, but not the cascading explosion.
Abilities.Ability_SummonMercenary_Descri: Recruit a crossbow mercenary to guard you.
Abilities.Ability_SummonMercenary_AltTex: Press A to give your minions an attack command.
Abilities.Ability_DevouringSouls_Descrip:
Calls forth five hungering souls that seeks out enemies, on hit they deal necrotic damage and then possesses the target.

Possessed enemies take necrotic damage over time for 1.5 seconds. Enemies cannot be possessed by multiple souls at once.
Abilities.Ability_DevouringSouls_AltText:
Possess''s damage counts as spell damage and it is affected by modifiers to base spell damage.

Added spell damage applies to the initial hit at 200% and to possess at 100% per second for 1.5 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_soulReave_Description: A necrotic melee attack that hits all enemies in a wide area. This attack has 15% more radius compared to the abomination''s basic melee attack.
Abilities.Ability_Abomination Double Str: Two rapid melee attacks which strike all enemies in front of the abomination.
Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness for each hit of Double Strike.
Abilities.Ability_BoneEruption_Descripti: Bones erupt from the ground, dealing physical damage to enemies in the area.
Abilities.Ability_AlluvionWave_Descripti: A wave of crashing water dealing spell cold damage in a wide area. Added spell damage is applied at 400% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_DragonfireNova_Descrip: Create a burst of fire damage around a minion. This ability is cast by your minion, not by you.
Abilities.Ability_Firebrand_Description: A melee attack which grants you a stack of Firebrand buff if it hits an enemy. Each stack of the Firebrand buff increases the size of subsequent Firebrand attacks and adds melee fire damage.
Abilities.Ability_Firebrand_AltText:
Firebrand can stack up to 4 times. Each stack grants +5 melee fire damage, increases the size of Firebrand attacks by 25% and lasts for 4 seconds.

Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_FlameWave_Description: Launch a wave of flame toward the target, hitting all enemies in its path.
Abilities.Ability_FlameWave_AltText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_ShieldShatter_Descript: Launch shield fragments in a cone in front of you.
Abilities.Ability_FlurryWave_Description:
Strike with such force that your blows extend further, granting additional range. Does not hit targets already hit by the attack that generated the Force Wave.
This still counts as a melee attack.
Abilities.Ability_FlurryWave_AltText: Added damage is applied at 50% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Puncture_Description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that has a 30% chance to inflict bleed on hit. Bleeds inflicted by puncture have 30% increased duration.
Abilities.Ability_Puncture_AltText:
When using a bow, Puncture deals 5% less damage to each subsequent enemy hit up to 20% less damage.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Bow Flurry_Description: A bow or melee attack that performs 3 rapid strikes. The last strike can be cancelled by moving.
Abilities.Ability_Bow Flurry_AltText: Added damage applies at 80% effectiveness to each strike and each strike has a 40% reduced chance to apply ailments on hit.
Abilities.Ability_Decoy_Description: Throw a device to create a Decoy that taunts enemies around it for 2.5 seconds before exploding.
Abilities.Ability_Decoy_AltText:
Added throwing attack damage is applied at 600% effectiveness to the explosion.

The Decoy cannot be destroyed before it expires.
Abilities.Ability_Decoy Small Explosion_: Trigger small hidden explosives hidden in your Decoy, damaging enemies near it.
Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Decoy Sonic Wave_Descr: Your Decoy emits a piercing sound that afflicts enemies around it with armor shred and frailty.
Abilities.Ability_DancingStrike1_Descrip:
Requires dual wielding.

A combo ability that is a series of fast dash attacks. Dancing Strikes gains increased movement speed and more damage equal to 50% of your total increased melee attack speed.
Abilities.Ability_DancingStrike1_AltText:
Added damage is applied to each attack at 150% effectiveness.

Your total increased melee attack speed includes the modifier from attack rate and generic increased attack speed stats. If your '{'Melee Attack Speed'}' is 1.5, then Dancing Strikes gains 25% increased movement speed and 25% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Dancing Strikes cannot gain more than 100% increased movement speed.
Abilities.Ability_DancingStrike2_Descrip:
Requires dual wielding.

A series of fast dash attacks. Dancing Strikes'' movement does not scale with attack speed, but it gains increased cooldown recovery speed and more damage equal to 50% of your total increased melee attack speed.
Abilities.Ability_DancingStrike2_AltText:
Added damage is applied to each attack at 150% effectiveness.

Your total increased melee attack speed includes the modifier from attack rate and generic increased attack speed stats. If your '{'Melee Attack Speed'}' is 1.5, then Dancing Strikes gains 25% increased cooldown recovery speed and 25% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Abilities.Ability_DancingStrike3_Descrip:
Requires dual wielding.

A series of fast dash attacks. Dancing Strikes'' movement does not scale with attack speed, but it gains increased cooldown recovery speed and more damage equal to 50% of your total increased melee attack speed.
Abilities.Ability_DancingStrike3_AltText:
Added damage is applied to each attack at 150% effectiveness.

Your total increased melee attack speed includes the modifier from attack rate and generic increased attack speed stats. If your '{'Melee Attack Speed'}' is 1.5, then Dancing Strikes gains 25% increased cooldown recovery speed and 25% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Abilities.Ability_DancingStrike4_Descrip:
Requires dual wielding.

A series of fast dash attacks. Dancing Strikes'' movement does not scale with attack speed, but it gains increased cooldown recovery speed and more damage equal to 50% of your total increased melee attack speed.
Abilities.Ability_DancingStrike4_AltText:
Added damage is applied to each attack at 150% effectiveness.

Your total increased melee attack speed includes the modifier from attack rate and generic increased attack speed stats. If your '{'Melee Attack Speed'}' is 1.5, then Dancing Strikes gains 25% increased cooldown recovery speed and 25% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Abilities.Ability_Chakram_Description: Throw a single Chakram that pierces through all enemies, rebounds off terrain, and returns to you. Enemies can be hit a second time when the Chakram is returning.
Abilities.Ability_Chakram_AltText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_BowPuncture_Descriptio: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that has a 30% chance to inflict bleed on hit. Bleed inflicted by puncture has 30% increased duration.
Abilities.Ability_BowPuncture_AltText:
When using a bow, Puncture deals 5% less damage to each subsequent enemy hit up to 20% less damage.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_TotemPoisonBurst_Descr: Deals a small amount of physical damage and has 100% chance to poison on hit.
Abilities.Ability_TotemPoisonBurst_AltTe: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Lethal Mirage_Descript: Become immune for a duration and rapidly strike nearby targets with 6 mirages.
Abilities.Ability_Lethal Mirage_AltText:
Mirages'' added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats apply to the attacks of individual mirages, but not to the maximum range at which mirages can be created.
Abilities.Ability_CreateShadow_Descripti:
Create a Shadow of yourself that persists for up to 5 seconds and will imitate your next direct use of Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, or Acid Flask. Shadows can also imitate indirect uses of Shadow Cascade.
Up to 3 Shadows can be active at once.
Abilities.Ability_DetonationChainLightni: A bolt of lightning created by the detonation, jumping to nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_SynchronizedStrike_Des:
Requires a melee weapon.

Jump forward and strike in an area in front of you while shadows appear and simultaneously strike on either side of you.

The shadows will persist afterwards for up to 5 seconds. Shadows will imitate your next direct use of Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, Explosive Trap, or Acid Flask. Shadows can also imitate indirect uses of Shadow Cascade. Up to 3 shadows can be active at once.
Abilities.Ability_SynchronizedStrike_Alt: Added damage applies to each hit at 300% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_HailOfArrows_Descripti:
Requires a bow.

Launch a hail of arrows into the sky that rain down on the target location over 3.5 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_HailOfArrows_AltText: Added bow damage is applied at 325% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_CinderStrike_Descripti:
A combo ability with three attacks. The first attack also creates a fiery explosion, damaging nearby enemies.

Can be used with a bow or melee weapon.
Abilities.Ability_CinderStrike_AltText:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 2 seconds without using Cinder Strike.

Added damage applies to the first attack at 200% effectiveness, and to the other attacks at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_CinderStrikeCombo2_Des: Melee or bow combo with three attacks. The first attack also creates a fiery explosion, damaging nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_CinderStrikeCombo2_Alt:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 2 seconds without using Cinder Strike.

Added damage applies to the first attack at 200% effectiveness, and to the other attacks at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_CinderStrikeCombo3_Des: Melee or bow combo with three attacks. The first attack also creates a fiery explosion, damaging nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_CinderStrikeCombo3_Alt:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 2 seconds without using Cinder Strike.

Added damage applies to the first attack at 200% effectiveness, and to the other attacks at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Cinder Strike Bow_Desc: Melee or bow combo with three attacks. The first attack also creates a fiery explosion, damaging nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_Cinder Strike Bow_AltT:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 2 seconds without using Cinder Strike.

Added damage applies to the first attack at 200% effectiveness, and to the other attacks at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Burning Dagger Throw_D: Launch a burning dagger at a nearby enemy.
Abilities.Ability_Burning Dagger Throw_A: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Burning Dagger Throw 5: Launch a cone of burning daggers at nearby enemies.
Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Rain of Arrows_Descrip: Launch a hail of arrows into the sky that hits all enemies in an area around the target.
Abilities.Ability_Rain of Arrows_AltText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_ExplosiveFlaskExplosio: Throw a highly explosive flask at a target.
Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SummonStormCrow_Descri:
Summons Storm Crows up to your companion limit. The Storm Crow casts spells from a distance. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The Storm Crow counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
Abilities.Ability_SummonStormCrow_AltTex: The crow has 200 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.
Abilities.Ability_Storm Crow Ability_Des:
The companion ability of your Storm Crows.

Your crows call down a single massive lightning strike on the targeted area after a brief delay, hitting all enemies in the area. Deals 30% more damage per contributing crow.
Abilities.Ability_Storm Crow Ability_Alt:
Your crows'' added spell damage applies at 400% effectiveness by default.

Not affected by increased cast speed.
Abilities.Ability_SummonWarcryTotem_Desc: Summons a totem that repeatedly grants casts Warcry.
Abilities.Ability_SummonWarcryTotem_AltT: Warcry totems have 100 base health and last 3 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_MageLightning_Descript: An arc of lightning from your mana blade that strikes each enemy hit by Mana Strike.
Abilities.Ability_MageLightning_AltText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_TidalWave_Description: A wave of crashing water dealing spell cold damage and chilling enemies in a wide area.
Abilities.Ability_TidalWave_AltText: Added damage is applied at 400% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SummonCorpseParasite_D: Summon a corpse parasite that will attack nearby enemies for 4 seconds, dealing melee physical damage.
Abilities.Ability_SummonCorpseParasite_A: Press A to give your minions an attack command.
Abilities.Ability_Anchor of Oblivion Wav:
A devastating wave of void centred on the caster.

Added spell damage is applied at 500% effectiveness.

Applies three stacks of slow to the caster.
Abilities.Ability_GasparSetSwipe_Descrip: Slashes the area in front of you with void. Added spell damage is applied at 800% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_HeorotUniqueBowIcicle_: Cast a shard of ice in the direction of your bow attack.
Abilities.Ability_Icicle_Description: Cast an arc of ice spikes towards your enemy.
Abilities.Ability_Icicle_AltText: Added spell damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_ZombieVomit_Descriptio: Vomits to death over 3 seconds, dealing a mixture of physical and poison damage over time to nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_Coagulated Blood Explo:
Combine the excess coagulated blood into an orb that seeks out the nearest enemy and explodes, hitting all nearby enemies.
Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Multistrike_Descriptio:
A melee attack that grants a stack of '{'Armament'}' if you hit at least one enemy.

Armament stacks up to 2 times and each stack lasts 3 seconds.

Each stack of '{'Armament'}' causes an additional sword to strike a nearby enemy when you use Multistrike.
Abilities.Ability_Multistrike_AltText:
Additional swords cannot target the enemy you initially hit or enemies targeted by other swords.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Javelin_Description:
Hurl a javelin that pierces through every enemy in its path.

If you have a spear equipped added melee damage from the spear applies to Javelin as added throwing damage at 50% of its normal value. Added melee damage from other sources has no effect.

Added throwing damage applies at 250% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Javelin_AltText:
This is a throwing attack that scales with throwing attack damage and throwing attack speed.

The 250% added throwing damage effectiveness applies to all added throwing damage, including added throwing damage that was converted from your spear''s added melee damage. So, equipping a spear with +100 Melee Damage causes Javelin to deal 125 additional damage.
Abilities.Ability_JavelinLightningSpear_: A spear of lightning that emerges from the Javelin and seeks out a nearby enemy, piercing all in its path.
Abilities.Ability_FlameTrail_Description:
Creates a trail of holy fire and lightning which damages enemies standing on it.

Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_Upheaval_Description: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.
Abilities.Ability_Upheaval_AltText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Swarmblade Form_Descri:
Transform into an agile Swarmblade, increasing your melee capabilities, and gaining 4 new abilities.

Your mana is replaced with Rage while in swarmblade form. When your Rage reaches 0 you automatically transform back into your human form. Your starting Rage is equal to your maximum mana. Rage slowly decays over time at a constant rate.
Abilities.Ability_Swarmblade Form_AltTex:
The four new abilities are: Armblade Slashes, Swarm Strike, Dash and Summon Hive.

While in Swarmblade Form you have 10% increased melee attack speed and movement speed.

When returning to human form, your mana will return to the amount you had before shapeshifting, but you will have gained the mana you regenerated while shapeshifted. Other forms of mana recovery do not apply.
Abilities.Ability_SwarmbladeToHumanForm_: Return back to human form, returning your original stats and abilities.
Abilities.Ability_SwarmbladeSummonHive_D:
Summons a Hive that releases Locusts while enemies are nearby. You can have a maximum of three Hives by default and each Hive contains 12 Locusts.

You are limited to 12 active Locusts and each Locust lasts up to 12 seconds.
Abilities.Ability_SwarmbladeSummonHive_A: The rate at which it summons Locusts scales with minion cast speed. Locusts scale with your minion stats.
Abilities.Ability_SwarmbladeShift_Descri: Dash a short fixed distance in the target direction dealing damage to all enemies in your path.
Abilities.Ability_SwarmbladeShift_AltTex:
Dive''s cooldown does not recover while you are using it.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness
Abilities.Ability_SwarmbladeArmbladeSlas: Slash enemies in front of you with a fast combo ability.
Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness
Abilities.Ability_SwarmbladeSpinAttack_D: A circular attack which deals damage to all nearby enemies, then gathers nearby locusts to create a Swarm around you which deals damage over time to nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_SwarmbladeSpinAttack_A:
For each Locust consumed the Swarm gains +15 melee physical, +15 melee poison damage, 15% increased duration, and 15% increased area.

Added melee damage applies at 350% effectiveness to the initial hit and at 300% per second to the Swarm.
Abilities.Ability_Locust Swarm_Descripti:
Surrounds you with a swarm of locusts that deals melee damage over time.

Has a base duration of 4 seconds. Only one Locust Swarm can exist at once.
Abilities.Ability_Locust Swarm_AltText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SwarmbladeArmbladeSlas: Slash enemies in front of you with a fast combo ability.
Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness
Abilities.Ability_Umbral Blades 1_Descri:
A combo ability that throws 2 blades, then 4 blades, then recalls all blades in the ground back to you, hitting enemies along the way.

An enemy can be hit by multiple blades from the same throw and by multiple blades from the recall.

Only the first part of the combo costs mana.
Abilities.Ability_Umbral Blades 1_AltTex:
Added damage applies at 60% effectiveness. 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.

Abilities.Ability_Summon Spirit Sabertoo: Creates an ancestral spirit sabertooth which will attack your enemies for 4 seconds before dissipating. Ancestral sabertooths have the same stats as your sabertooth, but can''t use abilities other than basic attack.
Abilities.Ability_Wraithlord 01 Stygian: Shoots beams of dark energy at up to 3 targets. The beams deal necrotic damage on hit, and the Wraithlord''s added spell damage is applied at 200% effectiveness to each hit.

Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

Abilities.Ability_VoidwinterBolt_Descrip: Cast 3 piercing corrupted shards of ice towards enemies in front of you.
Abilities.Ability_VoidwinterBolt_AltText: Added spell damage is applied at 600% effectiveness to each shard.
Abilities.Ability_FearCircleCurse_Descri:
Inflicts Fear for 1.5 to 2.7 seconds, causing enemies to flee from the target location. Enemies can only be feared once.

Effects that trigger when you use Evade also trigger when you use Terrify.
Abilities.Ability_SummonCrab_Description:
Summons a loyal crab that follows you into combat.

Effects that trigger when you use Evade also trigger when you use Summon Crab.
Abilities.Ability_SummonCrab_AltText: The crab has 400 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.
Abilities.Ability_Swap With Wandering Sp:
Swap places with a target wandering spirit at the targeted area. If there is no spirit, you will instead reappear a short distance forwards.

Effects that trigger when you use Evade also trigger when you use Spirit Step.
Abilities.Ability_Doom Pulse_Description: Unleashes a wave of void energy in the target direction. Added spell damage is applied at at 500% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Volatile Reversal Void: Launches a bolt of piercing void energy at a nearby enemy.
Abilities.Ability_EnchantWeapon FireExpl: An explosion that deals fire damage in an area.
Abilities.Ability_Shade FireExplosion_De: An explosion that deals fire damage in an area.
Abilities.Ability_Smite LightningBolt_De: A bolt of lightning directly strikes the target.
Abilities.Ability_Smite LightningBolt_Al: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Heartseeker_Descriptio:
Requires a bow.

Shoot an arrow that seeks the heart of a nearby target, passing harmlessly through other enemies. Whenever it hits its target it has a chance to continue through it and '{'Recurve'}' to strike it again. 

Subsequent '{'Recurve'}' chance is multiplied by 0.8 each time the arrow '{'Recurves'}'. If the target dies, it will choose a new target.
Abilities.Ability_Heartseeker_AltText:
Base recurve chance is 100%.
Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_ForgeFlames_Descriptio: Radiates extreme heat, dealing fire damage to enemies within 2.5 meters.
Abilities.Ability_ForgeFlames_AltText: Added spell damage is applied at 200% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_Summon Tolmat Minion_D:
Tolmat''s History of Eterra describes many fantastical creatures from across the eras of Eterra, and how to tame them.

One such creature is summoned to aid you whenever you travel to a new area, and if it perishes a new one will be summoned in its stead.
Abilities.Ability_Summon Tolmat Minion_A: Press A to give your minions an attack command.
Abilities.Ability_TimeTravel AoE Telepor: Travel between the Divine and Imperial eras without moving, dragging nearby enemies along with you.
<#C686FF>Temporal Rift</color> ability gained while inside the Oerden''s Watch Woven Echo.
Abilities.Ability_Abomination EternalArr:
The abomination''s archer shoots an arrow that seeks the heart of a nearby target, passing harmlessly through other enemies. Whenever it hits its target it has a chance to continue through it and '{'Recurve'}' to strike it again. 

Subsequent '{'Recurve'}' chance is multiplied by 0.8 each time the arrow '{'Recurves'}'. If the target dies, it will choose a new target.

Base recurve chance is 100%.

Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Abomination Minion Sto: The abomination stomps the ground, dealing physical damage to enemies in the area.
Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_AuraOfRot_Description: An aura surrounding the abomination which poisons it every second. Enemies near it are poisoned four times a second, and the abomination''s chance to poison on hit applies to each of these instances at 25% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_Summon AncientOasis01:
Summons Anuroks to fill your unused companion slots.

Anuroks are not affected by increased area of effect stats, but gain 3% more damage for each 1% increased Area of Effect for Minion Area Skills.
Abilities.Ability_PrimordialBloodSplatte:
Primordial Blood Splatter is a physical spell that deals damage to other enemies around the target.

Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_RaptorFireBreath_Descr: Your raptor breathes fire on enemies in a cone in front of it, dealing fire spell damage over time for 1 second.
Abilities.Ability_RaptorFireBreath_AltTe: Added spell damage applies at 400% effectiveness per second.
Abilities.Ability_BearThornBurst_Descrip: Releases a burst of thorns, damaging all nearby enemies.
Abilities.Ability_BearThornBurst_AltText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_PrimalBear Teleport_De: Your bear teleports towards an enemy at an unbearable speed.
Abilities.Ability_Summon Giant T_Rex Min:
Summons a Tyrannosaur minion that follows you into combat. It can roar, granting your other minions +25 physical damage with spells and attacks, and the bonuses from Tyrant''s Skull are applied to them at 20% effectiveness. The roar''s buff lasts for 12 seconds, and also grants frenzy to all allies hit for the same duration.

The roar also applies frailty, slow, and armor shred to nearby enemies.
Press A to give your minions an attack command.
Abilities.Ability_Bladestorm Throw_Descr:
Throw spinning blades towards the target location where they will hit nearby enemies 3 times per second. 

Bladestorms last 4 seconds. You can have a maximum of 3 Bladestorms active at once, but each enemy can only take damage from one at a time.
Abilities.Ability_Bladestorm Throw_AltTe:
Bladestorms hit 3 times per second, and added damage applies at 150% effectiveness to each hit.
Bladestorms have 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.
Abilities.Ability_ShadowRend_Description:
Perform a short dash attack and manifest a shadow at your previous position, which will perform a sweeping melee attack or piercing bow attack for you after a short delay.

The shadow will persist afterwards for up to 5 seconds. Shadows will imitate your next direct use of Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, Explosive Trap, or Acid Flask. Shadows can also imitate indirect uses of Shadow Cascade. Up to 3 shadows can be active at once.
Abilities.Ability_ShadowRend_AltText:
The initial attack has 100% damage effectiveness, and the shadow''s attack has 500% damage effectiveness.

Modifiers to skills used by shadows affect the shadow''s attack.
Abilities.Ability_ShadowRend Bow_Descrip:
Perform a short dash attack and manifest a shadow at your previous position, which will perform a sweeping melee attack or piercing bow attack for you after a short delay.

The shadow will persist afterwards for up to 5 seconds. Shadows will imitate your next Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, Explosive Trap, or Acid Flask. Up to 3 shadows can be active at once.
Abilities.Ability_ShadowRend Bow_AltText:
The initial attack has 100% damage effectiveness, and the shadow''s attack has 500% damage effectiveness.

Modifiers to skills used by shadows affect the shadow''s attack.
Abilities.Ability_ShadowBlade_Descriptio: Throw a ghastly blade at a nearby enemy, with 100% chance to inflict Shadow Daggers.
Abilities.Ability_BladeStormExplosion_De: The Bladestorm detonates, causing an explosion of damage in an area that is twice the size of the Bladestorm.
Abilities.Ability_BoneSplinters_Descript:
Unleashes multiple splinters of bone in a cone behind Marrow Shards.
An enemy can only be hit by Marrow Shards or one projectile from Bone Splinters.
Abilities.Ability_BoneSplinters_AltText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.
Abilities.Ability_SplinterNova_Descripti: Splintered bones fly out in all directions, impaling enemies.
Abilities.Ability_SplinterNova_AltText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.

<color=#fff>Destroys an item, creating a random number of Affix Shards containing its powers.

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Rerolls the values of all affixes on an item within their tiers.

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Removes a random affix on an item, returning a number of shards equal to its tier.

<font="Caladea SDF"><color=#B4AD99>Experimental and Personal affixes cannot be removed this way.</font>

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Adds random tier 1 affixes to all empty affix slots on an item. Has an increased chance of rolling rarer affixes.

<font="Caladea SDF"><color=#B4AD99>Does not cost forging potential, but cannot be applied to items with zero forging potential.</font>

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Rerolls all implicits on an item.

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Changes the item into a unique or set item of the same item type.

Using this on a Silver Ring could turn it into any unique ring, including ones that are not Silver Rings. However it cannot turn it into a Helmet.

None of the other properties of the base item are retained.

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Duplicates the item, but reduces the forging potential of both the original and the copy to 0.

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Seals an experimental affix on the item. The affix is moved to its own slot, leaving its old slot open for you to add a new affix.<font="Caladea SDF"><color=#B4AD99>

The sealed affix cannot be modified further and an item can have a maximum of one sealed affix.

When an experimental affix is sealed you have a chance to gain a Glyph of Insight. This chance is higher for items with higher tier affixes, but cannot exceed 45%.

</font><color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Transforms a random amount of the remaining Weaver''s Will or Weaver''s Touch on an item into additional affixes or affix tiers as if you had slain many enemies with that item equipped.

</font><color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Shuffles the tiers of non-sealed affixes on an exalted item with 4 non-sealed affixes.<font="Caladea SDF"><color=#B4AD99>

For example an item with tier 2 strength, tier 7 dexterity, tier 3 health, and tier 2 endurance might be changed to have tier 7 strength, tier 3 dexterity, tier 2 health, and tier 2 endurance.

The rolls of the affixes within their tiers are preserved regardless of whether their tiers change.

Cannot result in all the affixes having the same tiers as before, and cannot be used on items where all the non-sealed affixes have the same tier.

</font><color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Randomly changes the exalted affixes on an item into different affixes. Does not change the tiers of the affixes or the rolls within the tiers.<font="Caladea SDF"><color=#B4AD99>

Affixes can only be changed to ones that can spawn on this item type when dropped from a regular enemy.

Sealed affixes are unaffected.

</font><color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

Evolves an exalted item into a Primordial exalted item, upgrading a random tier 7 affix on the item into a tier 8 affix, massively increasing the affix''s power and moving it to its own second sealed affix slot. The affix cannot be modified further.

Can only be used on an exalted item with at least one tier 7 affix, and no tier 8 affix.

You can only have one Primordial Item equipped at a time.

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

Corrupts an item, changing it unpredictably and preventing it from being crafted further. The item may no longer be usable after it is corrupted.
Removes all forging potential, legendary potential, weaver''s will, and weaver''s touch from the item.
<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>
Item_Names.Item_SubType_Description_103_:
<color=#fff>Modifies the outcome of a craft, granting it a 25% chance to have no forging potential cost.

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Modifies the outcome of a craft when upgrading an affix.

Randomly changes the upgraded affix to a different one that can spawn on that item type. It cannot change a prefix into a suffix or vice versa.

For example if you use a fire resistance shard to a raise the tier of a fire resistance suffix the tier would increase as normal and then it would change into a different affix such as cold resistance or increased health.

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Modifies the outcome of a craft when upgrading an affix.

Prevents the roll of an affix within its range changing when it is upgraded.

<color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Has a chance to seal an affix instead of upgrading it. The sealed affix is moved to its own slot, leaving its old slot open for you to add a new affix.<font="Caladea SDF"><color=#B4AD99>

The sealed affix cannot be modified further and an item can have a maximum of one sealed affix.

Chance to seal is higher when crafting on affixes of lower tiers, and is also higher for exalted items and items with more affixes.

</font><color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

<color=#fff>Changes a prefix into an experimental affix.

Only works on gloves, boots, and belts, and does not work if the item already has an experimental affix.<font="Caladea SDF"><color=#B4AD99>

The exact experimental affix it becomes and its tier are determined by the properties of the item.

Which properties determine the affix and what is required for higher tiers can be discerned through experimenting and carefully studying the numbers of the items you experiment on.

</font><color=#999>Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.</color>

Changes the item''s subtype to a different one with the same class requirement when adding or upgrading an affix. Cannot change the item type or result in drop-restricted subtypes. For example, a Raptor Helm could become a Tusked Greathelm, but it could not become an Arcane Visage or a Silver Ring. Can result in a higher level than you can currently equip. Press [F] to open the Crafting Panel.
