Item_Names.Item_SubType_Description_107_: Contains many Rune Prisons
A temple from a forgotten timeline, filled with shrines.
Lost caches abound in this graveyard of wrecked vessels.
Confront multiple Nemeses to scale the tower.

Confront Majasa among the testaments to her avarice. Quell her rage and claim her riches.

Always drops a unique piece of jewelry.
An Altar of the Weaver atop a woven tower

Duel a sequence of empowered bosses and their champions.

Once the last enemy has fallen, it will drop two copies of the same random unique item, and you will gain access to the Sacrificial Altar. Here you can sacrifice one copy of a unique item to reroll the properties of another copy of the same unique item.
A free for all between champions of the arena.

The Pillar of Skulls rises high above the Soulfire Bastion. It is here that the Lich Cremorus used soul embers to resurrect champions of ages past and ages yet to come. Stand atop the pillar and slay all champions that would rise to oppose you.

Slay Haruspex Orian, Seeker of the Shards, upon the summit of his warcamp.

Always drops a unique melee weapon.

Slay enemies to collect as many soul embers as you can before the time runs out. Then spend soul embers at the Soul Gambler.

The first item purchased is always a unique.

Travel back to the ancient era and destroy whatever created the antipode rift.

Always drops a unique piece of armor.

Destroy the Draal Queen deep beneath the Stonefall Mountains.

Always drops a unique ranged or caster weapon.

Slay the roaming Fateweavers among the trails and woven halls to scatter The Weaver''s followers across the surrounding echoes.

Packs of The Weaver''s followers in those echoes are more powerful, but drop large amounts of memory amber.
Break through the fortifications along the great bridge to gain access to the Forge of Fates where you can shatter your set items to reforge them.
Help the denizens of the graveyard repel the invasive plants.

Defeat a Shade of Orobyss of each type to reset this timeline''s web of echoes and gain corruption based on the highest corruption reached in any timeline by any character with access to the same stash as this one.

Upon the threshold Aberroth awaits.

Corruption and Echo Modifiers have no effect here.
Wade through the bloodsoaked halls to confront the Baroness.
Brawl with beer in the brewery and emerge victorious to claim the Brewmaster''s Buckle.

Defend the turtle of enormous girth as it transports the Transmuting Gem.

Once the attackers are defeated you can harness the gem''s power to reweave the fate of your unique items that have legendary potential, either increasing it or decreasing it. The new legendary potential is rolled the same way as the legendary potential of a freshly dropped unique of that type. As such, for most uniques it is mostly likely to change the legendary potential to 0.
Destroy the Vessel of Chaos in this echo to reroll the rewards of nearby uncompleted echoes.

Destroy the Vessel of Memory in this echo to restore nearby completed echoes to their original states, allowing you to complete them again and claim their rewards for a second time.

Woven Echoes and echoes containing Vessels of Memory or Vessels of Chaos are unaffected.

A runemaster fortress from which Rune Prisons are temporally displaced, and the arcane experiments they created are sealed away.

Defeat the wardens to lower the barrier around the Thaumaturgy Device and craft your own experimental items.

Time travel between the abandoned tower in the Divine Era and the refortified Lich''s abode in the Imperial Era.

Defeat both the Osprix and Imperial forces to control the Relic of the Oberserver and alter the fate of your items. The Relic allows you to swap between strength, intelligence, dexterity, and attunement affixes on your items.
A Cemetery of the Erased where woven echoes can be exchanged for others, once the Woven Firstborn has been slain.
Delve into a vast Tomb of the Erased and defeat the Fateweavers to claim the echo specific rewards of all surrounding echoes.
Descend into a labyrinthine Tomb of the Erased and defeat the Ascendant Firstborn to weave new Tombs of the Erased into all surrounding echoes.

Duel a Harbinger that has already slain the boss of this timeline, and claim its spoils.

It drops the same items as it would have had you slain it right after defeating the timeline boss.

Travel to the brink of the black hole, to the end of all timelines that Orobyss has erased. There confront a sequence of Harbingers who have slain the bosses of those timelines and reclaim the treasures they stole.
Charge the Great Beacon in this echo to reveal echoes in a large area around it.

Before he vanished, the Barnacle King stashed his treasure in a hidden vault deep beneath the ground. Search for the lost vault within the caverns and altruistically free the overburdened lizards locked within the caches.

Venture into the eastern fortress long since broken and defiled by the Harbingers. Disturb the remains of its defenders to confront the Void Nemesis and destroy it.

Completing this echo permanently adds the void nemesis to the pool of nemeses you may encounter and improves the chance for rare and exalted items'' affixes to become exalted when empowering a nemesis.
Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Primalist.
Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Mage.
Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Sentinel.
Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Acolyte.
Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Rogue.
Slay a pack of randomly evolved Rift Beasts Champions to retrieve the Primordial Exalted Items they guard, each of which has a Primordial Champion Affix.

Protect the Rift Beast Nests to spread Rift Beast encounters to surrounding echoes.

Cannot add Rift Beast Encounters to Arena Echoes, Woven Echoes, or Cemeteries of the Erased. Only applies to the first attempt at each echo.
Slay a rampantly evolved Rift Beast with a crystallised heart to unlock the ability to evolve your own rift beast Lineages beyond the normal limit.

Travel to the veil between worlds, where Omens gather. Defeat them to seize control over their influence of the timeline, and attract Omens to surrounding echoes.

Shatter their plans completely and you may ascend to the pinnacle of their power.
Clear the Fractured Prison

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_185: Studying at the great colleges of Welryn and Vul''Kaur, Vilatria perfected the art of Storm Magic. Yet a scholarly life never sated her ambition and she returned to the Lake kingdoms of central Eterra. Without a god to lead them, their lords and elders were proud and open to challenges of force. With the college of Welryn on their doorsteps, they were not unprepared for arcane challengers, but their wards could not protect them from the lightning that tore threw the roofs of their halls and smote them in their thrones, and so Vilatria claimed their kingdoms by force.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_186: In her old age, Vilatria''s hubris only grew. Having defeated all her human challengers, the storm queen''s mind turned to Lagon, the fabled god of the sea and storms. With her apprentice, she sailed out from the border town of Etendell, along the estuary and out into the Fogrise sea. Lagon was said to dwell beneath the far seas beyond the western isles, yet the journey was quick for Vilatria as she fuelled her sails with winds of magic. Eventually she alighted at night upon a great isle of rock, coral, and ancient shrines. The moon spoke to her from its reflection flickering on the surface of the sea. It spoke with the voice of Lagon, and it spoke with amusement at her challenge, readily accepting, and opening the heavens. Thousands of years have passed and Vilatria is long dead, and her kingdom fractured, but the storms still rage upon the seas around that isle.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_187: A critical success, a critical failure... It''s all in the coin toss.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_188: The nagasa of the Scorched Basin always warned merchants to disregard the false oasis on the long road to Keltha, but Azurral had never put much heed in the snake people''s superstition and his thirst overcame him. He drew deep from the blood red waters. The next day he awoke to his caravan reduced to ash upon the sand and his sword burning hot in his hand.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_198: Heed not the cowards that fight from the safety of range, or the generals that sit in their camps while their soldiers'' blood spills. Face your foes with honour, a shield, and a good blade.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_199: When fire falls in love with the wind, run.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_200: Litugy in darkness leads only to despair, poison on the tongue beguiles the soul, truth in unwords reveals salvation.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_201: In times of strife the inflexible are doomed to break. A true Battlemage must master all the arts of war.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_202: The roar of thunder above the frozen seas has long inspired stories among the nomads of great white bears that prowl the ice beneath the storms.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_203: Decades after the rest of civilisation hid itself beneath the ground, the last of the void knights still roamed the ruined surface, searching relentlessly for a way to turn the power of the void against itself. Their discoveries remain with them, lost amidst the shadows.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_204: After making peace with the nagasa, Lord Berant of Skalnir was impatient to secure his legacy and so turned his eyes to an easier conquest. The Verdant Isle was small and his scouts assured him that its druid inhabitants had no weapons. But when his soldiers returned from the sacred island, they brought back only their thorn pierced fallen and tales of vine strangled ships.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_205: The last imperial dwelt for centuries beneath Welryn, bound by his own sanctuary to witness the ruin of this world.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_206: "Stay quick on your feet. Don''t get hit once, but if you do get hit once, don''t get hit twice" - Dar''Fuun, Scalebane Recruiter.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_207: Overseer Nicovus had little patience for the traditional mining techniques of his living predecessors. The empire would delve deep and it would delve fast.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_208: A pair of mimic brothers, lost in the ravenous void, hungry for anyone who dips their hands inside.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_211: Argentus may have been born a mere slave of Rahyeh, but his ambition eclipsed even his god.

A frail sun rises behind an illuminable shadow, spreading a corona of half light upon the ruined world beneath. This feeble shadow is no salvation from the end, but only from the hope of what might have been.

Yet a wild storm needs no reason to strike where it does and the inscrutable stones were dismissed by later storm priests, who claimed it did not befit surface dwellers to decipher their god''s purposes or designs.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_226: Matron Tu''rani is still revered amongst the nagasa for leading the first successful campaign against the Osprix. Striking them out of the sky with javelins and thunderbolts, she drove them back into the Mountains of the Sun, liberating the town of Kel''tha.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_227: When Ferebor''s collection of totems grew too large, he gathered his creations in a cave while his fellow nomads moved on without him. As the winters passed and his collection grew, other nomads would visit him to trade food and furs for totems crafted to defend their tribes.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_228: Fifty winters since they first parted, Ferebor''s tribe returned to his cave eager to purchase another totem. However, instead of finding the storied totem carver, they were driven away by his creations. Assuming him dead, they paid their respects and moved on, yet the number of totems around the cave continued to grow. Some say Ferebor still dwells there, cut off from the outside but carving totem after totem among the shadows.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_229: Root yourself into the cold earth and drink deep from Eterra''s bounty.

She had at first seemed more civilised than the average Wengari, carrying a giant sword instead of a crude axe or club. Nevertheless she proved particularly difficult to reason with on account of her propensity to devour their envoys.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_280: Fascinated by mirages, Telf''un long wandered the deserts, telescope in hand. Even after decades of study and delirium he failed to truly comprehend their nature, but eventually the mirages took pity on the old man and turned him into one of their own.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_283: The witches of the Red Marsh learned to cultivate a type of magical fungus within their own skulls. The mycelium grew eagerly into their brains, twisting their minds, but the powers it bestowed were well worth their sanity.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_285: Jelkhor was once the greatest archer and artificer in all of Majasa''s domain. Eventually the diamond matrons grew fearful of his popularity among the human populace, and so they accused him of a terrible crime and had his left hand severed, so that he could no longer wield a bow. Though disgraced and outcast, Jelkhor''s resolve remained and his ingenuity gave him the tools he needed to deliver his revenge.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_286: When the scholars of Vul''Kaur realised the artifact''s power, they shattered it immediately and told not even Majasa of their discovery.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_288: Above the skies the natural and the arcane are one.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_289: The streets of Maj''elka engender no love for authority
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_290: "The gods serve only themselves, foolish mortals. They will not protect you. If you wish to survive, you must forge your own sanctuary."
Item_Names.Unique_Tooltip_0_290: Health Leech is disabled for 4 seconds when you directly cast a Spell
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_291: The mercenary guilds of Skalnir care naught for the destruction they leave in their wake, as long as their pay is fair and they can take a cut of the spoils.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_292: Formosus knew not what cause these warriors had fought for, or what ancient conflict left their bodies frozen upon the outer ice. But, as he felt the rage and power of their lingering souls he knew well what purpose they would now fulfill.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_293: "Cities, memories, whole timelines have been erased by the spreading void. There is much work ahead of us." - The Acolyte of Golden Silk
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_294: "For those who have lost everything, The Weaver''s bounty knows no end."  - The Acolyte of Golden Silk
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_295: "Rest now, you are safe here in this cocoon. It''s all gone now, but this is not where your thread ends." - The Acolyte of Golden Silk
Item_Names.Unique_Tooltip_0_295: Gain a stack of Golden Aegis each second
Item_Names.Unique_Tooltip_1_295: Lose a stack of Golden Aegis on Block
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_296: "Those long lost may walk again on woven feet" - The Acolyte of Golden Silk

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_297: "A protector of wilds long lost shall now serve a greater purpose" - The Acolyte of Golden Silk
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_298: "Such insight wasted on a lost timeline. It is for naught now, but it proves thy worth." - The Acolyte of Golden Silk

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_299: "Memories of past honour that befits the woven form" - The Acolyte of Golden Silk
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_300: "The context of thy aspirations is long lost, yet they still pervade thy silken form." - The Acolyte of Golden Silk

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_301: "It is no accident that you have outlasted your world, but belief in one''s own luck is a powerful tool." - The Acolyte of Golden Silk

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_302: Dark clouds roll in from the Sea of the Storms
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_303: "The cycle of life and death is forever shattered. Our cities shall not crumble and our citizens shall not yield or die at the whims of a winged devil. We shall persist. Our bodies may whither and decay, but even when we fall we return and persist again. Glory to the new cycle. Glory to persistence and decay. Glory to humanity." - Thelocus, Imperial Governor of Argentum

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_304: The carapace of a meruna storm ogre makes for an impressive trophy, and an effective cuirass.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_305: "I have long travelled the north, Aergon. I have seen the great stone ruins at Reimhaven and Kolheim and I have seen the frozen blood of their ancient defenders. No tower can stand forever and those walls shall not avail you when the flames descends. You must strike first." - Reowyn''s last letter to the mages of Oerden''s Watch.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_306: Fleeing does not stem the flow
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_307: In the waning years of his reign Lord Drelkor forbade the mages of Welryn from focusing their studies on any single element, lest their research lead them to aligning with forces beyond his domain.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_308: "Runes provide order to magic, a way to shape it, harness it, and use it for one''s will. Follow their structure and you shall remain in control, break it and you shall loose the madness between the lines." - Arch Runemaster Unvar to the college of Kolheim.

Item_Names.Unique_Lore_312: Deep within her research of Geometromancy, Runemaster Heraclea was surprised to discover a shape that behaved as if it had many heads.
Item_Names.Unique_Lore_313: Discard freely the paths not taken. They are only distractions from deeper knowledge.

Properties.Property_Master_Ailment Chanc: For skills which have less chance to apply ailments on hit, nodes within that skill''s tree always grant the stated amount, unaffected by that less chance modifier.
Properties.Property_Master_Attack Speed_: Increases the number of attacks you can use per second
Properties.Property_Master_Cast Speed_Al: Increases the number of spells you can cast per second
Properties.Property_Master_Critical Stri: Increases your chance to deal a critical strike. Your base crit chance is 5% so 100% increased crit chance would give you 10% crit chance if there are no other modifiers.
Increases the damage dealt by your critical strikes
Properties.Property_Master_Movement Spee: Increases how quickly you can run
Properties.Property_Master_Armor_AltText: Armor reduces the damage you take from all hits, but not damage over time. More effective against physical damage.
Properties.Property_Master_Stun Avoidanc: All hits can have a chance to stun you based on their damage. Stun Avoidance reduces that chance.
Properties.Property_Master_Fire Resistan: Reduces all fire damage you take. Capped at 75%.
Properties.Property_Master_Cold Resistan: Reduces all cold damage you take. Capped at 75%.
Properties.Property_Master_Lightning Res: Reduces all lightning damage you take. Capped at 75%.
Properties.Property_Master_Ward Retentio: Ward is decaying shield with no limit, that steadily decays. Ward retention reduces the rate at which your ward decays.
Properties.Property_Master_Health Regen_: Increases the rate at which your health regenerates over time
Properties.Property_Master_Mana Regen_Al: Increases the rate at which your mana regenerates over time
Properties.Property_Master_Strength_AltT: Each point of strength increases armor by 4% and improves skills that rely the raw strength of you and your companions
Properties.Property_Master_Vitality_AltT: Each point of vitality grants 6 health and 1% poison and necrotic resistance.
Properties.Property_Master_Intelligence_: Each point of intelligence grants 2% ward retention and improves skills that rely on carefully studied magic
Properties.Property_Master_Dexterity_Alt: Each point of dexterity adds 4 dodge rating and improves skills that rely on the skillful handling of weapons
Properties.Property_Master_Attunement_Al: Each point of attunement grants 2 mana and improves skills that rely on the innate magic inside you and your surroundings
Properties.Property_Master_Damage Dealt: Damage Dealt to Mana Before Health
A percentage of the damage you take is dealt to your mana instead of your health. Each point of mana shields 5 health.
Properties.Property_Master_Channel Cost_: Modifies the mana cost per second of channelled skills
Properties.Property_Master_Void Resistan: Reduces all void damage you take. Capped at 75%.
Properties.Property_Master_Necrotic Resi: Reduces all necrotic damage you take. Capped at 75%.
Properties.Property_Master_Poison Resist: Reduces all poison damage you take. Capped at 75%.
Properties.Property_Master_Block Chance_: Adds to your chance to block. Blocked hits deal less damage depending on your block effectiveness.
Properties.Property_Master_All Resistanc: Adds to your physical, fire, cold, lightning, necrotic, void, and poison resistances.
Properties.Property_Master_Ward Gain_Alt: Instantly gain ward. Ward is a temporary shield that decays over time based on the amount you currently have.
Properties.Property_Master_Adaptive Spel: Adds damage to all spells. The type of damage added matches the base damage of the spell.
Properties.Property_Master_Increased Ail: Increases the duration of ailments you inflict
Increases the effect of ailments you inflict
Properties.Property_Master_Increased Hea: Increases the health restored by healing skills
Properties.Property_Master_Increased Stu: All your hits have a chance to stun if they deal enough damage. Increased stun chance increases that chance.
Properties.Property_Master_All Attribute: Adds to your Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Attunement, and Vitality.
Properties.Property_Master_Increased Cha: Increases your chance to find potions. Potions are displayed next to your health globe, and can be consumed to gain health (by using the 1 key by default).
Properties.Property_Master_Health Gained: Potions are displayed next to your health globe, and can be consumed to gain health (by using the 1 key by default).
Properties.Property_Master_Potion Slots_: Adds to your maximum number of potions. Potions are displayed next to your health globe, and can be consumed to gain health (by using the 1 key by default).
Properties.Property_Master_Damage Leeche: A percentage of your damage is returned to you as health over three seconds.
Properties.Property_Master_Elemental Res: Adds to your fire, cold, and lightning resistances.
Properties.Property_Master_Block Effecti: Block Effectiveness reduces damage taken for hits you block.
Properties.Property_Master_Increased Stu: By default when you are stunned you become immune to stuns for one second after the stun ends. This increases the duration of that immunity.
Properties.Property_Master_Dark Protecti: Protects against void, poison, and necrotic damage. 10 dark protection is like 10 effective health against void, poison, or necrotic damage.
Properties.Property_Master_Penetration_A: Penetration can reduce effective resistance below 0%, increasing damage even against enemies with no resistance. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.
Properties.Property_Master_Chance to rec: Chance to receive a Glancing Blow when hit
Grants a chance to recieve a glancing blow when hit. Glancing blows deal 35% less damage.
Properties.Property_Master_Mana Cost_Alt: Modifies the cost of skills you use
Properties.Property_Master_Freeze Rate M: Cold skills have a chance to freeze on hit equal to their freeze rate divided by the target''s health.
Properties.Property_Master_Mana Efficien:
Increases the efficiency of your mana usage
Mana cost = base mana cost / (1 + mana efficiency)
Properties.Property_Master_Increased Coo: Increases the speed at which your skills come off cooldown
Properties.Property_Master_Physical Resi: Reduces all physical damage you take. Capped at 75%.
Properties.Property_Master_Current Healt: Drains a percent of your current health per second. You can''t die from this effect
Properties.Property_Master_Cull on Hit_A: Enemies are killed at this percentage of their health

Properties.Property_Master_Chance to gai: Chance to gain Haste for 1 second on Hit
Haste is a buff that grants 30% increased movement speed. Haste does not stack.
Properties.Property_Master_Chance to Chi: Gives you a chance to chill enemies when they hit you. Chill reduces attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed by 12% (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts 4 seconds. It can stack up to 3 times and is 50% less effective against Players.
Properties.Property_Master_Chance to Slo: Gives you a chance to slow enemies when they hit you. Each stack of Slow reduces movement speed by 20% (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts 4 seconds. It can stacks up to 3 times and is 50% less effective against Players.
Properties.Property_Master_Damage Reflec: Damage is dealt directly to attackers when you take a hit. Not affected by enemy defenses.
A percentage of the damage you take is dealt directly to the attacker. Mitigation applies before reflection. Reflecting damage does not affect how much damage you take.
Properties.Property_Master_Chance to Sho: Gives you a chance to shock enemies when they hit you. Shock reduces lightning resistance by 5%, increases chance to be stunned by 20%, lasts 4 seconds, and can stack up to 10 times. It has 60% reduced effect against bosses and players.
Properties.Property_Master_Critical Stri: Gives a chance to downgrade an enemy''s crit on you to a regular hit. Unmodified enemies have a 5% crit chance.
Properties.Property_Master_Potion Health: A percentage of the health you would gain from using a potion is gained as ward instead. There is no effect above 100%.
Properties.Property_Master_Ward Gained o: Ward is a decaying shield that protects your health
Properties.Property_Master_Overkill Dama: When you kill an enemy with a hit a percentage of the excess damage is returned to you as health over three seconds.
Properties.Property_Master_Ward per Seco: Causes you to generate ward over time. Ward naturally decays over time so your total ward will stabilize at a point where the regen is equal to the decay.
Properties.Property_Master_Damage Dealt: Damage Dealt to Mana Before Health or Ward
A percentage of the damage you take is dealt to your mana instead of your health or ward. Each point of mana shields 5 health.
Properties.Property_Master_Increased Stu: Increases the duration of stuns you inflict
Properties.Property_Master_Duration of S: Reduces the duration of stuns on you
Properties.Property_Master_Chance to Gai: Chance to Gain 30 Ward when Hit
Ward is a decaying overshield that protect your health. Extra chance above 100% has no effect. Applies after damage taken, unless the damage would be lethal.
Properties.Property_Master_Mana Spent Ga: Ward is a decaying overshield that protect your health. Only affects mana spent, not mana drained.
Properties.Property_Master_Increased Lee: Increases the speed at which health is gained from Health Leech. Does not change the total amount leeched.
Properties.Property_Master_Freeze Rate p: Freeze Rate per stack of Chill
Increases your chance to freeze for each stack of chill on the target. Multiplicative with other modifiers.
Properties.Property_Master_Physical and: Adds to your physical and void resistances.
Properties.Property_Master_Necrotic and: Adds to your necrotic and poison resistances.
Properties.Property_Master_Chance to Rec: Chance to Receive a Critical Strike
Adds to your chance to receive a critical strike when hit. Not affected by the attacker''s increased critical strike chance.
Properties.Property_Master_Endurance_Alt: Endurance reduces damage dealt to your health below your Endurance Threshold. Capped at 60%.
Properties.Property_Master_Endurance Thr: Damage dealt to your health below your Endurance Threshold is reduced by your Endurance
Properties.Property_Master_Maximum Healt: Maximum Health gained as Endurance Threshold
Gain a portion of your maximum health as endurance threshold. Damage taken your health below your endurance threshold is reduced by your endurance.
Properties.Property_Master_reduced Bonus: reduced Bonus Damage Taken from Critical Strikes
Reduces the bonus damage taken from crits. Cannot reduce damage below that of a regular hit. This stat is multiplicative with other damage modifiers, but multiple sources of this stat are additive.
Properties.Property_Master_More Damage P: Counts stacks on the Target. Multiplicative with other modifiers.
Properties.Property_Master_increased Are: Increases the area of effect of skills with the Area tag. Additive with other sources of increased area.
Properties.Property_Master_Armor Mitigat: Armor Mitigation also applies to Damage over Time
For example, if you have enough armor to reduce hit damage by 60% and 50% of your Armor Mitigation also applies to Damage over Time then armor will reduce damage over time by 30%.
Properties.Property_Master_Ward Decay Th: Ward does not decay below your Ward Decay Threshold and ward below the threshold does not contribute to decay rate. For example if you have a Ward Decay Threshold of 500 then ward will not decay below 500 and ward decay rate at 1000 ward will be halved.
Properties.Property_Master_Parry Chance_: Parrying a hit reduces the hit damage taken to zero. It does not prevent other effects of the hit. Parry Chance has no effect on damage over time and is capped at 75%. Parried hits cannot also be blocked and cannot be glancing blows.
Properties.Property_Master_Lens_AltText:
Increases your chance to see certain prophecies in the observatory.

Lenses that block activities or increase the cost of prophecies do not stack.
Properties.Property_Master_Chance to Cas: If the ability has a cooldown, it must be on your bar and off cooldown, and this effect puts it on cooldown.

Applies to all damage dealt by the attack, not just the damage of the initial hit.

Skills.Skill_kn-1_111_PointBonusDescript: You gain additional critical strike multiplier, scaling with your Strength, while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

You have a chance to cast a shield from '{'Ring of Shields'}' when you block a hit and you have additional block effectiveness per shield from '{'Ring of Shields'}'.

Additionally, your minions have increased health and armor.
Skills.Skill_kn-1_35_0_Stat: Chance To Cast Shield On Block
Skills.Skill_kn-1_35_AltText: This does not put Ring of Shields on cooldown if you have it equipped.

Skills.Skill_kn-1_84_Description: Your hits have a chance to ignite.

Skills.Skill_kn-1_83_AltText: Increased healing effectiveness increases the health restored by healing skills only.

Skills.Skill_kn-1_96_Description:
You have a chance to be granted a '{'Divine Essence'}' each second while at high health (above 65% of max health).

Divine Essences last 10 seconds and grant 15% increased armor and healing effectiveness. They also reduce damage over time you take by 5%.

You can have a maximum of 3 Divine Essences at once.
Skills.Skill_kn-1_96_1_Stat: Divine Essence Chance Per Second On High Health
Skills.Skill_kn-1_96_AltText: Heal over time effects cannot grant a Divine Essence.

UI.Class_Acolyte_Description: A rebellious scion who disobeyed her masters to seek out forbidden magic, the Acolyte will let nothing stop her from becoming more powerful.
UI.Mastery_Necromancer_Description: A commander of undeath, they send their animated thralls to battle perfectly willing to sacrifice them as they deem fit.

UI.PassiveTree_Panel_LichBonus2_Label: Spells and Melee attacks deal increased damage equal to your missing Health

UI.PassiveTree_Panel_WarlockBonus1_Label: 4% more damage per curse on the target
UI.Mastery_Warlock_Description: A master of the forbidden arts, they tear into the essence of their foes, corrupting their spirits with relentless curses, necrotic magic and flames to burn their flesh.
UI.Class_Mage_Description: An Elder cresting his prime, the Mage wields the power of the arcane to make up for his past wrongs and to give the world a new future.

UI.Mastery_Sorcerer_Description: A master of the arcane who wields unprecedented power to devastate their foes from a distance.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_SpellbladeBonus1_La: 12 ward gained on melee use and hit at least one enemy
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_SpellbladeBonus2_La: 40% of added melee damage on weapons is also gained as added spell damage
UI.Mastery_Spellblade_Description: A mage who has mixed martial prowess and cunning with their mastery of spells to face enemies in close range.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_Runemaster2_Label: 10% increased Cast Speed with Elemental Spells
UI.MasteryPanel_Runemaster_Description: A savant of the art of runes, able to infuse magic into offensive and protective wards that devastate those who trespass them.
UI.Class_Primalist_Description: A warrior from the north who has seen the horrors of war first hand, the Primalist seeks communion with the power of Eterra, the power of the earth.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_BeastmasterBonus2_L: You and your minions deal 50% increased melee damage
UI.Mastery_Beastmaster_Description: You are the master of the wilds and the beasts that dwell within. The heart of the wild beats within you, its fury leading your way.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_ShamanBonus3_Label: +50% elemental resistance while you control a totem
UI.Mastery_Shaman_Description: Your strikes bear power, avalanches that shatter mountainsides, the lightning that cracks the sky open. You are the storm.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_DruidBonus1_Label: When leaving a transformed state, you gain 70% damage reduction for 2 seconds
UI.Mastery_Druid_Description: You are the avatar of the latent power of the earth. Your form malleable to that power, Eterra''s bastion against all that would threaten her.
UI.Class_Rogue_Description: Unrivaled in bow and blade, the rogue strikes out from the shadows to find a higher purpose for her deadly talents.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_BladedancerBonus3_L: 15% more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers)
UI.Mastery_Bladedancer_Description: An artisan of shadows, they dash in and out of the reach of their enemies, each movement another deadly cut.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_MarksmanBonus1_Labe: Bow Mastery: Using a bow attack grants 5% increased attack speed. Can stack 5 times. All stacks fall off after if you have not used a bow attack recently.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_MarksmanBonus2_Labe: Bow Mastery: 50% increased damage while using a bow.
UI.Mastery_Marksman_Description: A master of the bow, adept at engaging foes from a distance and keeping them there.
UI.Mastery_Falconer_Description: A master tactician who employs deceptive traps and a fearsome bird of prey to gain an advantage against her enemies.
UI.Class_Sentinel_Description: A former soldier of Rahyeh’s army who left their ranks to pursue a more noble path.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_VoidKnightBonus1_La: You gain 1% more melee void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 3 Vitality.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_VoidKnightBonus2_La: Your melee attacks, throwing attacks and void spells have a 10% chance to be repeated by an echo 0.5s later (excludes movement abilities and Anomaly).
UI.Mastery_VoidKnight_Description: A fallen knight who has taken part of the void inside themselves and uses it to devastate their foes even at the cost of their own life.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_ForgeGuardBonus2_La: You gain a stack of Stalwart when hit. Stalwart grants 5% increased armor, lasts 10 seconds, and stacks up to 10 times.
UI.Mastery_Forge_Guard_Description: A bulwark of strength and steel whose mastery of weapons, armor, and the animation of molten metal dominates the battlefield.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_PaladinBonus1_Label: You deal 1.5% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10% remaining health, up to 15% more damage at full heath.
UI.PassiveTree_Panel_PaladinBonus2_Label: 1% increased healing effectiveness per point of attunement
UI.Mastery_Paladin_Description: You are a righteous warrior, your conviction empowering your allies and burning away the dark with righteous fire.

Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio: Contains many Rune Prisons
A temple from a forgotten timeline, filled with shrines.
Lost caches abound in this graveyard of wrecked vessels.
Confront multiple Nemeses to scale the tower.
MonolithObjectives.Monolith_Objective_Wo: Defeat or Banish the Nemesis on each floor to scale the tower
Ascend to the roof and destroy Vengeance Incarnate
Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio:
Confront Majasa among the testaments to her avarice. Quell her rage and claim her riches.

Always drops a unique piece of jewelry.
An Altar of the Weaver atop a woven tower

Duel a sequence of empowered bosses and their champions.


Once the last enemy has fallen, it will drop two copies of the same random unique item, and you will gain access to the Sacrificial Altar. Here you can sacrifice one copy of a unique item to reroll the properties of another copy of the same unique item.
MonolithObjectives.Monolith_Objective_Wo: Slay all 7 bosses and their champions
A new champion spawns each time you defeat a boss
Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio: A free for all between champions of the arena.

The Pillar of Skulls rises high above the Soulfire Bastion. It is here that the Lich Cremorus used soul embers to resurrect champions of ages past and ages yet to come. Stand atop the pillar and slay all champions that would rise to oppose you.

Slay Haruspex Orian, Seeker of the Shards, upon the summit of his warcamp.

Always drops a unique melee weapon.

Slay enemies to collect as many soul embers as you can before the time runs out. Then spend soul embers at the Soul Gambler.

The first item purchased is always a unique.
MonolithObjectives.Monolith_Objective_Wo: Bonus stability increases over time. You will be transported once it is full.
Spend Soul Embers at the Soul Gambler. The first purchase is always a unique.
Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio:
Travel back to the ancient era and destroy whatever created the antipode rift.

Always drops a unique piece of armor.

Destroy the Draal Queen deep beneath the Stonefall Mountains.

Always drops a unique ranged or caster weapon.

Slay the roaming Fateweavers among the trails and woven halls to scatter The Weaver''s followers across the surrounding echoes.

Packs of The Weaver''s followers in those echoes are more powerful, but drop large amounts of memory amber.
Break through the fortifications along the great bridge to gain access to the Forge of Fates where you can shatter your set items to reforge them.
MonolithObjectives.Monolith_Objective_Wo: Slay the Osprix guarding the Forge of Fates
Use the Forge of Fates to shatter Set Items

Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio: Defeat a Shade of Orobyss of each type to reset this timeline''s web of echoes and gain corruption based on the highest corruption reached in any timeline by any character with access to the same stash as this one.
Upon the threshold Aberroth awaits.
Wade through the bloodsoaked halls to confront the Baroness.
Brawl with beer in the brewery and emerge victorious to claim the Brewmaster''s Buckle.

Defend the turtle of enormous girth as it transports the Transmuting Gem.

Once the attackers are defeated you can harness the gem''s power to reweave the fate of your unique items that have legendary potential, either increasing it or decreasing it. The new legendary potential is rolled the same way as the legendary potential of a freshly dropped unique of that type. As such, for most uniques it is mostly likely to change the legendary potential to 0.
Destroy the Vessel of Chaos in this echo to reroll the rewards of nearby uncompleted echoes.

Destroy the Vessel of Memory in this echo to restore nearby completed echoes to their original states, allowing you to complete them again and claim their rewards for a second time.

Woven Echoes and echoes containing Vessels of Memory or Vessels of Chaos are unaffected.

A runemaster fortress from which Rune Prisons are temporally displaced, and the arcane experiments they created are sealed away.

Defeat the wardens to lower the barrier around the Thaumaturgy Device and craft your own experimental items.

Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio:
Time travel between the abandoned tower in the Divine Era and the refortified Lich''s abode in the Imperial Era.

Defeat both the Osprix and Imperial forces to control the Relic of the Oberserver and alter the fate of your items. The Relic allows you to swap between strength, intelligence, dexterity, and attunement affixes on your items.
MonolithObjectives.Monolith_Objective_Wo: Repel the Osprix and Imperial Forces from the Relic
Use your Temporal Rift Ability to travel between eras
Champions in either era prevent progress
Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio: A Cemetery of the Erased where woven echoes can be exchanged for others, once the Woven Firstborn has been slain.
Delve into a vast Tomb of the Erased and defeat the Fateweavers to claim the echo specific rewards of all surrounding echoes.
MonolithObjectives.Monolith_Objective_Wo: Find and slay the Fate Weavers
Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio: Descend into a labyrinthine Tomb of the Erased and defeat the Ascendant Firstborn to weave new Tombs of the Erased into all surrounding echoes.
MonolithObjectives.Monolith_Objective_Wo: Find and slay the Ascendant Firstborn
Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio:
Duel a Harbinger that has already slain the boss of this timeline, and claim its spoils.

It drops the same items as it would have had you slain it right after defeating the timeline boss.

Travel to the brink of the black hole, to the end of all timelines that Orobyss has erased. There confront a sequence of Harbingers who have slain the bosses of those timelines and reclaim the treasures they stole.
Charge the Great Beacon in this echo to reveal echoes in a large area around it.

Before he vanished, the Barnacle King stashed his treasure in a hidden vault deep beneath the ground. Search for the lost vault within the caverns and altruistically free the overburdened lizards locked within the caches.

Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio:
Venture into the eastern fortress long since broken and defiled by the Harbingers. Disturb the remains of its defenders to confront the Void Nemesis and destroy it.

Completing this echo permanently adds the void nemesis to the pool of nemeses you may encounter and improves the chance for rare and exalted items'' affixes to become exalted when empowering a nemesis.
Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Primalist.
Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Mage.
Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Sentinel.
Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Acolyte.
Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Rogue.
Slay a pack of randomly evolved Rift Beasts Champions to retrieve the Primordial Exalted Items they guard, each of which has a Primordial Champion Affix.

Protect the Rift Beast Nests to spread Rift Beast encounters to surrounding echoes.

Cannot add Rift Beast Encounters to Arena Echoes, Woven Echoes, or Cemeteries of the Erased. Only applies to the first attempt at each echo.
MonolithObjectives.Monolith_Objective_Wo: Find and protect the Western Rift Beast Nest
Find and protect the Central Rift Beast Nest
Find and protect the Northern Rift Beast Nest
Find and protect the Eastern Rift Beast Nest
Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio: Slay a rampantly evolved Rift Beast with a crystallised heart to unlock the ability to evolve your own rift beast Lineages beyond the normal limit.

Travel to the veil between worlds, where Omens gather. Defeat them to seize control over their influence of the timeline, and attract Omens to surrounding echoes.

Shatter their plans completely and you may ascend to the pinnacle of their power.
MonolithObjectives.Monolith_Objective_Wo: Clear all three Omen encounters at once
Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio: The Observer''s vision of himself begins to coalesce. The Omens must be stopped.
MonolithObjectives.Monolith_Objective_Wo: Defeat the Omens and the Vision of the Observer
Monolith_Timelines.Woven_Echo_Descriptio: Discover the Rift within the ancient valley and slay the Rift Beast within.

Skills.Skill_sp38_17_Description: Your Spriggan can now cast '{'Ensnaring Roots'}', a wave of roots deals physical damage and roots enemies it hits for 1.5 seconds. Rooted enemies take physical damage over time until they are freed.

Squirrels grant half as much increased attack and cast speed as Wolves.
If multiple players are providing Spriggans with these effects, only the strongest of each effect will apply.

Your spriggan''s '{'Healing Aura'}' is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.
Skills.Skill_sp38_31_Description:
Your Spriggan''s '{'Healing Aura'}' grants additional effects based on your active companions.
With a '{'Bear'}', it grants a percentage of max health gained as endurance threshold.
With a '{'Sabertooth'}',  it grants increased dodge rating.
With a '{'Scorpion'}', it grants increased area of effect.
Skills.Skill_sp38_31_0_Stat: Maximum Health Gained As Endurance Threshold with Bear
Skills.Skill_sp38_31_AltText: Your spriggan''s '{'Healing Aura'}' is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.
Skills.Skill_va53st_0_LoreText: All shall fall before swirling path of war

Skills.Skill_va53st_25_1_Stat: Global Base Critical Chance With Sword

Skills.Skill_va53st_8_Description: While spinning, you gain mana every three seconds while wielding a two handed weapon.

Skills.Skill_lu25ng_24_Description: Lunge''s final hit has a chance to cast '{'Smite'}' at up to 3 nearby targets based on distance traveled up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_24_AltText: If there are 3 available targets and this effect triggers it will always cast smite at all 3 targets. The cast chance is not rolled individually.
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_27_Description: Killing an enemy with Lunge grants you '{'Frenzy'}' for a short duration.
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_28_Description:
Lunge''s base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict '{'Time Rot'}'.

Swaps Lunge''s '{'Physical'}' tag for a '{'Void'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_29_Description: Killing an enemy with Lunge resets the cooldowns of '{'Void Cleave'}', '{'Erasing Strike'}', '{'Forge Strike'}' and '{'Judgement'}'
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_30_Description: Lunge''s final hit now deals damage in an extended rectangle instead of a circle when using a spear.
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_31_Description:
Lunge''s final hit now causes you to use '{'Javelin'}' when using a spear.

This consumes Javelin''s mana cost.
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_32_Description:
You reduce a portion of Lunge''s remaining cooldown when you use a different melee attack and hit at least one enemy. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times per use of Lunge.
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_33_Description: Lunge deals more melee damage to enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_33_AltText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_34_Description: You grant other nearby allies '{'Haste'}' at the end of the charge for a short duration based on distance traveled, up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_34_AltText: This does not grant you Haste, but does affect your minions.
Skills.Skill_lu25ng_35_Description: '{'Warrior''s Renewal'}' recovers an additional amount of Lunge''s cooldown and also grants you health when it triggers.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_2_Description: Flame Reave has increased attack speed and costs less mana, but travels more slowly, reducing its range.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_3_Description: Using Flame Reave grants 4 stacks of '{'Rhythm of Fire'}'. If you already have 12 stacks, Flame Reave instead consumes all the stacks to gain significantly more width, range, and damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_3_AltText:
If you have the '{'Worldfire'}' node the damage and range increases apply as normal, but the width increase has no effect.

The use of Flame Reave that consumes the stacks does not generate any stacks itself. This results in stacks being consumed every 4 uses of Flame Reave by default.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_4_Description:
Directly using Surge, Fireball, Mana Strike, or Firebrand also grants stacks of '{'Rhythm of Fire'}'.

These skills cannot consume stacks of '{'Rhythm of Fire'}' and you cannot exceed the number of stacks required for Flame Reave to consume stacks, which is 12 by default.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_5_Description:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to apply '{'Spreading Flames'}'.

Flame Reave deals more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_6_Description:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to grant you '{'Frenzy'}' for 3 seconds.

In addition to Frenzy''s base effect it now grants Flame Reave additional melee fire damage.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_6_1_Stat: Flame Reave Fire Damage during Frenzy
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_7_Description: Flame Reave hits deal additional melee fire damage per equipped sword.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_9_Description: Flame Reave deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers)
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_11_Description: When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast '{'Lightning Blast'}' at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Lightning Blast''s mana cost.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_11_0_Stat: Lightning Blast on Kill or Rare or Boss Hit
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_12_Description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it deals added melee damage based on your added spell damage.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_12_AltText: All types of added spell damage, such as added spell fire damage and added spell void damage, count and will be added as the corresponding type of melee damage.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_13_Description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_16_Description: Flame Reave now has a cooldown, but it expands and returns a second time. This can hit the same enemy two additional times.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_16_AltText: The additional expanding and returning hits from '{'Reflash'}' always have the 50% less damage penalty.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_17_Description: Flame Reave can store an additional charge and has increased cooldown recovery rate, but it also has additional mana cost.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_19_Description: Each time Flame Reave returns, it pulls enemies to you and grants you '{'Haste'}' for a duration.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_20_Description: Flame Reave has additional critical strike chance, but deals damage in a narrower area.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_20_AltText: Does not make Flame Reave narrower if you have the '{'Worldfire'}' node.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_21_Description: When you attack with Flame Reave and critically strike at least one enemy you gain ward.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_22_Description: Flame Reave hits have a chance to ignite enemies.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_23_Description: Flame Reave hits deal more melee damage against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_24_Description: Flame Reave melee hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_25_Description: Flame Reave travels faster, increasing its range.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_25_AltText: Multiplicative with the reduced speed from the '{'Dancing Flames'}' node.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_26_Description: Flame Reave''s critical strikes deal more damage.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_27_Description: Flame Reave deals damage in a larger area.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_14_Description: When you directly cast Flame Reave and consume '{'Rhythm of Fire'}', you cast '{'Elemental Nova'}' with more area and damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect consumes a percentage of Elemental Nova''s mana cost.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_14_0_Stat: Rhythm of Fire Casts Elemental Nova
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_8_Description:
Half of Flame Reave''s base damage is converted to lightning, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to lightning damage but not with increases to fire damage.

Fire damage bonuses from this tree now also apply to Lightning.

Ignite chance from this tree now also grants an equal amount of shock chance.

Flame Reave gains a '{'Lightning'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_8_1_Stat: Fire Damage modifiers on tree also apply to Lightning Damage
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_8_2_Stat: Ignite Chance from tree also grants Shock Chance
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_10_Description: When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast '{'Fireball'}' at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Fireball''s mana cost.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_10_0_Stat: Fireball on Kill or Boss or Rare Hit
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_18_Description: Flame Reave returns to you. This can hit the same enemy again.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_18_AltText: Flame Reave''s baseline damage penalty from expansion still applies, meaning a returning hit always has 50% less damage.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_28_Description: Flame Reave hits enemies in an expanding circle centered on you, but has less range and costs significantly more mana.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_29_Description:
You have a chance to cast '{'Fire Aura'}' when you directly use Flame Reave. Flame Reave has additional chance to Ignite on hit per active Fire Aura.

These effects are tripled if Flame Reave has a cooldown.
Skills.Skill_fr11mv_30_Description:
Flame Reave requires fewer stacks of '{'Rhythm of Fire'}' to consume all stacks. This does not affect the bonuses from consuming stacks.

Additionally when Flame Reave consumes '{'Rhythm of Fire'}' stacks it gains additional critical strike chance.
Skills.Skill_bh2_0_LoreText: Those who have seen past the darkness have been driven to madness or death.
Skills.Skill_bh2_2_Description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Black Hole pulls enemies towards it slower.
Skills.Skill_bh2_3_Description: Black Hole has a chance to chill enemies within its area of effect each second.
Skills.Skill_bh2_5_Description: Black Hole’s damage over time penetrates enemy fire resistance.
Skills.Skill_bh2_6_Description: Black Hole has a chance to ignite enemies within its area of effect each second based on your uncapped fire resistance.
Skills.Skill_bh2_6_0_Stat: Ignite Chance Per Second Per 1% Uncapped Fire Res
Skills.Skill_bh2_6_AltText: This scales off of uncapped fire resistance, so gaining more fire resistance above the normal 75% cap will continue to increase its effect. For example at 100% fire resistance, one point in this node grants 200% chance to ignite per second.
Skills.Skill_bh2_7_Description: Black Hole deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bh2_8_Description: Black Hole grants you ward each second.
Skills.Skill_bh2_10_Description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bh2_11_Description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced cast speed.
Skills.Skill_bh2_14_Description: The explosions created by the '{'Collapse'}' and '{'Pulsar'}' nodes have an increased chance to freeze enemies.
Skills.Skill_bh2_15_Description: Black Hole has increased duration and a chance to blind enemies within its area of effect each second.
Skills.Skill_bh2_16_Description: Black Hole has a chance to create another Black Hole once it expires.
Skills.Skill_bh2_16_AltText: The second Black Hole cannot create another.
Skills.Skill_bh2_17_Description: Black Hole''s cooldown is reduced and it costs less mana, but pulls enemies towards it slower and pulls enemies within a lesser area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bh2_17_AltText: Modifiers to the pull area do not affect the damage area.
Skills.Skill_bh2_18_Description: Black Hole pulls enemies toward it faster and from within an increased area.
Skills.Skill_bh2_21_Description: Black Hole moves faster toward the nearest enemy.
Skills.Skill_bh2_22_Description: Black Hole’s center hits enemies, dealing spell physical damage.
Skills.Skill_bh2_23_Description: Black Hole deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it prioritises moving towards rare enemies and bosses.
Skills.Skill_bh2_25_Description: Black Hole lasts longer, but has a longer cooldown.
Skills.Skill_bh2_26_Description: A second Black Hole is created 10 meters away in a random direction from the first Black Hole.
Skills.Skill_bh2_27_Description: Black Hole deals more damage to enemies within 1 meter of its center.
Skills.Skill_bh2_27_AltText: This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers and does not affect ailments applied by Black Hole.
Skills.Skill_bh2_28_Description: Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only 1 Black Hole can be created at a time.
Skills.Skill_bh2_4_Description:
Black Hole’s base cold damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Black Hole lasts much longer, but no longer pulls enemies.
Skills.Skill_bh2_9_Description:
Black Hole becomes two stars which orbit each other. One deals fire damage and the other deals cold damage. 

Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bh2_12_Description: Black Hole will '{'Collapse'}' at the end of its duration, an explosion which deals cold hit damage and knocks enemies back.
Skills.Skill_bh2_13_Description: Black Hole will '{'Collapse'}' each second while it exists, but it deals less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bh2_20_Description: Black Hole moves toward the nearest enemy that is not within its damaging area.
Skills.Skill_bh2_29_Description: Black Hole casts '{'Meteor'}' every second, but consumes Meteor''s mana cost every second.
Skills.Skill_bh2_29_AltText: Will only cast Meteor while above 0 mana.
Skills.Skill_bh2_30_Description: You can store an additional charge of Black Hole.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_0_LoreText: The bones of many: divided in life, united in death.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_2_Description: Your Golem has increased attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_5_Description: Your Golem has a chance to ignite enemies, additional fire resistance, and deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_6_Description: Your Golem deals additional fire damage with spells and melee attacks.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_8_Description: Your Golem deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers), and '{'Pyre Golems'}'’ '{'Infernal Aura'}' deals damage in a larger area.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_9_Description: Your Golem causes all nearby minions to move faster, including themselves. This bonus is doubled for the Golems themselves.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_10_Description: Your Golem has a chance to grant you a stack of '{'Putrid Coating'}' when it is hit. Each stack lasts for 8 seconds and grants you a chance to poison enemies.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_10_1_Stat: Chance To Grant Putrid Coating When Hit
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_11_Description: Your Golem deals additional melee cold damage and it has a chance to chill attackers when hit.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_13_Description: Your Golem deals more damage and has more health and armor (each multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_14_Description: Your Golem deals more damage with melee attacks (multiplicative with other modifers), and has an increased chance to stun with melee attacks.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_15_Description: Your Golem is larger (multiplicative with other modifiers), has increased area of effect, and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_16_Description:
Your Golems have increased size and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have no other living golems when you summon them.

Your Golems have significantly higher armor for the first 15 seconds of their life when summoned near the corpse of another Golem.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_16_1_Stat: Size if no other living Golems
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_16_2_Stat: Damage if no other living Golems
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_17_Description: Your Golem grants additional armor to nearby minions, including itself.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_18_Description: Your Golem''s hits restore health to you and itself. This effect restores additional health per 2 Vitality.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_20_Description: Your Golem deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and has an increased chance to stun.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_21_Description: Your Golem has a higher chance to retaliate with '{'Bone Shatter'}' when hit and its Bone Shatter deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_23_Description: Your Golem has additional health regeneration based on your total amount of health regeneration.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_24_Description: Your '{'Skeletons'}' which die within 18 meters of your Bone Golem grant it more armor and melee damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_24_AltText: Each stack of this effect is multiplicative with other stacks.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_25_Description: If you only control one Golem, it has a much higher chance to retaliate with '{'Bone Shatter'}' when damaged by hits from allies.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_25_0_Stat: Triple Bone Shatter Chance From Ally Hits
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_25_AltText:
This effect only applies to hits that damage the Bone Golem.

The default chance (without taking this node) for an ally''s hit to cause a '{'Bone Shatter'}' is the same as the chance for hits from enemies.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_3_Description: You summon an additional Golem, but each Golem has reduced maximum health, is smaller, and deals less damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_3_AltText: This node''s modifiers to health and damage are multiplicative with other modifiers
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_4_Description: Your Golems deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). If Bone Golems have been replaced by another type of Golem, you now have an equal chance to summon a Bone Golem.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_4_1_Stat: Golem Summons Also Summon A Bone Golem
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_7_Description:
You now summon a '{'Pyre Golem'}' instead of a Bone Golem.

The base physical damage of Pyre Golems'' melee attacks is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion fire damage, but not increases to minion physical damage.

Pyre Golems also cast '{'Infernal Aura'}', a spell that deals a burst of fire damage on cast and fire damage over time afterwards. Infernal Aura also ignites nearby enemies every second.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_7_AltText: If you have multiple golem type nodes, you will summon a random golem.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_12_Description:
You now summon a '{'Deathchill Golem'}' instead of a Bone Golem. 

The base physical damage of Deathchill Golems'' melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not increases to minion physical damage. Death Chill Golems'' melee attacks gain a Freeze Rate equal to twice their base damage.

Deathchill Golem also casts Freezing Grasp, a spell that deals cold damage and has high freeze rate. Bosses cannot be frozen by this.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_12_AltText: If you have multiple golem type nodes, you will summon a random golem.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_19_Description:
You now summon a '{'Blood Golem'}' instead of a Bone Golem. 

Blood Golems can also cast '{'Sanguine Orb'}', a spell that deals physical damage to nearby enemies over 2 seconds.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_19_AltText: If you have multiple golem type nodes, you will summon a random golem.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_22_Description: Your Golem''s '{'Bone Shatter'}' has a chance to repeat from enemies hit by it. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_22_AltText: The repeat can hit the enemy it repeats from.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_26_Description: Your Golem''s '{'Freezing Grasp'}' spell now has additional spell damage and base freeze rate per point of Vitality.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_26_0_Stat: Freezing Grasp Freeze Rate per Vitality
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_28_Description: Your '{'Skeletons'}' and '{'Skeletal Mages'}' which die within 18 meters of your Bone Golem grant it more fire damage over time to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.
Skills.Skill_bg36nl_28_0_Stat: Infernal Aura Damage Per Skeleton or Skeletal Mage
Skills.Skill_sw31a_2_Description: Snap Freeze has increased cast speed.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_3_Description: Snap Freeze has a shorter cooldown, but Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has reduced duration.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_5_Description: Snap Freeze has a chance to chill enemies.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_6_Description: Chill caused by Snap Freeze has increased duration. If you have taken the '{'Snap Shock'}' node, this increases Shock duration instead.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_6_AltText: If you have taken the Snap Shock node then this increases shock duration instead.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_8_Description: Snap Freeze hits deal additional spell cold damage.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_10_Description: Improves Snap Freeze’s base critical strike chance.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_11_Description: Snap Freeze critical strikes deal more damage.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_12_Description: Snap Freeze hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of '{'Shock'}' on the target.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_13_Description: Snap Freeze costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_14_Description: Snap Freeze inflicts '{'Frostbite'}' on all enemies within its area of effect.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_15_Description: '{'Frostbite'}' inflicted by Snap Freeze has additional Cold Penetration.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_17_Description: Snap Freeze costs less mana, but has a narrower area of effect.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_18_Description: Snap Freeze’s area of effect extends further away from you.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_19_Description: Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has a longer duration, but has a narrower area of effect.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_20_Description: You have additional armor and cold resistance while Snap Freeze is on cooldown.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_21_Description: Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze last longer.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_22_Description: You steal cold resistance from enemies hit by Snap Freeze, causing you to gain cold resistance for 4 seconds and the enemies hit to lose it.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_22_AltText: This still works on enemies with 0% elemental resistance; it causes their elemental resistance to become negative causing them to take more damage.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_23_Description: You can store an additional charge of Snap Freeze, but Snap Freeze has a longer cooldown.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_7_Description: Snap Freeze hits and deals spell cold damage and can apply on-hit effects, but costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_7_AltText: This damage has an added damage scaling of 100%, and is increased by your increases to cold damage and spell damage.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_9_Description:
Snap Freeze no longer freezes and its base cold damage is converted to lightning damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Adds 4 lighting damage for each second of freeze duration. 

All chill chance is converted to shock chance, and all nodes which rely on targets being frozen or chilled now work on shocked enemies instead.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_9_2_Stat: Lightning Damage Per Second Of Freeze
Skills.Skill_sw31a_9_AltText: Shock reduces lightning resistance by 5%, increases chance to be stunned by 10%, lasts 4 seconds, and can stack up to 20 times. It has 60% reduced effect against bosses and players.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_16_Description: Snap Freeze leaves a patch of '{'Frozen Ground'}' for 5 seconds, which chills all enemies who walk on it. Frostbite inflicted by Snap Freeze last longer.
Skills.Skill_sw31a_24_Description: Snap Freeze also freezes yourself for 2 seconds. You cannot take damage while frozen this way.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_0_LoreText: The quick hunter catches the prey
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_2_Description: Your sabertooth has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and recovers a percentage of its maximum health when it leaps.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_3_Description: Your sabertooth has additional cold resistance and it has a chance to chill attackers that hit it. It also has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_5_Description: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with '{'Flurry Swipes'}'.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_6_Description: Your sabertooth has more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it gains additional dodge rating for each point of Dexterity you have.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_6_AltText: This scales with your dexterity, not the dexterity of your sabertooth.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_8_Description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its melee attacks have increased area.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_9_Description: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike chance.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_10_Description: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike multiplier.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_12_Description: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_14_Description: While your sabertooth is on low health it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage it deals as health.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_14_AltText: Low health is defined as below 35% of maximum health.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_15_Description: Your sabertooth deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_16_Description: Your sabertooth deals additional cold damage with spells and melee attacks.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_20_Description: Your sabertooth has additional Freeze Rate Multiplier and it has more Freeze Rate per stack of Chill on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers)
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_21_Description: Your sabertooth deals additional cold melee damage based on your dexterity.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_21_AltText: This includes abilities granted from this tree.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_4_Description: All physical damage dealt to your sabertooth is converted to cold damage. Consequently it is reduced by cold resistance, but not by physical resistance.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_7_Description: When your sabertooth directly uses a melee attack and hits at least one target it has a chance to use '{'Flurry Swipes'}'.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_13_Description: Your sabertooth gains Frenzy for 2 seconds after using '{'Flurry Swipes'}'.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_17_Description:
Your sabertooth becomes an '{'Ice Tiger'}', converting 100% of its base melee physical damage to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not with increases to physical damage. The ice tiger''s melee attacks have a freeze rate equal to twice their base damage.

All bleed chance is converted to frostbite chance for your ice tiger.

The ice tiger''s melee attacks'' '{'Physical'}' tags are swapped for '{'Cold'}' tags.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_18_Description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of chill on the target.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_19_Description: Your sabertooth has a a chance to inflict frostbite and chill on hit.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_22_Description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but your Sabertooth can no longer leap.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_23_Description:
Your sabertooth''s attacks which hit at least one enemy have a chance to trigger '{'Upheaval'}'. Upheaval cast in this way uses your sabertooth''s stats, but your Upheaval tree.

This chance is halved if Upheaval creates multiple fault lines.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_23_1_Stat: Halved Chance with Multiple Fault Lines
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_23_AltText: If Upheaval creates totems, those totems still count as created by you, using your minion stats.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_24_Description: When your sabertooth leaps, it uses '{'Upheaval'}' when it lands
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_25_Description: When your sabertooth leaps you gain '{'Haste'}' for a duration.
Skills.Skill_sa36oh_25_0_Stat: You gain Haste when your Sabertooth Leaps

Skills.Skill_fe8at_1_Description: Soul Feast has increased cast speed and costs less mana.
