Skills.Skill_ds34l_28_Description: When used on a minion, Death Seal also grants it more damage and critical strike chance (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_ds34l_31_Description:
You release '{'Hungering Souls'}' more frequently.

Additionally, whenever you cast Reap or Evade, you gain this effect for a percentage of Death Seal''s maximum duration. Death Seal must be on your action bar for this effect to occur.
Skills.Skill_ds34l_31_1_Stat: Percent Effect Duration on Reap or Evade
Skills.Skill_ds34l_31_AltText: For example, if you have 2 points invested in this node then using Reap or Evade will cause you to release Hungering Souls for an amount of time equal to 50% of Death Seal''s maximum duration.
Skills.Skill_ds34l_22_Description: Death Seal prevents health loss from effects that continously drain a percentage of your current health.
Skills.Skill_ds34l_22_AltText: This does not affect health drain effects from abilities like Reaper Form.
Skills.Skill_ds34l_6_Description: You release a Wave of Death each second while sealed and upon activation, in addition to when you release Death Seal, but your waves of death deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_ds34l_6_0_Stat: Death Wave Cast Every Second While Sealed
Skills.Skill_ds34l_11_Description: If your health is above 33% of your maximum when you activate Death Seal, it is reduced to 33% of your maximum health.
Skills.Skill_ds34l_18_Description:
Wave of Death''s base damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to physical resistance and physical resistance shred.
Skills.Skill_ds34l_18_2_Stat: Necrotic Resistance Shred Chance -> Physical Resistance Shred Chance
Skills.Skill_ds34l_27_Description: Death Seal now targets only minions.
Skills.Skill_ds34l_29_Description: Minions targeted by Death Seal are rooted in place for its duration. When Death Seal is released, the minion explodes in addition to releasing the wave of death at its location.
Skills.Skill_ds34l_30_Description: You now repeatedly cast '{'Hungering Souls'}' while you are sealed. Hungering Souls cast this way has a 70% chance to have only 1 projectile.
Skills.Skill_ds34l_32_Description:
The Wave of Death''s base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to cold resistance and cold resistance shred.
Skills.Skill_ds34l_32_2_Stat: Necrotic Resistance Shred -> Cold Resistance Shred
Skills.Skill_ds34l_32_AltText: This node has no effect if '{'Corporeal Cascade'}' is allocated.
Skills.Skill_bc53_0_Description: Apply a curse to enemies in an area that causes spell physical damage when hit.
Skills.Skill_bc53_1_Description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bc53_2_Description:
Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.
Skills.Skill_bc53_3_Description: Enemies afflicted with Bone Curse have a chance to explode on death, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but Bone Curse costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_bc53_6_Description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but falls off after a few hits.
Skills.Skill_bc53_9_Description: Bone Curse has a chance to reduce enemy armor.
Skills.Skill_bc53_10_Description: If you kill an enemy affected by Bone Curse you have a chance to gain '{'Bone Armor'}' for 4 seconds, which grants less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bc53_11_Description:
When '{'Marrow Thief'}' triggers you are also healed. 

The healing scales with healing effectiveness.
Skills.Skill_bc53_12_Description: Bone Curse has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.
Skills.Skill_bc53_14_Description: When you cast Bone Curse, it now also leaves behind '{'Cursed Ground'}' for a short duration. Enemies that walk into the Cursed Ground are afflicted with Bone Curse.
Skills.Skill_bc53_15_Description: Bone Curse affects a larger area.
Skills.Skill_bc53_17_Description: Bone Curse has a significantly shorter cooldown, but '{'Bone Prison'}' now has gaps.
Skills.Skill_bc53_18_Description: Your '{'Bone Prison'}' takes less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_bc53_22_Description:
Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now only affects a single target. Bone Curse and Mark for Death have unlimited duration.

This is not compatible with the '{'Signet of Agony'}' node.
Skills.Skill_bc53_23_Description: Bone Curse slows enemies within its area of effect
Skills.Skill_bc53_25_Description: Bone Curse costs less mana and has increased cast speed.
Skills.Skill_bc53_26_Description: Bone Curse has a chance to apply chill when the enemy is hit.
Skills.Skill_bc53_27_Description: Adds a freeze rate to Bone Curse, granting it a chance to freeze enemies.
Skills.Skill_bc53_28_Description:
You may cast Bone Curse on your minions, which grants them more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but also applies Bone Curse''s negative effects. 

This effect lasts 4 seconds and does not stack.
Skills.Skill_bc53_29_Description:
Casting Bone Curse on minions causes them to reflect a flat amount damage to attackers. 

This effect lasts 4 seconds and does not stack.
Skills.Skill_bc53_30_Description: All minion buffs from Bone Curse have 200% increased effect on Bone Golems.
Skills.Skill_bc53_24_Description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but lingers for a shorter duration on enemies if not reapplied. The duration reduction only applies to Bone Curse applied by the aura.
Skills.Skill_bc53_24_AltText: Does not affect the duration of Bone Curse on minions.
Skills.Skill_bc53_4_Description: Killing an enemy with Bone Curse has a chance to summon a Skeleton Vanguard, a minion that deals melee physical damage using a spear. You are limited to 3 Skeleton Vanguards by default.
Skills.Skill_bc53_5_Description: Shortly after casting Bone Curse, it causes a '{'Bone Eruption'}' beneath the target area, causing enemies to take spell physical damage, but Bone Curse Costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_bc53_7_Description:
Bone Curse becomes a toggled aura which surrounds you, but it has reduced area and drains your mana over time. You are also inflicted with Bone Curse.

This is not compatible with the '{'Oppressive Gaze'}' and '{'Illusion of Pain'}' nodes.
Skills.Skill_bc53_7_AltText: Modifiers to Bone Curse''s mana efficiency affect its mana drain.
Skills.Skill_bc53_8_Description:
Bone Curse falls off after only 1 hit, but it always crits and deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Bone Curse now has a cooldown.

This is not compatible with the '{'Signet of Agony'}' node.
The duration of '{'Cursed Limbs'}' and '{'Cursed Ground'}' are significantly reduced.
Skills.Skill_bc53_8_4_Stat: Cursed Limbs and Cursed Ground duration
Skills.Skill_bc53_13_Description: When Bone Curse times out, you cast '{'Rip Blood'}' on that enemy, a spell dealing physical damage. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.
Skills.Skill_bc53_13_0_Stat: Rip Blood On Bone Curse Time Out
Skills.Skill_bc53_13_AltText: Rip Blood cast this way cannot apply Bone Curse, even if you have the '{'Cursed Limbs'}' node.
Skills.Skill_bc53_16_Description:
When you directly cast Bone Curse you summon a '{'Bone Prison'}' around the target area, trapping enemies inside. Bone Prison lasts a long time, but can be attacked and destroyed.

Bone Curse has a significantly longer cooldown.
Skills.Skill_bc53_19_Description:
Bone Curse applies '{'Mark for Death'}' for 2 seconds, but costs more mana.

This effect overwrites '{'Mark for Death''s'}' normal duration.
Skills.Skill_bc53_19_AltText: If you have '{'Signet of Agony'}', this mana cost is added to its mana drain.
Skills.Skill_bc53_21_Description: Bone Curse''s base physical damage is converted to necrotic. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.
Skills.Skill_bc53_31_Description:
After directly casting Bone Curse, you also cast Bone Curse on hit for the next few seconds, but Bone Curse costs more mana.
This cast on hit effect can''t occur more than once per second.
Skills.Skill_bc53_31_0_Stat: Bone Curse On Hit After Direct Cast
Skills.Skill_bc53_31_AltText: Bone Curse cast this way does not consume mana, but can not grant Cursed Limbs.
Skills.Skill_shiif_0_Description: Teleport a short fixed distance in the target direction.
Skills.Skill_shiif_2_Description: Shifting heals you. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.
Skills.Skill_shiif_3_Description: You travel farther with Shift, but it has a longer cooldown.
Skills.Skill_shiif_4_Description: You have additional dodge chance per point of Dexterity for 1 second after Shifting.
Skills.Skill_shiif_5_Description: Shifting heals you for a portion equal to your Dexterity. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.
Skills.Skill_shiif_7_Description: If a single hit deals at least 50% of your health, Shift''s cooldown is reset. This can only occur once every 10 seconds.
Skills.Skill_shiif_8_Description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting.
Skills.Skill_shiif_8_AltText: This damage modifier is additive with other damage modifiers on this tree, but multiplicative with other modifiers.
Skills.Skill_shiif_9_Description: You gain 50% increased movement speed for a brief moment after Shifting.
Skills.Skill_shiif_10_Description: You have a chance to cause bleeding with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting.
Skills.Skill_shiif_11_Description: After Shifting your next damaging non-channelled skill has increased bleed duration and bleed it inflicts has additional Physical Penetration.
Skills.Skill_shiif_15_Description: Shift restores mana on use. This amount is tripled when below half health.
Skills.Skill_shiif_17_Description: Shift consumes a health potion on use if you are below 50% health.
Skills.Skill_shiif_18_Description: The next damaging non-channelled skill you use after Shifting is always a critical strike.
Skills.Skill_shiif_18_0_Stat: Always Crit With Next Non-Channelled Skill
Skills.Skill_shiif_19_Description: If using a melee weapon, when Shifting you perform an '{'Unseen Strike'}', hitting enemies along your path.
Skills.Skill_shiif_19_AltText: Deals melee physical damage, with 100% added damage effectiveness.
Skills.Skill_shiif_20_Description: You throw '{'Shurikens'}' at nearby enemies after Shifting.
Skills.Skill_shiif_20_AltText: This will grant '{'Chakram'}' 10% more damage per point (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have the '{'Keen Throw'}' node.
Skills.Skill_shiif_21_Description: '{'Unseen Strike'}' hits in a wider area.
Skills.Skill_shiif_23_Description: When the '{'Shadow'}' created by Shift is consumed, you return to its location.
Skills.Skill_shiif_25_Description: You have a chance to drop an '{'Acid Flask'}' on arrival.
Skills.Skill_shiif_25_AltText: Acid Flask can not have extra projectiles when thrown from Shift.
Skills.Skill_shiif_26_Description: You have a chance to drop an '{'Acid Flask'}' on departure.
Skills.Skill_shiif_26_AltText: Acid Flask can not have extra projectiles when thrown from Shift.
Skills.Skill_shiif_27_Description: Shift has a shorter cooldown and costs less mana.
Skills.Skill_shiif_28_Description: '{'Unseen Strike'}' has a chance to inflict '{'Shadow Dagger'}' to enemies hit.
Skills.Skill_shiif_30_Description:
'{'Unseen Strike'}' instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.
Skills.Skill_shiif_32_Description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting, but travel a shorter distance with Shift.
Skills.Skill_shiif_32_AltText: This damage modifier is additive with other damage modifiers on this tree, but multiplicative with other modifiers.
Skills.Skill_shiif_12_Description:
Using Shift grants you '{'Jade Arrows.'}' 

Using a bow attack consumes a '{'Jade Arrow'}' to have increased critical strike chance and a chance to poison enemies.
Skills.Skill_shiif_12_1_Stat: Jade Arrow Increased Critical Strike Chance
Skills.Skill_shiif_13_Description: Consuming a '{'Jade Arrow'}' also causes your next bow attack''s critical strikes to deal more damage.
Skills.Skill_shiif_14_Description: Consuming a '{'Jade Arrow'}' also grants your next bow attack increased damage over time.
Skills.Skill_shiif_6_Description: Shifting cleanses all negative ailments on you.
Skills.Skill_shiif_22_Description: You leave behind a '{'Shadow'}' at the place you Shifted from.
Skills.Skill_shiif_24_Description: After using Shift you use '{'Shadow Cascade'}'.
Skills.Skill_aa710_0_Description: Hold ability key to channel to increase the area. When you release, combine all of your minions in the area into a single hulking abomination with states based on which minions are consumed.
Skills.Skill_aa710_2_Description:
For each '{'Skeleton Warrior'}' absorbed, your abomination deals more melee damage and has more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

For each '{'Skeleton Rogue'}' absorbed, your abomination has increased attack speed.

For each '{'Skeleton Archer'}' absorbed, your abomination has increased area of effect.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
Skills.Skill_aa710_2_0_Stat: Melee Damage and Health per Skeleton Warrior
Skills.Skill_aa710_2_AltText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.
Skills.Skill_aa710_3_Description:
Your abomination has additional critical strike chance.

For each '{'Skeleton Rogue'}' absorbed, your abomination has increased movement speed.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
Skills.Skill_aa710_3_AltText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.
Skills.Skill_aa710_5_Description: Your abomination has increased critical strike chance, but can no longer regenerate health or absorb '{'Bone Golems'}'.
Skills.Skill_aa710_5_AltText: The Abomination can still recover health by methods other than health regen.
Skills.Skill_aa710_7_Description: Your abomination''s melee hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but can no longer absorb '{'Skeletal Mages'}'.
Skills.Skill_aa710_11_Description: Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.
Skills.Skill_aa710_12_Description: Your abomination reflects a percentage of damage to attackers, and disassembles into a number of '{'Skeletal Vanguards'}' on death.
Skills.Skill_aa710_13_Description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_aa710_14_Description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced attack speed.
Skills.Skill_aa710_16_Description: Your abomination''s hits leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.
Skills.Skill_aa710_17_Description: Your abomination''s melee attacks deal damage in a larger area.
Skills.Skill_aa710_20_Description: Your abomination gains increased attack speed when it kills an enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 5 seconds.
Skills.Skill_aa710_21_Description: Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restores a larger percentage of its maximum health when devouring other minions.
Skills.Skill_aa710_21_1_Stat: Percent Max Health Restored on Devour
Skills.Skill_aa710_22_Description: Your abomination gains more max health (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 8 seconds each time it devours a minion, up to a limited number of times per 8 seconds.
Skills.Skill_aa710_22_AltText: Each stack of this effect falls off separately. Stacks are multiplicative with each other.
Skills.Skill_aa710_24_Description:
'{'Eternal Arrow'}' has a reduced cooldown.

For each '{'Skeleton Archer'}' absorbed, Eternal Arrow has additional Recurve chance.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
Skills.Skill_aa710_24_1_Stat: Eternal Arrow Recurve Chance per Absorbed Archer
Skills.Skill_aa710_24_AltText:
Modifiers which add to or subtract from a cooldown, such as this, are applied before increased cooldown recovery speed.

If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.
Skills.Skill_aa710_26_Description: Your abomination has more health and deals more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for each type of minion absorbed to create it among '{'Summoned Skeleton'}', '{'Skeletal Mage'}', '{'Wraith'}', and '{'Bone Golem'}'.
Skills.Skill_aa710_26_AltText: The maximum benefit of this effect is achieved if the abomination absorbs at least one minion from each of the four types.
Skills.Skill_aa710_28_Description: If the abomination was made by absorbing at least 1 of every type of minion mentioned by '{'Engorgement'}', it gains more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), increased attack speed, and increased and movement speed.
Skills.Skill_aa710_28_1_Stat: Attack Speed With All Types Absorbed
Skills.Skill_aa710_28_2_Stat: Movement Speed With All Types Absorbed
Skills.Skill_aa710_28_AltText: If a minion has a different name, it''s considered a different type of minion
Skills.Skill_aa710_30_Description:
'{'Devouring Souls'}' has a reduced cooldown.

Devouring Souls deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each '{'Skeletal Mage'}' absorbed.

Devouring Souls releases an additional soul for each Skeletal Mage absorbed.
Skills.Skill_aa710_30_1_Stat: Devouring Souls Damage per Absorbed Mage
Skills.Skill_aa710_31_Description: Your abomination has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with abilities that have cooldowns.
Skills.Skill_aa710_33_Description:
'{'Stomp'}' has a reduced cooldown.

For each '{'Bone Golem'}' absorbed,  Stomp deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect.
Skills.Skill_aa710_6_Description:
If a '{'Skeleton Warrior'}' or '{'Skeleton Rogue'}' is absorbed, your abomination is granted the ability to '{'Double Strike'}' with a 6 second cooldown, dealing significant melee damage.

Double Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Skeleton Warrior or Rogue consumed.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
Skills.Skill_aa710_6_0_Stat: Double Strike Gained on Warrior or Rogue Absorbed
Skills.Skill_aa710_6_1_Stat: Double Strike Damage per Warrior or Rogue Absorbed
Skills.Skill_aa710_6_AltText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.
Skills.Skill_aa710_29_Description: If a '{'Skeletal Mage'}' is absorbed, your abomination can cast '{'Devouring Souls'}', a spell that releases multiple necrotic projectiles.
Skills.Skill_aa710_29_0_Stat: Devouring Souls Gained On Mage Absorbed
Skills.Skill_aa710_15_Description: Your abomination has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities, but takes damage equal to a percentage of its maximum health each time it uses an ability with a cooldown.
Skills.Skill_aa710_18_Description:
If a '{'Wraith'}' is absorbed, its melee attack is replaced with '{'Soul Reave'}', which deals melee necrotic damage.

Soul Reave has 200% damage effectiveness compared to the basic melee attack''s 150%, and Soul Reave has 15% more radius compared to the basic melee attack.
Skills.Skill_aa710_18_0_Stat: Soul Reave Gained On Wraith Absorbed
Skills.Skill_aa710_19_Description: If a '{'Bone Golem'}' is absorbed, your abomination uses '{'Stomp'}', a melee attack that deals physical damage and has a high chance to stun enemies in a large area.
Skills.Skill_aa710_23_Description:
If a '{'Skeletal Archer'}' is absorbed, your abomination casts '{'Eternal Arrow'}' every 4 seconds, a bow ability that deals physical damage and has 100% chance to Recurve.

Your abomination gains additional bow damage per point of your Intelligence.
Skills.Skill_aa710_23_0_Stat: Eternal Arrow Gained On Skeletal Archer Absorbed
Skills.Skill_aa710_32_Description: If a '{'Volatile Zombie'}' is absorbed, your abomination gains an explosive '{'Tail Slam'}' ability.
Skills.Skill_aa710_32_0_Stat: Explosive Slam Attack Gained On Zombie Absorbed
Skills.Skill_aa710_9_Description:
Your abomination can no longer absorb '{'Summoned Skeletons'}'.

Minions within 12 meters of your abomination gain increased attack speed.
Skills.Skill_aa710_4_Description:
Your abomination casts '{'Aura of Rot'}', poisoning itself and nearby enemies every second.

For each '{'Skeleton Rogue'}' absorbed, your abomination gains additional chance to inflict poison on hit.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
Skills.Skill_aa710_4_AltText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.
Skills.Skill_aa710_25_Description: Your abomination will not devour '{'Volatile Zombies'}', even if they were absorbed to create it.
Skills.Skill_aa710_34_Description: When your abomination would devour a minion, it will instead be '{'Sacrificed'}', consuming a percentage of Sacrifice''s mana cost. This Sacrifice is cast by you and uses your Sacrifice tree.
Skills.Skill_aa710_34_AltText:
Minions that are Sacrificed will not grant the abomination any benefits that come from devouring.

If Sacrifice chains, it will not chain to the abomination.

If you do not have enough mana to consume, the minion will instead be devoured.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_0_Description: Target minion takes 3% max health per second for each second the shade has been active, but it and minions around it deal 25% more damage. Each minion only benefits from one Dread Shade aura. Expires after 20 seconds. Max 4 active shades.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_2_Description: Dread Shade costs less mana and has increased cast speed.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_3_Description: Dread Shade now grants minions armor based on your vitality, but Dread Shade decays your minions faster.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_4_Description: You can control one additional Dread Shade or Infernal Shade at once.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_6_Description: Dread Shade now grants frenzy to affected minions for a fixed duration after being cast.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_7_Description: Dread Shade now grants the targeted minion '{'Haste'}' while it persists, but it also applies a stack of ignite to the targeted minion each second.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_8_Description: Dread Shade drains your minions'' health more slowly and all affected minions deal additional necrotic damage with spells and attacks.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_10_Description: Dread Shade no longer decays your minions'' health, but instead inflicts a stack of '{'Everlasting Poison'}' each second.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_10_AltText: Everlasting Poison is the same as Poison, but does not expire.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_12_Description: The minion targeted by Dread Shade has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier, but also has additional chance to be critically hit.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_16_Description: Dread Shade grants affected minions increased attack and cast speed.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_17_Description: Minions affected by Dread Shade have a chance to inflict '{'Damned'}' to enemies they hit.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_19_Description: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_20_Description: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area and grants more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the targeted minion''s health decays more quickly.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_21_Description:
Dread Shade applies '{'Mark for Death'}' to nearby enemies and minions when it expires.

Mark for Death is a curse that reduces all resistances by 25%. It cannot stack.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_22_Description: When any of your minions targeted by Dread Shade dies, it casts '{'Sacrifice'}' on additional minions, with each cast consuming mana equal to Sacrifice''s mana cost.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_23_Description:
Dread Shade now attaches to enemies instead, still buffing your minions, but Dread Shade now has a duration, and this duration cannot be increased.

This does not buff or drain the health of enemies.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_24_Description: You are affected by the beneficial buffs of Dread Shade''s aura.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_24_AltText: For example you will not apply '{'Doom Brand'}' to yourself.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_25_Description: Dread Shade now drains the health of other minions, and marks them with '{'Doom Brand'}'. When they die, the brand explodes dealing necrotic spell damage to surrounding enemies.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_25_AltText: Doom brand''s explosion counts as your ability, not the minion''s.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_26_Description: '{'Doom Brand'}' deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_27_Description: Dread Shade grants increased effect of all its buffs for each 3% of missing health on the targeted minion.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_27_0_Stat: Increased Buff Effect Per 3% Missing Health
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_27_AltText: If Dread Shade is cast on an enemy, the increased buff effect will be dependent on that enemy''s missing health.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_29_Description: Dread Shade applies '{'Spirit Plague'}' to a nearby enemy whenever it expires.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_28_Description: Casting Dread Shade refreshes the duration of your '{'Infernal Shades.'}' Each Infernal Shade can only be refreshed a maximum number of times.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_28_0_Stat: Refresh Infernal Shade Duration On Cast
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_9_Description: Dread Shade has increased area of effect per active minion when cast, up to a maximum benefit.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_13_Description: Dread Shade now roots the targeted minion and causes it to taunt enemies around it.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_14_Description: Dread Shade grants the targeted minion significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Dread Shade no longer buffs other minions.
Skills.Skill_ds4d3_18_Description: Dread Shade now inflicts '{'Damned'}' each second to all enemies and friendly minions in its area.

Skills.Skill_wc57_21_Description: Fear inflicted by Warcry lasts longer and each stack of the '{'Berserk'}' buff from the Berserker node now also causes you to deal more damage to Feared enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Skills.Skill_wc57_24_Description: '{'Berserk'}' has increased duration and additional maximum stacks.

Skills.Skill_wc57_26_Description: '{'Berserk'}' now also grants you increased attack speed per stack of Berserk up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_wc57_26_AltText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.
Skills.Skill_wc57_30_Description: Warcry now hits enemies and deals spell physical damage.

While Warcry is on cooldown, your critical strikes have a chance to use Warcry for you.

Skills.Skill_wc57_5_Description:
Warcry now freezes enemies instead of stunning them, but it no longer knocks enemies back.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to '{'Frostbite'}' chance and effects related to bleed now depend on Frostbite instead.
Skills.Skill_wc57_5_AltText: Physical damage from '{'Kinetic Scream'}' is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.
Skills.Skill_wc57_14_Description:
You now cast '{'Maelstrom'}' when you use Warcry. 

Maelstrom cast this way costs less mana.
Skills.Skill_wc57_12_Description: You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Warcry.
Skills.Skill_wc57_22_Description:
You gain the '{'Berserk'}' buff for 1.5 seconds when you use Warcry, granting you additional melee damage.

While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.
Skills.Skill_wc57_22_2_Stat: Berserk Stacks On Hit While Berserk
Skills.Skill_wc57_22_AltText: With '{'Totemic Heart'}' you gain Berserk when you place the totem.
Skills.Skill_wc57_25_Description: '{'Berserk'}' now also affects your Raptor and Bear.
Skills.Skill_wc57_25_AltText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.
Skills.Skill_wc57_20_Description: Warcry now fears enemies for 2 seconds instead of stunning them.
Skills.Skill_wc57_20_AltText:
Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

This has no effect if you have '{'Jormun''s Wrath'}'.
Skills.Skill_wc57_33_Description: You now place down a totem for 3 seconds that repeatedly uses Warcry instead of you, but Warcry costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_wc57_33_AltText:
Warcry cannot taunt if used by a totem.

When used by a totem Warcry benefits from your minion and totem stats rather than your own stats.
Skills.Skill_wc57_28_Description: Warcry now pulls enemies instead of knocking them back.
Skills.Skill_wc57_28_AltText: Modifiers to knockback distance now affect pull distance.
Skills.Skill_wc57_29_Description: Warcry now also taunts affected enemies for a short duration.
Skills.Skill_wc57_29_AltText: This effect does not work if Warcry is used by a totem.
Skills.Skill_svz81_0_Description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which shambles towards an enemy and explodes.
Skills.Skill_svz81_1_Description: Zombies now leap towards their targets, up to a maximum distance.
Skills.Skill_svz81_2_Description: Zombies deal more damage and have more movement speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_svz81_3_Description: Zombies deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the Zombies'' health decays slower, but they also move slower.

Skills.Skill_svz81_9_Description: The explosion applies '{'Mark for Death'}' to enemies hit, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_svz81_9_0_Stat: Mark For Death On Explosion Hit
Skills.Skill_svz81_10_Description: You summon additional Zombies per cast, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana and has additional cooldown duration.

Skills.Skill_svz81_12_Description: The explosion has a chance to poison enemies.
Skills.Skill_svz81_14_Description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area.

Skills.Skill_svz81_24_Description:
Zombies instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

Skills.Skill_svz81_25_Description: The explosion now fears enemies for a short duration.

Skills.Skill_svz81_29_0_Stat: Dread Shade Chance for Direct Casts
Skills.Skill_svz81_29_1_Stat: Percent of Dread Shade Mana Cost Consumed
Skills.Skill_svz81_29_AltText: If you are at your maximum number of Dread Shades, this effect will not occur.
Skills.Skill_svz81_6_Description: '{'Vomit'}' has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.
Skills.Skill_svz81_11_Description: '{'Vomit'}' deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_svz81_16_Description: '{'Vomit'}' has a chance to poison enemies each second based on your maximum mana.
Skills.Skill_svz81_16_0_Stat: Poison Chance Per Second Per 2 Maximum Mana
Skills.Skill_svz81_31_Description: When a minion dies you have a chance to cast Volatile Zombie at its location, expending its mana cost.
Skills.Skill_svz81_31_0_Stat: Chance to Cast Volatile Zombie On Minion Death
Skills.Skill_svz81_31_AltText:
This cannot be triggered by Zombies or Corpse Parasites.

Skills.Skill_svz81_32_Description: '{'Necromantic Fervor'}' now grants ward rather than health. The amount of ward gained is not affected by increased healing effectiveness.

Skills.Skill_ssc50_0_Description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which shambles towards an enemy and explodes.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_1_Description: Storm Crows have increased cast speed, movement speed and more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_ssc50_2_Description: Storm Crows hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_3_Description: Storm Crows deal more damage per active crow (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_ssc50_4_Description: Storm Crows hits have a chance to shred enemy armor per point of strength, and armor shred they apply has increased effectiveness per point of strength.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_5_Description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to grant active Storm Crows more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_6_Description: Storm Crows have a chance to shock enemies and have additional lightning resistance.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_7_Description: '{'Crowstorm'}' deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_9_Description: '{'Crowstorm'}' deals damage in a larger area and has a chance to shock enemies it hits.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_10_Description:
Storm Crows'' base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Skills.Skill_ssc50_11_Description: Storm Crows have a higher chance to freeze enemies.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_12_Description: Storm Crows deal more spell damage per stack of shock on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.

Elemental damage increases and increases that don''t have a specific damage type also apply to the crows'' lightning damage.

This node has no effect on non-lightning damage, even if the crows'' damage type is converted.

Skills.Skill_ssc50_15_Description: Storm Crows deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased critical strike chance.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_16_Description: Storm Crows'' critical strikes deal more damage.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_17_Description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to improve active Storm Crows'' base critical strike chance for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_18_Description: Storm Crows'' basic lightning spell deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second they spent moving since their previous attack, up to a maximum duration.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_19_Description: You can now only have 1 Storm Crow, it deals more damage, has more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and is larger.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_20_Description: Storm Crows'' basic lightning spell deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now consumes your mana.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_20_AltText: This effect does not work if you are out of mana.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_21_Description: Storm Crow hits have a chance to grant you a stack of '{'Aspect of the Crow'}' for 8 seconds, granting you additional melee and spell lightning damage per stack.

Skills.Skill_ssc50_22_0_Stat: Aspect of the Crow On Other Companions

Storm Crows fly to your companions below half health to heal them. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

Skills.Skill_ssc50_24_Description:
'{'Goodberries'}' now also grants the companion ward. 

The amount of ward gained is increased by healing effectiveness.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_25_Description: Storm Crows are able to use '{'Goodberries'}' more frequently.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_26_Description: Storm Crows can now also fly to and heal you with '{'Goodberries'}'.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_26_AltText: This also takes the effect of the '{'Silverberries'}' node.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_27_Description:
Every 10 seconds Storm Crows cast '{'Wisdom of the Storm'}' on its nearest ally, granting it '{'Aspect of the Crow'}'. 

This effect has 50% reduced duration on minions.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_27_0_Stat: Wisdom of the Storm On Allies
Skills.Skill_ssc50_28_Description: You are granted additional Intelligence per active Storm Crow.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_29_Description: '{'Wisdom of the Storm'}' no longer has a cooldown, but can now only target totems.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_29_1_Stat: Wisdom of the Storm On Totems
Skills.Skill_ssc50_8_Description: Storm Crows have additional dodge chance and increased dodge chance.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_31_Description: '{'Crowstorm'}' deals more damage per contributing Crow (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_31_AltText: The damage bonus from Thunderous Blast is additive with Crowstorm''s baseline more damage per contributing Crow.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_30_Description:
When you directly cast '{'Crowstorm'}' you and your crows are teleported to the target location if it is accessible.

Crowstorm now counts as a '{'Traversal'}' skill.
Skills.Skill_ssc50_30_AltText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills'' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_2_Description:
Void Cleave hits ignite enemies and half of its base damage is converted to fire, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to fire damage but not with increases to void damage.

Ignite inflicted by Void Cleave gains additional fire penetration based on your increased void damage.

Void Cleave gains the '{'fire'}' tag.

Skills.Skill_v01cv_2_AltText: Generic increased damage is not taken into account for adding fire penetration for ignite. Neither is more void damage or increased melee void damage. Only increased void damage has any effect.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_3_Description:
All of Void Cleave''s base void damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Additionally your next non-channeled fire attack or spell after Void Cleave deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Void resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred and effects related to void resistance shred now depend on fire resistance shred instead.

Void Cleave loses the '{'void'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_3_1_Stat: Void Res -> Fire Res Shred Chance
Skills.Skill_v01cv_3_2_Stat: Damage On Next Fire Attack Or Spell
Skills.Skill_v01cv_4_Description: When you use Void Cleave and hit at least one enemy, your minions gain a stack of '{'Molten Infusion'}' for 4 seconds, granting them additional melee fire damage and a chance to ignite enemies.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_5_Description: Minions only gain a stack of '{'Molten Infusion'}' when you directly hit them with Void Cleave, but '{'Molten Infusion'}' has significantly increased effect.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_5_0_Stat: Molten Infusion Only On Minion Hit
Skills.Skill_v01cv_6_Description: You can travel farther with Void Cleave and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_v01cv_7_Description: After channelling '{'Warpath'}' for at least 2 seconds your next Void Cleave within 1 second deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_v01cv_8_Description: Void Cleave deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in an increased area.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_9_Description: Improves Void Cleave''s base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_10_Description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on high health.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_10_AltText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_11_Description: Void Cleave hits apply '{'Critical Vulnerability'}' and Void Cleave has increased critical strike chance.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_12_Description: Void Cleave critical strikes deal more damage and you gain mana with Void Cleave critical strikes.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_13_Description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next '{'Erasing Strike'}' is always a critical strike.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_14_Description:
Void Cleave deals additional melee void damage. 

This effect is tripled for echoed Void Cleaves.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_15_Description: Void Cleave deals significantly more melee void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on low health.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_15_0_Stat: Melee Void Damage To Low Health
Skills.Skill_v01cv_15_AltText: Targets below 35% max health are considered to be at low health.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_16_Description: Void Cleave hits slow enemies, have increased stun chance and increased stun duration.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_17_Description: Void Cleave has a shorter cooldown.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_18_Description: Void Cleave hits shred enemy void resistance.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_19_Description:
You cast '{'Abyssal Echoes'}' after using Void Cleave.

Abyssal Echoes cast this way uses its mana cost.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_20_Description: Void Cleave hits inflict enemies with '{'Time Rot'}'.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_21_Description: When you use Void Cleave you gain '{'Ravaging Aura'}' for a short duration scaling with the amount of enemies hit up to 10.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_22_Description: '{'Ravaging Aura'}' deals additional spell void damage and has an increased area of effect.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_23_Description: '{'Ravaging Aura'}' leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_24_Description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack inflicts enemies with '{'Time Rot'}'.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_24_0_Stat: Time Rot Stacks For Next Throwing
Skills.Skill_v01cv_25_Description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of '{'Time Rot'}' on the target.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_26_Description: Void Cleave hits shred enemy armor and '{'Armor Shred'}' applied by Void Cleave has increased effect and duration.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_27_Description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack deals additional void damage.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_28_Description: You can store an additional charge of Void Cleave, but Void Cleave costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_29_Description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_29_AltText: This effect is based on ignite rather than bleed if you have the [Riftflame] node.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_30_Description: Your increases to physical damage also apply to fire damage for Void Cleave.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_32_Description: You can travel much further with Void Cleave (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it has a longer cooldown and now counts as a '{'Traversal'}' skill.
Skills.Skill_v01cv_32_AltText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills'' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.
Skills.Skill_multis_2_Description: Armament stacks last longer and grant you additional melee physical damage per stack.
Skills.Skill_multis_3_Description: You have additional armor and block effectiveness per stack of Armament.
Skills.Skill_multis_4_Description: When you drop below 0 mana, you consume all stacks of Armament to restore mana per stack.
Skills.Skill_multis_5_Description: When you have 0 stacks of Armament you have an additional sword when using Multistrike, as if you had 1 stack.
Skills.Skill_multis_6_Description:
Each additional sword is replaced with '{'Smite'}'.

Smite cast this way costs its full mana cost per cast.
Skills.Skill_multis_7_Description:
You have a chance to retaliate with Multistrike swords on block. 

This effect has a 1 second cooldown and doesn''t include the initial strike.
Skills.Skill_multis_8_Description: Multistrike attacks repeated by your '{'Echoes'}' have additional swords.

This only affects the echoed Multistrike, not the original use.

Skills.Skill_multis_9_Description: The initial strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Skills.Skill_multis_23_Description:

This effect cannot be triggered from additional swords created this way.
Skills.Skill_multis_24_Description: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament.
Skills.Skill_multis_25_Description: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament, but Multistrike has less attack speed per stack (multipicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_multis_26_Description: While at maximum stacks of Armament and positive mana, attacking with Multistrike will consume all stacks and 40 mana to use '{'Forge Strike'}'.
Skills.Skill_multis_27_Description: Multistrike has an additional sword while you are at maximum stacks of Armament and wielding a two-handed weapon.

Skills.Skill_multis_28_Description: '{'Void Cleave'}' consumes all stacks of Armament to gain more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased area per stack consumed.
Skills.Skill_javeli_2_Description: Javelin hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow.
Skills.Skill_javeli_4_Description: Javelin hits deal more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies the farther away they are, up to a maximum of 15 meters.

Skills.Skill_javeli_9_Description:
Javelin''s base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Ignite and bleed chance from all sources is converted to '{'Electrify'}' for Javelin and effects related to bleed or ignite now depend on Electrify instead.

Physical resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred chance and effects related to Physical resistance shred now depend on lightning resistance shred instead.

Swaps Javelin''s '{'Physical'}' tag for a '{'Lightning'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_javeli_10_Description: Javelin has a chance to '{'Electrify'}' enemies on hit. Electrify applied by Javelin has additional Lightning Penetration.
Skills.Skill_javeli_11_Description: When Javelin hits an enemy it now splits into additional piercing lightning spears which aim towards enemies close to the target, but Javelin itself can no longer pierce and it costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_javeli_11_AltText: If there are no other enemies nearby the target, only 2 lightning spears will be created.
Skills.Skill_javeli_12_Description:
Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies on high health.
Skills.Skill_javeli_12_AltText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.
Skills.Skill_javeli_13_Description: Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to a maximum, for each enemy pierced.
Skills.Skill_javeli_14_Description: Improves Javelin''s base critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.
Skills.Skill_javeli_15_Description: Javelin hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.
Skills.Skill_javeli_17_Description: Directly using Javelin causes your next melee attack to costs less mana.
Skills.Skill_javeli_18_Description: Directly using Javelin and hitting an enemy causes your next '{'Judgement'}' or '{'Forge Strike'}' to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_javeli_19_Description: Javelin deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased attack speed.
Skills.Skill_javeli_20_Description: Javelin hits have a chance to ignite enemies.
Skills.Skill_javeli_21_Description: You now throw Javelin into the air causing 4 javelins to rain down at target location dealing damage in an area, but it costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_javeli_22_Description:
Now only 1 Javelin rains down at the target location, it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and persists for 4 seconds, but has a cooldown.

It has a '{'Battle Standard'}' attached granting you and other allies in its radius increased damage and added endurance threshold based on your attunement.
Skills.Skill_javeli_22_AltText:
You are limited to 1 standard.

If Javelin would echo, the echo instead throws down a Javelin similar to the '{'Siege Barrage'}' node, rather than another Battle Standard.
Skills.Skill_javeli_23_Description: The '{'Battle Standard'}' now heals allies around it each second. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.
Skills.Skill_javeli_24_Description: The '{'Battle Standard'}' now lasts longer, but is still limited to one standard.
Skills.Skill_javeli_25_Description: If an enemy walks over the '{'Battle Standard'}' it captures it and carries the flag until it expires.
Skills.Skill_javeli_25_AltText: This just means the '{'Battle Standard'}' aura moves with the enemy, not that they gain the buffs.
Skills.Skill_javeli_26_Description: The '{'Battle Standard'}' now casts '{'Smite'}' at targets nearby every 1.5 seconds.
Skills.Skill_javeli_27_Description: The '{'Battle Standard'}' casts '{'Smite'}' more frequently and Smite cast this way has improved base critical strike chance.
Skills.Skill_javeli_28_Description:
Javelin is now a combo ability, the first part throws down the '{'Battle Standard'}' and the second part causes you to '{'Dash'}' to the flag.

Javelin''s cooldown is now longer.
Skills.Skill_javeli_28_AltText: This effect works even if the '{'Battle Standard'}' has been picked up by an enemy.
Skills.Skill_javeli_29_Description: Additional Javelins rain down, but Javelin costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_javeli_33_Description: Javelin deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_javeli_6_Description: Javelin deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_javeli_31_Description: Javelin now leaves behind a '{'Holy Trail'}', that deals fire and lightning damage to enemies each second, heals you and your allies each second and lasts for 6 seconds, but Javelin now has a cooldown. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness
Skills.Skill_javeli_31_AltText: This has no effect if you have taken the '{'Siege Barrage'}' node.
Skills.Skill_javeli_32_Description: Javelin deals more fire and lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have a chance to ignite and electrify enemies with melee attacks while Javelin is on cooldown.
Skills.Skill_javeli_35_Description: '{'Holy Trail'}' gains additional spell damage based on your increased healing effectiveness.
Skills.Skill_javeli_35_0_Stat: Spell Damage per 5% Increased Healing Effectivenes
Skills.Skill_javeli_8_Description: Javelin hits have a chance to apply '{'Frailty'}' per point of Strength and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance per point of Dexterity.
Skills.Skill_javeli_8_1_Stat: Physical Res Shred Chance Per Dex
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_34_Description: You have increased attack and cast speed while in Swarmblade form.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_2_Description: Your Armblade Slash, Dive and '{'Locust'}' hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_3_Description:
When you create a '{'Locust Swarm'}' with Swarm Strike you consume all stacks of bleed from enemies hit by it, causing the '{'Swarm'}' to deal increased damage in a larger area per stack of bleed consumed.

The increased area scales up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_3_0_Stat: Locust Swarm Increased Damage Per Bleed
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_4_Description: Yours and your '{'Locusts'''}' hits have a chance to poison enemies.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_5_Description: You can control additional '{'Locusts'}' and your Hives contain additional '{'Locusts'}'.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_6_Description: Hives release '{'Locusts'}' more frequently and if you have an active '{'Locust Swarm'}' it also releases Locusts every second.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_6_1_Stat: Locusts per 3 seconds from Locust Swarm
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_6_AltText: A Locust Swarm does not lose damage or otherwise change as it releases locusts, but cannot release more Locusts than were originally gathered to create it.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_7_Description:
After using Summon Hive, Human Form is now replaced with '{'Cleanse Hives'}', which releases all '{'Locusts'}' from up to 2 Hives, replaces them with '{'Healing Totems'}' and transforms you to '{'Spriggan Form'}'.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_8_Description: When a '{'Hive'}' releases a '{'Locust'}' you regain health and '{'Rage'}'.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_9_Description: Your Armblade Slash can now hit your own Hives which causes them to release '{'Locusts'}'.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_10_Description:
The base damage of Swarm Strike, '{'Locust Swarm'}', and Dive is converted to cold, and '{'Locusts'''}' base melee damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. These attack all also gain a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to '{'Frostbite'}' chance while in Swarmblade Form.

Your '{'Locusts'''}' Poison chance from all sources is converted to '{'Frostbite'}' chance.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_11_Description: You and your '{'Locusts'}' have a higher chance of freezing enemies per point of Attunement.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_12_Description: Your Hives now cast '{'Thorns'}' as if they were '{'Thorn Totems'}', rather than releasing '{'Locusts'}'. They can cast thorns a limited number of times equal to the number of Locusts they would have released.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_12_AltText: If you have the '{'Release the Horde'}' node, hitting a Hive will release thorns.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_13_Description: You and your '{'Locusts'}' have a higher chance to dodge and additional armor while in Swarmblade Form.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_14_Description:
You cast '{'Maelstrom'}' a number of times when you Dive. 

This consumes a portion of Maelstrom''s mana cost as '{'Rage'}'.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_16_Description: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while in Swarmblade Form.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_17_Description: Your Swarm Strike, '{'Locust Swarm'}' and your '{'Locusts'''}' melee attacks all deal damage in a larger area.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_18_Description: Your '{'Locust Swarm'}' leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_20_Description: '{'Locust Swarm'}' has more duration and Swarm Strike hits deal more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_21_Description:
After using Swarm Strike, Human Form is now replaced with '{'Angered Swarm'}', which adds 4 seconds to the duration of your '{'Locust Swarm'}' and transforms you to '{'Werebear Form'}'.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_22_Description: A random active companion uses its active ability after you directly use Swarm Strike.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_22_0_Stat: Random Companion Ability After Swarm Strike
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_23_Description: Your '{'Locust Swarm'}' deals more damage per '{'Locust'}' consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers) and while the Locust Swarm is active you have additional chance to poison on hit per '{'Locust'}' consumed.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_23_1_Stat: Poison Chance Per Locust While Swarm Active
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_24_Description: You and your '{'Locusts'}' deal additional melee physical damage while in Swarmblade Form and your '{'Locust Swarm'}' deals additional melee physical damage per active '{'Locust'}' consumed when you use Swarm Strike.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_24_2_Stat: Swarm Melee Physical Damage Per Locust
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_25_Description: You and your '{'Locusts'}' have improved base critical strike chance while in Swarmblade Form.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_27_Description: You regain '{'Rage'}' when you or your '{'Locusts'}' critically hit.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_27_0_Stat: Rage Gain When You Or Locusts Crit
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_28_Description:
Your '{'Serpent Strike'}' tree now applies to Armblade Slashes, and it does not require a spear.

This effect does not include the base additional poison chance or increased poison duration from Serpent Strike.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_28_0_Stat: Serpent Strike Tree Affects Armblade Slashes
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_29_Description: You regain health and '{'Rage'}' when you or your '{'Locusts'}' kill an enemy or when you hit a rare enemy or boss.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_29_0_Stat: Health And Rage Gain On Kill
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_29_1_Stat: Health And Rage Gain On Boss or Rare Hit
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_30_Description:
You gain a stack of '{'Howling Cascade'}' when you use Armblade Slash and hit at least one enemy. Reaching 6 stacks consumes them to cast '{'Tornado'}'.

This consumes Tornado''s mana cost.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_30_0_Stat: Gain Howling Cascade Stacks On Hit With Slash
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_31_Description: Reduce the maximum stacks of '{'Howling Cascade'}' required to cast '{'Tornado'}', and tornadoes cast via Howling Cascade deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_31_0_Stat: Howling Cascade Stacks To Proc Tornado
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_32_Description: When you use Armblade Slashes you now summon a '{'Locust'}' instead of doing a melee attack.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_35_Description: '{'Locust Swarm'}' now scales with your minion damage rather than your damage.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_26_Description: You can only control half as many '{'Locusts'}', but they have significantly more health, deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_26_AltText: The maximum number of locusts is rounded up.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_36_Description: Swarm Strike and Dive deal more damage and you regain '{'Rage'}' on hit with both skills.
Skills.Skill_sbf4m_36_2_Stat: Rage On Hit With Swarm Strike And Dive
Skills.Skill_uph41_0_Description: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.
Skills.Skill_uph41_30_Description:
You now create an '{'Upheaval Totem'}' that attacks with Upheaval from it rather than yourself. You are limited to 1 of these totems. Upheaval now has a cooldown and costs significantly more mana.

Upheaval Totems last 8 seconds.
Skills.Skill_uph41_2_Description: When you directly use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of '{'Earth Shattering'}' up to a maximum, causing your next '{'Fury Leap'}' or '{'Earthquake'}' to consume all stacks to gain additional physical penetration and increased area per stack consumed.
Skills.Skill_uph41_2_1_Stat: Buff To Next Fury Leap Or Earthquake
Skills.Skill_uph41_2_AltText: This has no effect if Upheaval is used by a totem.
Skills.Skill_uph41_3_Description:
Upheaval now splits up into 3 fault lines in front of you, but Upheaval costs additional mana. Enemies can only be hit by 1 Fault Line at a time.

Upheaval Totems now have 50% less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_uph41_4_Description: Upheaval now travels in 5 fault lines in a star around you.
Skills.Skill_uph41_5_Description:
Upheaval''s base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Upheaval has a chance to freeze enemies on hit.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to '{'Frostbite'}' chance and slow chance from all sources is converted to chill chance.
Skills.Skill_uph41_6_Description: When Upheaval hits an enemy it has a chance to release a '{'Shockwave'}', a melee physical subskill. The Shockwave cannot hit enemies already hit by Upheaval and vice versa.
Skills.Skill_uph41_6_AltText: Enemies hit by a Shockwave can not create a Shockwave, even if hit by Upheaval.
Skills.Skill_uph41_7_Description: Upheaval costs less mana and has a chance to shred enemy armor.
Skills.Skill_uph41_8_Description: Improves Upheaval''s base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.
Skills.Skill_uph41_9_Description: Upheaval critical strikes deal more damage.
Skills.Skill_uph41_10_Description: Creating an Upheaval Totem consumes all active '{'Thorn Totems'}' to grant it more damage per totem consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers). You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval totem and you have an additional charge.
Skills.Skill_uph41_10_0_Stat: Upheaval Totem Damage Per Totem Consumed
Skills.Skill_uph41_11_Description: You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval Totem and you have an additional charge.
Skills.Skill_uph41_12_Description: Upheaval deals additional melee cold damage, and also deals more melee damage to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_uph41_13_Description: Upheaval has additional freeze rate and has additional chance to inflict Frostbite on hit.
Skills.Skill_uph41_14_Description: You cast '{'Shatter'}' on enemies you kill with Upheaval, a spell subskill dealing cold damage in an area.
Skills.Skill_uph41_15_Description: Upheaval now creates additional fault lines and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_uph41_16_Description:
Upheaval hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow them.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.
Skills.Skill_uph41_17_Description: Upheaval deals damage in a wider area.
Skills.Skill_uph41_17_AltText: This does not cause Upheaval to travel further.
Skills.Skill_uph41_18_Description: When you use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of '{'Earth Armor'}' for 6 seconds up to a maximum amount of stacks, granting you additional armor and endurance threshold per stack of Attunement.
Skills.Skill_uph41_18_3_Stat: Endurance Threshold Per Attunement Per Stack
Skills.Skill_uph41_18_AltText: This has no effect if Upheaval is used by a totem.
Skills.Skill_uph41_19_Description: While you have '{'Earth Armor'}', if you fall below 6 stacks of '{'Maelstrom'}' you consume all stacks of Earth Armor to cast Maelstrom once per stack consumed.
Skills.Skill_uph41_19_0_Stat: Consume Earth Armor Falling Below 6 Maelstroms
Skills.Skill_uph41_21_Description:
Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but no longer scales with modifiers to attack speed.

These effects are doubled when Upheaval is directly used.
Skills.Skill_uph41_22_Description:
Upheaval penetrates enemy physical and cold resistance.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.
Skills.Skill_uph41_23_Description: Upheaval has increased area while using a mace, additional bleed chance while using an axe and additional cold penetration while using a staff.
Skills.Skill_uph41_24_Description: Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to stun enemies.
Skills.Skill_uph41_25_Description: Upheaval deals more melee damage to enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on how close they are to you, up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_uph41_25_AltText:
This is fully effective within 2 meters and has no effect after 6 meters. 
This is based on your distance to the enemy, even with '{'Upheaval Totems'}'.
Skills.Skill_uph41_26_Description: Upheaval hits have a chance to apply '{'Frailty'}' to enemies and it penetrates enemy physical resistance, but travels a shorter distance.
Skills.Skill_uph41_26_AltText: The physical penetration is affected by conversions to Upheaval''s base damage.
Skills.Skill_uph41_27_Description: When Upheaval hits your totems it has a chance to release a '{'Shockwave'}' from the totem.
Skills.Skill_uph41_27_AltText: Totems hit by a Shockwave can create a Shockwave when hit by Upheaval.
Skills.Skill_uph41_28_Description: Upheaval hits grant your totems increased armor and more damage (each stack multiplicative with each other and other modifiers) for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 4 times.
Skills.Skill_uph41_29_Description: Upheaval and '{'Shockwave'}' hits from the '{'Sundering Strikes'}' node now '{'Shatter'}' totems, releasing shards of rock and debris dealing spell physical damage and heals you per point of Attunement.
Skills.Skill_uph41_29_AltText: Upheaval Totems cannot be shattered this way.
Skills.Skill_uph41_32_Description: Upheaval Totems last longer, and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_1_Description: You have a chance to gain '{'Dusk Shroud'}' when you use Umbral Blades and hit at least one enemy.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_2_Description: You now throw just one large Umbral Blade with each throw that deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased radius.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_2_AltText: For subskills that scale with area such as '{'Bladestorm'}' and '{'Blade Explosion'}' the effect of this node''s radius increase on the skills'' area is additive with sources of increased area.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_4_Description: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike chance.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_5_Description: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike multiplier for each blade being thrown or recalled by the attack.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_6_Description: Umbral Blades hits inflict a stack of '{'Shadow Dagger'}' on hit, while using a dagger.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_6_AltText: This is not affected by Umbral Blades'' reduction to ailment application chance.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_7_Description:
Umbral Blades deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of '{'Dusk Shroud'}' on you, up to 20. 

This effect is doubled while inside the area of '{'Smoke Bomb'}'.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_7_0_Stat: Damage per Dusk Shroud, up to 20
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_8_Description: Whenever one of your '{'Shadows'}' expire they now also leave behind an Umbral Blade.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_8_AltText: '{'Shadows'}' using Umbral Blades always throw a single Shadow Blade that deals 300% more damage.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_10_Description: Umbral Blades has increased attack speed and you gain ward on hit with recalled blades.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_10_1_Stat: Ward Gain On Hit On Recall
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_11_Description: Recalling the blades now sends each blade toward a different nearby enemy instead of to you, but recalled blades no longer pierce.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_11_AltText: If there are fewer enemies than blades, the remaining blades will go in random directions.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_12_Description: Recalled blades now have a chance to pierce enemies (pass through enemies it hits).
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_13_Description:
You can now only recall blades by using '{'Shift'}', rather than the combo itself.

You regain mana for each blade recalled.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_14_Description: Recalled blades deal more damage, but blades thrown out deal less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_15_Description: Recalled blade hits have a chance to slow enemies and a chance to cause them to bleed.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_15_AltText: These chances are not affected by Umbral Blades'' reduction to ailment application chance.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_16_Description: Recalled blade hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target and per bleed on the target, up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_16_0_Stat: Recalled Blades Hit Damage Per Slow
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_16_1_Stat: Recalled Blades Hit Damage Per Bleed
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_17_Description:
Umbral Blades hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

When your blades are recalled you have a chance to gain '{'Haste'}' for 1 second.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_17_AltText: This bleed chance is not affected by Umbral Blades'' reduction to ailment application chance.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_18_Description:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance for Umbral Blades and effects related to bleed now depend on poison instead. 

If you have the '{'Explosive Blades'}', the explosion hit poisons enemies, but deals 80% less damage and it no longer deals any fire damage.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_19_Description: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the second throw.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_20_Description: Every 2 seconds you throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the next throw.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_20_1_Stat: Extra Blades On Next Throw Every 2 Seconds
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_21_Description: Umbral Blades deals additional throwing physical damage.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_22_Description: You now throw a third time with Umbral Blades with 4 blades before recalling the blades.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_23_Description: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the third throw.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_24_Description:
Umbral Blades base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Swaps Umbral Blades'' '{'Physical'}' tag for a '{'Cold'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_25_Description: Umbral Blades hits have additional freeze rate and have a chance to chill enemies.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_25_AltText: This chill chance is not affected by Umbral Blades'' reduction to ailment application chance.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_26_Description: Umbral Blades now throw towards a fixed distance in front of you, and you have increased attack speed with Umbral Blades.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_27_Description:
Blades in the ground now arm after 0.5 seconds, but can no longer be recalled and Umbral Blades has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers). If enemies walk over them the blades will cause a '{'Shard Explosion'}', a subskill dealing physical damage in an area.

Blades expire and explode after 3 seconds if no enemies walk over them.
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_28_Description: The '{'Shard Explosion'}' deals damage in a larger area and deals more damage per second the blade has remained on the ground (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_28_0_Stat: More Explosion Area Per Second On Ground
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_28_1_Stat: Explosion Damage Per Second On Ground
Skills.Skill_ub5d9_30_Description: Recalled blades have a chance to create a '{'Shadow'}' at their position.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_1_Description: Runebolt has increased cast speed and it has a chance to grant you the '{'Haste'}' buff for a short duration.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_2_Description: Runebolt deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_3_Description:
The '{'Lightning Bolt''s'}' base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to '{'Chill'}' for Runebolt and effects related to shock now depend on chill instead.

Swaps the '{'Lightning Bolt''s'}' '{'Lightning'}' tag for a '{'Cold'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_4_Description:
The '{'Fire Bolt''s'}' base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to '{'Chill'}' for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on chill instead.

Swaps the '{'Fire Bolt''s'}' '{'Fire'}' tag for a '{'Cold'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_5_Description: Runebolt deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_6_Description:
The '{'Cold Bolt''s'}' base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from all sources is converted to '{'Shock'}' for Runebolt and effects related to chill now depend on shock instead.

Swaps the '{'Cold Bolt''s'}' '{'Cold'}' tag for a '{'Lightning'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_7_Description:
The '{'Fire Bolt''s'}' base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to '{'Shock'}' for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on shock instead.

Swaps the '{'Fire Bolt''s'}' '{'Fire'}' tag for a '{'Lightning'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_8_Description: Runebolt deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_9_Description:
The '{'Lightning Bolt''s'}' base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Runebolt and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps the '{'Lightning Bolt''s'}' '{'Lightning'}' tag for a '{'Fire'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_10_Description:
The '{'Cold Bolt''s'}' base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

'{'Frostbite'}' chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Runebolt and effects related to '{'Frostbite'}' now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps the '{'Cold Bolt''s'}' '{'Cold'}' tag for a '{'Fire'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_11_Description:
Runebolt now randomly selects the element with each cast rather than by combo order. 

Directly casting Rune Bolt now has a chance to double cast if the previous cast was a different type. The chance is based on the amount of '{'Glyph of Chaos'}' you have in your crafting inventory.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_11_0_Stat: Chance to Double Cast Per 5 Glyph of Chaos
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_12_Description: Runebolt has a chance to shoot additional projectiles in a volley in front of you.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_13_Description: Runebolt''s chance to shoot extra projectiles from the '{'Arcane Overcharge'}' node and the amount of projectiles are doubled while standing in a '{'Glyph of Dominion'}'.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_13_AltText: Chance above 100% to shoot additional projectiles doesn''t have any effect.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_14_Description: Runebolt now shoots in a cone and the projectiles seek out enemies.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_15_Description: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you health if it was a '{'Fire Bolt'}', ward if it was a '{'Lightning Bolt'}' and mana if it was a '{'Cold Bolt'}'.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_16_Description:
If your last three direct casts were all Runebolt, then any further cast of it becomes tri-elemental (fire, lightning and cold). Tri-elemental Runebolt deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and applies all the effects of the '{'Attuned Recovery'}' node.

Skills.Skill_fb8fe_17_Description: When Runebolt passes through a '{'Frost Wall'}' it is intensified dealing more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and gains increased projectile speed.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_18_Description: Runebolt hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_19_Description: Runebolt deals additional physical damage per point of strength of you or your nearby ally with the highest amount of strength.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_19_0_Stat: Physical Spell Damage per Strength from Nearby Ally
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_20_Description:
Directly casting Runebolt now creates a '{'Runestone'}' in front of you if you do not currently have one nearby instead of casting a Runebolt. If you have a nearby '{'Runestone'}', directly using Runebolt now casts two bolts from the '{'Runestone'}' towards the target.

Skills.Skill_fb8fe_20_0_Stat: Runestone On Cast Instead Of Runebolt
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_20_AltText: '{'Runestone'}' does not count as a minion.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_21_Description: Every second while channeling a skill, your nearest '{'Runestone'}' has a chance to cast Runebolt towards your target.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_22_Description: Runebolt now explodes when it reaches its target location or when hitting enemies or obstacles, dealing damage of the corresponding element in an area.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_23_Description: The explosion from '{'Devastator'}' deals damage in a larger area per uncapped resistance of the corresponding element.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_24_Description: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to grant you mana.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_25_Description: Casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you a stack of '{'Runeweave'}' up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_25_2_Stat: Mana Spent Gained As Ward per stack
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_26_Description: Each stack of '{'Runeweave'}' also grants you more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of armor shred on the target up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_26_0_Stat: Elemental Damage per stack of Armor Shred
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_26_1_Stat: Maximum Damage Boost per stack of Runeweave
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_27_Description: Each stack of '{'Runeweave'}' also grants your '{'Runic Invocation'}' additional critical strike chance.
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_27_0_Stat: Runic Invocation Crit Chance per stack
Skills.Skill_fb8fe_28_Description:
Runebolt gains additional effects for each unique '{'Rune'}' you have. Multiple '{'Runes'}' of the same type does not stack the effect.

'{'Rah Rune'}': Runebolt has a chance to ignite enemies.
'{'Gon Rune'}': Runebolt has a chance to shock enemies.
'{'Heo Rune'}': Runebolt has a chance to inflict '{'Frostbite'}' on enemies.

Skills.Skill_fb8fe_29_0_Stat: Reverses order of Rune Bolt Combo

Skills.Skill_fb8fe_30_AltText: This randomizes the element, number and order of '{'Runic Invocation'}'.

Skills.Skill_gy2dm_1_Description: The '{'Glyph'}' explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

Skills.Skill_gy2dm_8_Description: Glyph of Dominion now has a cooldown, which is refreshed whenever you directly cast '{'Runic Invocation'}'. It also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per rune from '{'Runic Invocation'}', without consuming them.
Skills.Skill_gy2dm_9_Description:
Glyph of Dominion now consumes the '{'Runes'}' from '{'Runic Invocation'}' on cast to gain additional effects per '{'Rune'}' you have.

Skills.Skill_gy2dm_10_Description: Glyph of Dominion has additional charges and all charges are refreshed whenever you directly cast '{'Runic Invocation'}'.
Skills.Skill_gy2dm_11_Description: You cast '{'Elemental Nova'}' in the middle of the '{'Glyph'}' if you stand inside it when the delay from '{'Doom Scribe'}' starts and you gain stacks of '{'Fire Aura'}'.
