Skills.Skill_aa989_28_AltText:
Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments and subskills from Aerial Assault.

This direct damage modifier does affect '{'Featherstorm'}'.
Skills.Skill_aa989_29_Description: The damage bonus from '{'Ambush'}' always applies against bosses and rare enemies, regardless of their health.
Skills.Skill_aa989_29_0_Stat: Damage bonus always applies to bosses and rares
Skills.Skill_aa989_30_Description: When the '{'Wing Burst'}' kills an enemy and you have 3 or fewer active '{'Shadows'}', it creates a '{'Shadow'}' at that enemy''s location.
Skills.Skill_aa989_30_0_Stat: Shadow Falcon on Feather Burst Kill
Skills.Skill_aa989_31_Description: A portion of your added, increased, and more throwing damage modifiers now apply to the '{'Wing Burst'}'.
Skills.Skill_aa989_32_Description: The '{'Wing Burst'}' now also includes a few '{'Umbral Blades'}' that your Falcon throws for you.
Skills.Skill_aa989_33_Description: The '{'Umbral Blades'''}' hits from the '{'Twilight Strike'}' node now shred enemy armor.
Skills.Skill_db992_2_Description: Dive Bomb has a shorter cooldown.
Skills.Skill_db992_3_Description: You reduce a portion of Dive Bomb''s remaining cooldown when you use a throwing or bow attack and hit at least one enemy.
Skills.Skill_db992_4_Description:
Before your Falcon dives it now uses '{'Featherfall'}' that causes razor-sharp feathers to strike a number of enemies in an area around the target location.

'{'Shadow Falcons'}' won''t use '{'Featherfall'}'.
Skills.Skill_db992_6_Description: Dive Bomb''s hits slows enemies and it deals damage in a larger area.
Skills.Skill_db992_7_Description: Dive Bomb''s hits apply '{'Critical Vulnerability'}' on enemies.
Skills.Skill_db992_8_Description:
Dive Bomb and '{'Featherfall'}' hits grant you a stack of '{'Talon Blades'}' for 18 seconds.

You have increased critical strike chance and critical multiplier per stack.

All stacks of '{'Talon Blades'}' are lost if you directly use Dive Bomb again.
Skills.Skill_db992_9_Description: You move faster while you have at least 5 stacks of '{'Talon Blades'}'.
Skills.Skill_db992_10_Description:
If Dive Bomb hits your '{'Explosive Traps'}' they instantly explode dealing more damage in a larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when you detonate an '{'Explosive Trap'}' this way you gain a stack of '{'Talon Blades'}'.
Skills.Skill_db992_10_0_Stat: Explosive Traps Detonate From Dive Bomb
Skills.Skill_db992_11_Description: Dive Bomb''s hits shred enemy physical resistance.
Skills.Skill_db992_12_Description: Dive Bomb''s hits grant you a stack of '{'Crimson Shroud'}' per enemy hit, up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_db992_13_Description:
Dive Bomb''s hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target up to a maximum.

Additionally, it causes all bleed stacks inflicted by you or your Falcon to be consumed to deal their remaining damage instantly.
Skills.Skill_db992_14_Description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has a shorter delay before the Falcon dives.
Skills.Skill_db992_15_Description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and stuns caused by it last longer, but it has a longer cooldown.
Skills.Skill_db992_18_Description:
Dive Bomb now creates a '{'Shadow Falcon'}' to strike the location of your own '{'Shadows'}' and it will prioritize your '{'Shadows'}' nearest the target location, but '{'Shadow Falcons'}' deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) than the real Falcon.

The number of '{'Shadow Falcons'}' cannot exceed the number of '{'Shadows'}' you currently have.
Skills.Skill_db992_18_AltText: Increases to your own '{'Shadow'}' damage also apply to your '{'Shadow Falcons'}'.
Skills.Skill_db992_19_Description: You have a chance to gain a stack of '{'Dusk Shroud'}' for each '{'Shadow Falcon'}' that hit at least one enemy.
Skills.Skill_db992_19_0_Stat: Dusk Shroud Chance From Shadow Falcons
Skills.Skill_db992_20_Description:
A '{'Shadow Falcon'}' takes your Falcon''s place, that uses Dive Bomb. Your Falcon is able to attack and use other abilities during this.
If you do not have an active Falcon, Dive Bomb will scale with your stats instead.
Skills.Skill_db992_21_Description: Your '{'Shadow Falcons'}' that land inside the area of your '{'Smoke Bomb'}' have a chance to take off again after a short delay before diving again at a nearby enemy to deal damage around them.
Skills.Skill_db992_21_0_Stat: Shadow Falcons Chance To Dive Again
Skills.Skill_db992_22_Description: Your '{'Shadow Falcons'}' deal more damage (multiplicative with other modfiers) per '{'Umbral Blade'}' you have on the ground, up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_db992_22_0_Stat: Shadow Falcon Damage Per Umbral Blade
Skills.Skill_db992_22_1_Stat: Max More Damage From Umbral Blades
Skills.Skill_db992_22_AltText: This effect does not include Umbral Blades in flight, but it does include Blade Storms and Umbral blade waiting to explode.
Skills.Skill_db992_23_Description:
If you are wielding a spear you also leap to the target location when you use Dive Bomb. This deals damage in the area around the target.

Dive Bomb gains the '{'Traversal'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_db992_24_Description: Dive Bomb''s hits cause enemies to bleed.
Skills.Skill_db992_25_Description: If you are dual wielding, a portion of the damage specific stats from both of your weapons apply to your Falcon''s Dive Bomb.
Skills.Skill_db992_26_Description: Dive Bomb deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10% of your increased stun chance.
Skills.Skill_db992_26_0_Stat: Ailment Damage Per 10% Increased Stun Chance
Skills.Skill_db992_27_Description: If Dive Bomb hits at least one boss or rare enemy you regain mana and recover a portion of your remaining traversal skills'' cooldown.
Skills.Skill_db992_27_0_Stat: Mana Gain On Boss Or Rare Hit
Skills.Skill_db992_28_Description:
If Dive Bomb hits one of your '{'Decoy'}', it detonates it, causing its explosion to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

The effects from the '{'Rapid Pursuit'}' node are also gained when Dive Bomb hits one of your '{'Decoys'}'.

Dive Bomb cannot explode more than one '{'Decoy'}' per use.
Skills.Skill_db992_29_Description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.
Skills.Skill_db992_30_Description:
If your Falcon lands inside the area of your '{'Smoke Bomb'}' the smoke area lasts longer.

This effect can occur once per Smoke Bomb.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_2_Description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits shred enemy fire resistance.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_3_Description:
Whenever you hit an enemy with any melee attack, you attach an Explosive Trap to that enemy.

This effect has a 1.5 second cooldown and attached traps explode after 1 second ignoring arming time or when the enemy it''s attached to dies. Enemies cannot have more than 1 trap attached.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_4_Description:
Attached traps deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If the enemy that the Explosive Trap is attached to hits you, it now attaches to you instead (but will still only damage enemies). Hitting an enemy then attaches it back to them without changing the delay before exploding.

Additionally, when it explodes, the trap deals 30% more damage for each time it has been passed.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_5_Description:
When an Explosive Trap detonates, all other Explosive Traps now also detonate in quick succession and fire '{'Detonating Arrows'}' at the original target trap''s location. The Detonating Arrows can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your '{'Detonating Arrow''s'}' mana cost.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_5_AltText: This effect only works while you have positive mana. Exceeding the limit only prevents Detonating Arrows, it does not prevent the chain detonations.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_6_Description: '{'Detonating Arrows'}' fired this way deal additional bow damage per 3 Dexterity.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_7_Description:
Explosive Trap''s base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap''s '{'Fire'}' tag for a '{'Lightning'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_8_Description: Explosive Trap''s hits have a chance to shock enemies and inflict them with a '{'Spark Charge'}'.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_9_Description:
When directly using Explosive Trap, an unconverted Explosive Trap and a trap corresponding to each conversion node you have taken are thrown at the same time. Traps thrown this way are thrown in a small area.

Additionally, Explosive Trap deals less damage in a smaller area (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and cost additional mana.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_10_Description:
Explosive Trap''s base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to cold resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap''s '{'Fire'}' tag for a '{'Cold'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_10_AltText: This effect conversion takes priority if you have converted Explosive Trap to lightning.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_11_Description:
Explosive Trap''s hits have a chance to chill enemies.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has additional freeze rate per Intelligence.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_12_Description:
When you directly throw Explosive Trap, its hits always freeze enemies, but it now has a cooldown.

Whenever you freeze an enemy with any skill, a portion of Explosive Trap''s remaining cooldown is recovered.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_12_AltText: If Explosive Trap already has a cooldown, the highest cooldown is used.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_13_Description: Explosive Trap is now triggered from farther away and deals damage in a larger area.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_14_Description:
Particularly fast enemies (with a movement speed above 6 meters per second) trigger Explosive Traps instantly, even if they haven''t armed.

Additionally, Explosive Trap''s hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to moving enemies.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_14_AltText: Base player movement speed is 5.28 meters per second.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_15_Description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for each second it has existed before detonating up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_16_Description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the arming time is not ignored, but it takes longer for it to arm before it can detonate.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_17_Description: When an Explosive Trap detonates, if it hit at least one enemy, it has a chance to grant you a stack of '{'Dusk Shroud'}'. This chance increases for each second it spends arming.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_17_0_Stat: Dusk Shroud chance gained per second
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_17_AltText: The chance has no benefit when above 100%.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_18_Description: Explosive Trap deals additional throwing damage per stack of '{'Dusk Shroud'}' you have.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_19_Description: Explosive Trap costs less mana and it has increased throwing attack speed.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_19_LoreText: Jelkhor taught a select few students how to build small intricate explosive contraptions.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_20_Description:
Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate, your '{'Falcon'}' gains physical and elemental penetration for a short duration.

This effect can trigger up to a maximum of 15 times within 3 seconds.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_21_Description: Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate, your '{'Falcon''s'}' skills recover a portion of their remaining cooldowns.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_23_Description: You can now have more active Explosive Traps.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_24_Description: When you directly use Explosive Trap you throw additional traps, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_25_Description: Explosive Trap costs less mana, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a smaller area.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_26_Description:
You now shoot arrows attached with Explosive Traps up into the air that then drop down around the target location.

Explosive Trap now scales with your bow damage instead of throwing damage and your bow attack speed instead of throwing attack speed.

This requires wielding a bow.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_27_Description:
Explosive Traps now instantly detonate when the arrows hit the ground via the '{'Blast Rain'}' node, ignoring the arming time.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has a higher chance to stun enemies.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_28_Description: Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates, it has a chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap at its location as long as there is an enemy within 6 meters, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_29_Description:
Explosive Trap has an additional chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap via the '{'Trap Sprinkler'}' node, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

Traps dropped this way cannot drop more additional traps.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_30_Description:
Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates, it now has a chance to create a '{'Ballista'}' for you.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of '{'Ballista''s'}' mana cost.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_31_Description:
Explosive Traps dropped by the '{'Trap Sprinkler'}' node are now flung at a nearby enemy within 12 meters instead of being dropped.

Explosive Traps dropped by the '{'Trap Sprinkler'}' node can now drop Explosive Traps when there''s an enemy within 12 meters even if there is not an enemy within 6 meters.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_32_Description:
When an Explosive Trap drops a trap by the '{'Trap Sprinkler'}' node, it also flings an '{'Acid Flask'}' for you towards the target location.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Acid Flask''s mana cost.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_22_Description:
Whenever you directly throw Explosive Trap, you now throw traps, up to your maximum number of traps, in a wide area around the target location.

Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per maximum traps, but it now has a cooldown and costs more mana per maximum trap.
Skills.Skill_ex4tp_22_AltText:
"Per maximum trap" bonuses do take your base 5 maximum traps into account, as well as ones added by nodes and items.

If Explosive Trap already has a cooldown, the highest cooldown is used.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_2_Description: Net''s hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_3_Description: Net snares enemies in a larger area.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_6_Description: Netted enemies and enemies slowed by the '{'Tanglewire'}' node cannot dodge and cannot avoid critical strikes.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_6_AltText: This overrides enemies'' chance to dodge or avoid crits.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_7_Description: Using Net grants you the '{'Huntress Advantage'}' buff for a short duration, granting you more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against slowed or immobilized enemies.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_8_Description: While you have '{'Huntress Advantage'}' you now also have global increased throwing attack speed.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_9_Description: Net causes enemies to take physical damage over time and causes them to bleed each second.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_10_Description:
Net''s base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred for Net.

Additionally, Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per global shock chance.

Swaps Net''s '{'Physical'}' tag for a '{'Lightning'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_11_Description: Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) scaling with your dodge chance.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_12_Description: Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and bleeds that it inflicts last longer.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_13_Description:
Net''s base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to poison chance for Net.

Net gains the '{'Poison'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_14_Description: You no longer flip back when using Net.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_15_Description:
Net now throws a trap that releases a net at a nearby enemy when it triggers.

You can have a maximum of 6 Net Traps active at once and they last up to 30 seconds.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_15_AltText: If you reach your maximum number of active traps, throwing additional traps will destroy the oldest traps without detonating them.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_16_Description:
Net Traps now also use '{'Puncture'}' for you when they are triggered. This will use the melee or bow version of Puncture depending on your equipped weapon.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of '{'Puncture''s'}' mana cost.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_16_AltText: If Puncture has no mana cost this effect would still cost 0 mana. 115% of 0 is still 0.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_17_Description: You now throw additional Net traps with each throw, but Net costs additional mana.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_18_Description: When using Net you drop '{'Caltrops'}' at your starting location after jumping.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_19_Description: '{'Caltrops'}' from all sources deal damage in a larger area.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_20_Description: Improves '{'Caltrops'''}' base critical strike chance from all sources per 10% global slow chance.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_20_0_Stat: Caltrops Crit Chance Per 10% Slow Chance
Skills.Skill_ne01t_21_Description:
If Net hits an enemy you now also throw '{'Caltrops'}' at your target location where the Net hits.

This effect can occur once per 2 seconds.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_22_Description: You jump further when using Net.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_23_Description: You now jump forwards when using Net instead of backwards and it is thrown behind you.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_24_Description: When directly using Net you now throw a '{'Smoke Bomb'}' after jumping.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_24_AltText: This effect only works if Smoke Bomb is off cooldown.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_25_Description: Net snares enemies for a longer duration.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_26_Description:
Net''s hits chill bosses and rare enemies while other enemies are stunned for a short duration. Additionally, you gain mana for each moving enemy hit.

This effect adds a 10 second cooldown.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_26_0_Stat: Chill Stacks On Bosses And Rares
Skills.Skill_ne01t_28_Description:
You now jump further when using Net and it has a reduced cooldown.

Net gains the '{'Traversal'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_29_Description: Netted enemies deal less physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_ne01t_30_Description: Your '{'Falcon'}' deals more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to netted enemies.
Skills.Skill_ne01t_31_Description: Net''s hits apply frailty to enemies.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_2_Description: Whenever you expend a '{'Storm Stack'}' you have a chance to cast '{'Storm Bolt'}' at an additional enemy.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_3_Description: Gathering Storm deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you expend '{'Storm Stacks'}' more frequently, but '{'Storm Bolts'}' target enemies within a smaller area.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_4_Name: In the Eye of the Storm
Skills.Skill_ga2st_4_Description: Whenever you expend a '{'Storm Stack'}' you have a chance to cast '{'Maelstrom'}'.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_6_Description: Whenever you expend a '{'Storm Stack'}' you have a chance to gain a stack instead of losing one.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_7_Description: Whenever you expend a '{'Storm Stack'}' you have a chance to gain '{'Haste'}'.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_8_Description:
Whenever you use a companion ability you expend '{'Storm Stacks'}' over the next 0.3 seconds.

Storm Bolts triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_ga2st_8_0_Stat: Expends Storm Stacks On Companion Use
Skills.Skill_ga2st_9_Description: Whenever you hit a boss or rare enemy with a '{'Storm Bolt'}' you have a chance to cast it again at the same enemy after 0.25 seconds.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_10_Description: While wielding a staff the melee attack of Gathering Storm is replaced by a direct ranged cast of '{'Storm Bolt'}', but Gathering Storm costs additional mana.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_10_AltText: Gathering Storm cast this way is affected by effects which apply to Gathering Storm and to Storm Bolt, but it is no longer a melee attack.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_11_Description: '{'Storm Bolts'}' target enemies from farther away.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_12_Description: If you have from 1 to 15 '{'Storm Stacks'}', your minions'' lightning skill hits have a chance to grant you a '{'Storm Stack'}'.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_12_AltText: If Gathering Storm is converted to physical or cold then this requires a physical or cold hit instead.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_13_Description: Gathering Storm penetrates enemy lightning resistance.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_13_AltText: If Gathering Storm is converted to physical or cold then this grants physical or cold penetration.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_14_Description: '{'Storm Bolts'}' now consume a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10 current mana, up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_14_AltText: The amount of mana consumed is also restricted by the max damage bonus, so having more than 1,000 current mana won''t consume more than 10 mana.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_15_Description: Whenever you expend a '{'Storm Stack'}' while dual wielding you now cast '{'Storm Bolts'}' at two enemies instead of one.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_15_0_Stat: Additional Storm Bolt While Dual Wielding
Skills.Skill_ga2st_16_Description: Gathering Storm has increased attack speed.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_17_Description: Whenever you directly use Gathering Storm you gain mana per active '{'Storm Stack'}' up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_17_0_Stat: Mana Gain Per Storm Stack On Use
Skills.Skill_ga2st_18_Description: You have increased global stun chance and additional freeze rate multiplier per active '{'Storm Stack'}' up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_18_0_Stat: Increased Stun Chance Per Storm Stack
Skills.Skill_ga2st_18_1_Stat: Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Storm Stack
Skills.Skill_ga2st_19_Description: Gathering Storm''s hits have a chance to consume mana to grant you additional '{'Storm Stacks'}'.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_19_AltText:
This has no effect if you have no current mana.

Mana consumption happens after the mana gain from the '{'Manafused Storm'}' node.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_20_Description: Gathering Storm''s melee attack deals damage in a larger area and you have a chance to gain an additional '{'Storm Stack'}' if you hit at least 3 enemies with the same melee attack.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_21_Description:
Whenever you use Gathering Storm''s and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of '{'Wings of Lightning'}'.

Each time one of your '{'Storm Crows'}' attack they consume a stack of Wings of Lightning causing their basic attack to chain 2 additional times.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_22_Description:
'{'Storm Bolts'''}' hits have chance to shock enemies.

Gathering Storm deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_22_AltText: If Gathering Storm is converted to cold or physical respectively this depends on frostbite or armor shred.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_23_Description:
Gathering Storm deals additional spell damage per 3 melee damage on your equipped axe or mace.

The added spell damage granted by this effect is significantly reduced when applied to a Storm Totem through its '{'Unmatched Storms'}'.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_24_Description:
Gathering Storm''s and '{'Storm Bolt''s'}' base lightning damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to armor shred chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm''s '{'Lightning'}' tag for a '{'Physical'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_25_Description: Gathering Storm deals additional melee damage per Strength while wielding a 2 handed weapon.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_26_Description:
Gathering Storm''s and '{'Storm Bolt''s'}' base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm''s '{'Lightning'}' tag for a '{'Cold'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_27_Description: Gathering Storm''s hits have a chance to chill enemies and a higher chance to freeze enemies.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_28_Description: Gathering Storm has a higher chance to freeze enemies per 2 Attunement and it also has additional cold penetration for frostbite per 2 Attunement.
Skills.Skill_ga2st_30_Description: Gathering Storm has improved base critical strike chance per stack of '{'Maelstrom'}' on you from any source.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_1_Description: Healing Hands now hits enemies within its area of effect, dealing spell fire damage. Added spell damage applies to it at 200% effectiveness.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_2_Description: Healing hands deals additional spell damage based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_2_0_Stat: Spell Damage per 20% increased Healing Effectiveness
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_3_Description:
Healing Hands '{'Immobilizes'}' void enemies for 1 second on hit and deals more damage to them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Healing Hands grants allies 10% less void damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds when cast on them. This buff does not stack.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_3_AltText:
You count as an ally so casting Healing Hands on yourself will grant you the buff.

Void Enemies include cultists, husks, pure voidforms, and voidfused enemies. They are encountered frequently in the Ruined Era.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_4_Description:
Healing Hands fears Undead Enemies for 2 to 3 seconds on hit and deals more damage to them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Healing Hands grants allies 10% less necrotic damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds when cast on them. This buff does not stack.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_4_AltText:
Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

You count as an ally so casting Healing Hands on yourself will grant you the buff.

Undead enemies include skeletons, wraiths, zombies, and most other enemies encountered in the Imperial Era.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_5_Description: Healing hands deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the combined levels of your specialised Buff skills.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_5_0_Stat: Damage per Level of Specialised Buff Skills
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_5_AltText: Only Skills with the Buff tag are counted.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_6_Description: Healing hands has a chance to '{'Electrify'}' on hit.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_7_Description: Healing Hands deals more lightning damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and when you hit an electrified enemy with Healing Hands it spreads all stacks of your stacks of electrify from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_8_Description:
Healing Hands is converted into a melee attack that hits in a wide arc in front of you. It now scales with melee damage instead of spell damage and effects on this tree that granted spell damage now grant melee damage instead.

Healing Hands still heals you, as well as allies within its area of affect.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_9_Description: Healing Hands has increased healing effectiveness. This bonus is doubled if there is a dead player within 30 meters.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_10_Description: Healing Hands has an increased area of effect and a lower mana cost.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_11_Description: Healing Hands has a lower mana cost.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_12_Description:
You cast '{'Divine Bolt'}' at nearby enemies when you directly cast healing hands and heal yourself or an ally.

Divine Bolt is affected by specific passives from the Paladin tree and if you take this node then Divine Bolt from all sources scales with nodes on this tree.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_13_Description:
Healing Hands also grants ward to allies based on your Attunement.

If the ally has an effect that causes them to gain ward per second based on their missing health, then it will not heal them, but will provide a percentage of its healing as ward.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_13_AltText: You count as your own ally and are affected by this node when you cast Healing Hands on yourself.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_14_Description:
If Healing Hands would not affect any allied players at the chosen target location, it is cast centered on you instead.

Healing Hands has increased healing effectiveness.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_14_0_Stat: Cast at self if not targeting ally
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_15_Description: Healing Hands also grants ward to allies based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_15_AltText: You count as your own ally and are affected by this node when you cast Healing Hands on yourself.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_16_Description: Healing Hands becomes a channeled ability, casting 4 times per second regardless of cast speed, and draining your mana.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_16_AltText:
If you have the '{'Seraph Blade'}' node, then the melee attacks occur in random directions while you channel.

If you have the '{'Rahyeh''s Chariot'}' node then this node has no effect.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_17_Description:
Healing Hands also grants ward per second for three seconds after being cast on an ally.

The ward per second is equal to a proportion of the ward granted up front by the other nodes on this tree and by items that cause you to grant ward with Healing Hands.

This effect cannot stack multiple times, casting again on the same ally just refreshes the duration.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_17_0_Stat: Upfront Ward gained as Ward per Second
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_17_AltText: You count as your own ally an are affected by this node when you cast Healing Hands on yourself.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_18_Description: Healing Hands restores additional health up front.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_19_Description: Healing Hands restores additional health over time. This lasts for three seconds just like Healing Hands'' inherent healing over time effect.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_20_Description:
When you directly use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to cast Healing Hands around the target. This consumes mana based on Healing Hands''s mana cost.

Healing Hands restores less up front health when cast indirectly.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_20_0_Stat: Healing Hands Chance on Melee Hit
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_20_2_Stat: Less Up Front Healing For Indirect Casts
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_21_Description: When you directly cast Smite, you have a chance to cast Healing Hands around the target location. This consumes 70% of its mana cost.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_21_0_Stat: Healing Hands Chance on Smite Cast
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_22_Description:
When you directly use Healing Hands you dash to the target location first. However, Healing Hands now has a cooldown and counts a '{'Traversal'}' skill.

This does not affect indirect casts of Healing Hands.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_22_AltText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills'' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_23_Description: A portion of Healing Hands'' remaining cooldown is recovered if you use it to heal an ally other than yourself. This effect can occur once per direct cast of Healing Hands.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_24_Description: When you cast Healing Hands, there is a chance it spawns a '{'Health Globe'}' at a random point inside the area of effect. When an ally walks over the globe, it is consumed, healing them for 70 health.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_26_Description: You are immune to damage while moving with Healing Hands.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_28_Description: Healing Hands takes longer to cast, but deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased healing effectiveness and a larger area of effect.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_28_AltText: The cast speed modifier is also multiplicative with other modifiers and affects attack speed instead if Healing Hands is converted to a melee attack.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_30_Description:
If you heal an allied player other than yourself that was below half prior to healing, Healing Hands restores them to full health and grants them ward equal to 80% of their max health.

This has no effect on you, nor on minions, nor players that have an effect that causes them to gain ward per second based on their missing health.
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_30_2_Stat: Health Gained as Ward when Healing to Full
Skills.Skill_hh7pa3_32_Description:
While channelling Healing Hands you also call down a beam from the sky that deals fire damage over time to enemies around the target area and heals allies within its area of effect.

Healing Hands costs additional mana per second while channelling.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_1_Description: You leech a portion of Heartseeker''s damage and it has an additional chance to '{'Recurve'}'.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_2_Description: Heartseeker has additional critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_3_Description: Heartseeker deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_4_Description: Heartseeker''s hits have a chance to apply frailty and shred enemy armor, but it no longer seeks new targets when the first target dies.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_5_Description: When Heartseeker''s target dies, you shoot '{'Puncture'}' at a nearby enemy for each '{'Recurve'}' it would have triggered after the target died.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_6_Description: Heartseeker has a chance on '{'Recurve'}' to grant you a '{'Dusk Shroud'}', up to a maximum every 2 seconds.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_7_Description: When you directly use Heartseeker and hit at least one enemy, it has a chance to consume one of your '{'Shadows'}' to use Heartseeker at the same target.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_8_Description:
After a Heartseeker arrow '{'Recurves'}' at least 3 times, it has a chance to leave a '{'Black Arrow'}' between you and the target enemy if the enemy is at least 6 meters away.

This effect can occur a limited number of times every 3 seconds.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_9_Description: Heartseeker''s hits cannot be dodged and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_htsk5_10_Description:
Heartseeker''s base physical damage is converted to cold and it now has a base freeze rate. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Heartseeker.

Swaps Heartseeker''s '{'Physical'}' tag for a '{'Cold'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_10_AltText: This has no effect if you have taken the fire conversion node.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_11_Description: Heartseeker''s hits have a higher chance to freeze and have a chance to chill enemies.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_12_Description: Heartseeker penetrate additional cold resistance scaling with your cold overcapped resistance.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_12_0_Stat: Cold Penetration Per 10% Overcapped Cold Res
Skills.Skill_htsk5_13_Description:
Heartseeker''s base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage. 

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Heartseeker''s '{'Physical'}' tag for a '{'Fire'}' tag.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_14_Description: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you a '{'Burning Dagger'}' on '{'Recurve'}' consuming mana.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_15_Description: Consecutive '{'Recurves'}' each grant a stack of '{'Dragonfang'}' for 10 seconds. Higher stacks can only be achieved by a higher amount of consecutive '{'Recurves'}', up to a maximum of 20.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_15_AltText: If Heartseeker '{'Recurves'}' twice, you will get two stacks. If the next Heartseeker '{'Recurves'}' three times, the first two stacks are refreshed and you will gain a third stack.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_16_Description:
Directly using Heartseeker and hitting at least one enemy grants you frenzy for a short duration. 

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_17_Description: When directly used, Heartseeker arrows have a chance to grant mana and health on hit.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_18_Description: Heartseeker has increased attack speed and costs less mana.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_19_Description: Heartseeker''s hits have a chance to poison enemies and poison it inflicts last longer.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_20_Description: Heartseeker''s hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and bleed it inflicts penetrate enemy physical resistance.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_21_Description: Heartseeker deals more ailment damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_22_Description: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you '{'Crimson Shroud'}' on '{'Recurve'}'.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_23_Description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to '{'Recurve'}'.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_24_Description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to '{'Recurve'}', and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_26_Description: Your Heartseeker restores a charge whenever you pick up a '{'Black Arrow'}'.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_27_Description: Heartseeker now has a minimum chance to '{'Recurve'}'.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_27_AltText: Its '{'Recurve'}' chance can''t be reduced below its minimum '{'Recurve'}' chance.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_28_Description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to '{'Recurve'}' scaling with Dexterity.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_29_Description: Whenever Heartseeker '{'Recurves'}', it extends the duration of your most recent '{'Hail of Arrows'}' by a small amount, up to 10 times per use of '{'Hail of Arrows'}'.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_29_0_Stat: Hail of Arrows Duration On Recurve
Skills.Skill_htsk5_30_Description: Heartseeker now twists around in a semi-cirle to '{'Recurve'}' and its hits have a chance to slow enemies.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_30_AltText: The twisting and turning effect is only a visual change.
Skills.Skill_htsk5_31_Description: Armor shred chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.
Skills.Skill_fl44_2_Description: Flay deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and has a chance to chill on hit.
Skills.Skill_fl44_3_Description: Every second melee attack with Flay which hits a boss or rare enemy has a chance to trigger a Blood Eruption.
Skills.Skill_fl44_3_0_Stat: Blood Eruption Chance Every Second Attack
Skills.Skill_fl44_4_Description: Flay deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), doubled against low life enemies.
Skills.Skill_fl44_4_AltText: Enemies which are below 35% of their maximum health are at low life.
Skills.Skill_fl44_5_Description: Enemies hit by Flay are inflicted with Marked for Death for a duration, and Flay hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
Skills.Skill_fl44_5_AltText: Marked for Death is a Curse that reduces all resistances by 25%. It cannot stack.
Skills.Skill_fl44_6_Description: While using a dagger, Flay has increased attack speed.
Skills.Skill_fl44_7_Description:
When you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to gain Haste for 2 seconds. This chance is tripled if Flay is a traversal skill.

Flay''s Spirit Step can move you from a further distance.
Skills.Skill_fl44_7_2_Stat: Haste Chance Tripled if Flay is Traversal
Skills.Skill_fl44_8_Description: When you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack, your active '{'Aura of Decay'}' is granted more ailment frequency (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased radius for 4 seconds.
Skills.Skill_fl44_8_0_Stat: Aura of Decay More Ailment Frequency
Skills.Skill_fl44_8_AltText: This effect stacks endlessly, but each stack falls off separately. Stacks are additive with each other.
Skills.Skill_fl44_9_Description:
Hitting a boss or rare enemy with Flay''s melee attack transfers your active Aura of Decay to them for up to 6 seconds.

While the aura is attached to an enemy, you can move away from it to avoid the self-inflicted ailments.
Skills.Skill_fl44_9_0_Stat: Aura of Decay Transferable to Boss or Rare Enemies
Skills.Skill_fl44_9_AltText: The aura will re-attach to you after the duration ends or the enemy dies. Subsequent Flay melee attacks can refresh the duration or transfer the effect to a different enemy.
Skills.Skill_fl44_10_Description: Flay has increased area of effect and additional spell damage. These effects are doubled if there is a bleeding enemy within 15 meters.
Skills.Skill_fl44_10_2_Stat: Doubled with a Bleeding Enemy Within Distance (meters)
Skills.Skill_fl44_11_Description: A percentage of the melee damage on your equipped axes or daggers is also applied as spell damage for the Blood Eruption.
Skills.Skill_fl44_11_0_Stat: Melee Damage On Axes Or Daggers As Spell Damage
Skills.Skill_fl44_11_AltText: For example with 2 points invested, if a weapon has 10 melee physical damage, Blood Eruption will receive 5 spell physical damage. This applies to all affixes and implicits which directly provide melee damage on your axes and daggers, but not any other sources of melee damage.
Skills.Skill_fl44_12_Description:
Flay and all skills triggered by its skill tree deal more spell damage per 100 maximum mana. 
Flay has additional mana cost.
Skills.Skill_fl44_12_AltText: This applies to Blood Eruption and all skills triggered by Flay''s skill tree, such as Chaos Bolts from '{'Chaos Rip'}'. It does not affect those skills if they were not triggered by Flay.
Skills.Skill_fl44_13_Description:
Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy with the melee attack has a chance per 1 maximum mana to release a '{'Chaos Bolt'}' towards an enemy.
This effect consumes 2 mana per Chaos Bolt released.
Skills.Skill_fl44_13_0_Stat: Chaos Bolt Chance per 1 Maximum Mana
Skills.Skill_fl44_13_AltText: For example if you have 250 maximum mana, you will release 2 Chaos Bolts with a 50% chance for a third.
Skills.Skill_fl44_14_Description: Flay has additional critical strike chance, and leeches a percentage of damage dealt as health.
Skills.Skill_fl44_15_Description:
Flay has additional critical strike multiplier.
Critically hitting at least one enemy with Flay''s melee attack has a chance to release Marrow Shards towards another nearby enemy within 6 meters.
Skills.Skill_fl44_15_AltText: The Marrow Shards will hit the initial enemy and then continue towards another nearby enemy. If they are not able to pierce, they will only hit the initial enemy.
Skills.Skill_fl44_16_Description: Flay inflicts '{'Exposed Flesh'}' on hit, a Curse which reduces cold resistance and armor, and increases the target''s chance to be frozen.
Skills.Skill_fl44_17_Description: Blood Eruption has increased area of effect and deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each of your curses that were on the enemy.
Skills.Skill_fl44_17_0_Stat: Blood Eruption Increased Area per Curse
Skills.Skill_fl44_17_1_Stat: Blood Eruption Hit Damage per Curse
Skills.Skill_fl44_18_Description: Blood Eruption consumes mana to release a Wandering Spirit. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 4 seconds.
Skills.Skill_fl44_18_AltText: This effect will attempt to trigger each time a Blood Eruption is created by any means.
Skills.Skill_fl44_19_Description: Blood Eruption spreads all bleeds on that enemy to a limited amount of other enemies within its range.
Skills.Skill_fl44_19_AltText: The ailment which is spread by this effect can be altered by Flay''s damage conversions.
Skills.Skill_fl44_20_Description: Flay has a chance to inflict bleed on hit, and bleeds inflicted by Flay have increased duration.
Skills.Skill_fl44_20_AltText: The ailment modified by this effect can be altered by Flay''s damage conversions.
Skills.Skill_fl44_21_Description:
Flay deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled or frozen enemies.

Flay has additional freeze rate per active skeleton or bone golem.
Skills.Skill_fl44_21_0_Stat: Hit Damage to Chilled or Frozen
Skills.Skill_fl44_21_1_Stat: Freeze Rate per Skeleton or Golem
Skills.Skill_fl44_21_AltText: The freeze rate modifier counts all skeletons from Summon Skeleton and Skeletal Vanguards, along with all types of Bone Golem.
Skills.Skill_fl44_22_Description: If you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy, but do not hit a boss or rare enemy, a spectral copy of Flay strikes a random nearby boss or rare enemy.
Skills.Skill_fl44_22_0_Stat: Spectral Flay on nearby Boss or Rare
Skills.Skill_fl44_23_Description:
Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to trigger a spectral copy of Flay against a nearby enemy if one would not be triggered otherwise.

Spectral copies of Flay have increased area of effect.
Skills.Skill_fl44_23_AltText: This effect has a chance to trigger any time '{'Prince of Pain'}' was not triggered. Unlike Prince of Pain, this effect can result in a boss or rare enemy being hit by both the original Flay cast and the spectral Flay.
Skills.Skill_fl44_24_Description: Directly using Flay consumes a percentage of your current health and ward. Flay gains additional melee damage per 30 health consumed and additional spell damage per 30 ward consumed by this effect, up to a limited amount of each.
Skills.Skill_fl44_24_0_Stat: Percent of Current Health and Ward Consumed
Skills.Skill_fl44_25_Description:
Flay deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy reduces the remaining cooldown of Reaper Form by a percentage. This can occur a limited number of times per use of Reaper Form or Reap.
Skills.Skill_fl44_25_2_Stat: Limit per Use of Reaper Form or Reap
Skills.Skill_fl44_26_Description:
Flay has a chance to inflict bleed on hit, and Flay deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Flay has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_fl44_27_Description: Flay is now a traversal skill with a cooldown. The Spirit Step can move you from a much further distance and no longer requires a target.
Skills.Skill_fl44_28_Description: The Spirit Step is removed, and Flay has increased attack speed.
Skills.Skill_fl44_29_Description:
Flay''s melee attack is removed. Flay becomes a spell that directly creates the Blood Eruption, and is now affected by cast speed instead of attack speed.

Any modifiers to Flay''s attack speed in its skill tree instead apply to cast speed.
Skills.Skill_fl44_29_2_Stat: Attack Speed on Tree -> Cast Speed
Skills.Skill_fl44_29_AltText: Additional Blood Eruptions can still be created by killing enemies with Flay.
Skills.Skill_fl44_30_Description:
Flay''s base damage is converted to cold and it now has a chance to freeze. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

This node has no effect if '{'Soul Ripper'}' is allocated.
Skills.Skill_fl44_31_Description:
Flay''s base damage is converted to necrotic. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to damned chance.
Skills.Skill_fl44_32_Description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

This node has no effect if '{'Soul Ripper'}' or '{'Frostblight'}' are allocated.
Skills.Skill_fl44_33_Description:
When you create a '{'Blood Eruption'}', you gain a stack of '{'Blood Revelry'}', up to 5. Direct uses of Harvest or Rip Blood can consume a stack of Blood Revelry to deal more damage and gain increased area of effect.

Blood Eruptions have a significantly reduced delay before erupting.
Skills.Skill_fl44_33_1_Stat: Harvest or Rip Blood Damage on Stack Consumed
Skills.Skill_fl44_33_2_Stat: Harvest or Rip Blood Area on Stack Consumed
Skills.Skill_fl44_33_AltText: Only one stack can be consumed at a time by each direct use of Harvest or Rip Blood.
Skills.Skill_fl44_34_Description:
Flay deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a lower mana cost.

Flay has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_sh4re_2_Description: Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_sh4re_3_Description: Shadow Rend deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_sh4re_4_Description: Shadows consumed by '{'Shadow Massacre'}' have a chance to manifest a new shadow afterwards, based on their distance from you. Maximum effect is reached for shadows that are at least 6 meters away.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_5_Description: Each shadow consumed by '{'Shadow Massacre'}' or '{'Hidden Strength'}' restores health based on your dexterity.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_6_Description: You have a chance to gain a stack of '{'Dusk Shroud'}' when you directly use Shadow Rend and hit at least one enemy with the shadow''s attack.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_7_Description: The manifested shadow chooses a random enemy to dash toward, ignoring your targeted direction. It can target enemies that are further away.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_8_Description: For every '{'Dusk Shroud'}' on you up to 20, the shadow''s attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants ward if it hits at least one enemy.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_9_Description: Shadow Rend has additional chance to inflict bleed on hit, doubled for the shadow''s attack.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_9_0_Stat: Bleed Chance, Doubled for Shadow Attack
Skills.Skill_sh4re_10_Description: Shadow Rend has additional critical strike chance.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_11_Description: Shadow Rend has additional chance to shock enemies on hit, and it has additional critical strike multiplier per shock on the enemy.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_12_Description: Shadow Rend has additional critical strike multiplier, and additional chance to blind enemies on hit.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_13_Description: The shadow''s attack has a chance to inflict Shadow Daggers on hit.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_13_0_Stat: Shadow Daggers Chance for Shadow Attack
Skills.Skill_sh4re_14_Description: Traversal skills consume all stacks of '{'Ghost Blades'}' over the course of their duration.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_14_0_Stat: All Ghost Blades Stacks Consumed on Traversal
Skills.Skill_sh4re_15_Description: Shadow Rend has a chance to inflict frailty and slow on hit.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_16_Description: Shadow Rend has additional physical penetration per unique negative ailment on the enemy, up to 5.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_16_0_Stat: Physical Penetration per Unique Negative Ailment
Skills.Skill_sh4re_16_AltText: This can be converted to lightning penetration by '{'Dusklight'}'.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_17_Description: Directly using Shadow Rend grants Frenzy for a duration, and Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have frenzy.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_18_Description: While you are inside your '{'Smoke Bomb'}', Shadow Rend has increased attack speed and a lower mana cost.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_19_Description: Shadow Rend has increased attack speed and a lower mana cost.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_20_Description:
Shadow Rend has increased melee area for the shadow''s attack.

The shadow''s attack has a chance to shred armor on hit, doubled with a bow.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_20_1_Stat: Armor Shred Chance for Shadow Attack, Doubled with Bow
Skills.Skill_sh4re_21_Description:
Directly using Shadow Rend consumes existing shadows to make them imitate Multishot or Shadow Cascade, depending on your equipped weapon type. Each Shadow Cascade or Multishot imitated consumes mana.

This node has no effect if '{'Hidden Strength'}' is allocated.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_21_0_Stat: Shadows Imitate Multishot with a Bow
Skills.Skill_sh4re_21_1_Stat: Shadows Imitate Shadow Cascade with a Melee Weapon
Skills.Skill_sh4re_22_Description: Shadow Rend no longer moves you. The manifested shadow dashes forward 5 meters in the targeted direction before attacking, and will choose a target within range upon arriving.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_23_Description:
Directly using Shadow Rend consumes all shadows. It restores mana if you consume at least 1 shadow.

For each shadow consumed after the first, it gains more damage and more melee area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Skills.Skill_sh4re_23_0_Stat: Mana Restored from First Shadow Consumed
Skills.Skill_sh4re_23_2_Stat: Melee Area from Subsequent Shadows Consumed
Skills.Skill_sh4re_23_AltText: For example with 1 point invested and 3 shadows consumed, you will restore 2 mana and Shadow Rend will gain 40% more damage and 20% more area.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_24_Description:
Shadow Rend is now a traversal skill. You dash up to 7 meters forward after manifesting the shadow.

Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a cooldown.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_25_Description: Shadow Rend''s base physical damage is converted to lightning damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_26_Description: Directly using Shadow Rend and hitting at least one enemy with the shadow''s attack grants stacks of '{'Ghost Blades'}', up to 9. Stacks of Ghost Blades are consumed 3 times per second while moving to throw a Ghost Blade at a nearby enemy.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_26_2_Stat: Ghost Blade Stacks Consumed per Second While Moving
Skills.Skill_sh4re_26_AltText: Ghost Blades ignore conversions from effects such as '{'Dusklight'}'.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_27_Description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance for Shadow Rend.

Shadow Rend deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per poison on the enemy, up to 30.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_27_1_Stat: Hit Damage per Poison, up to 30
Skills.Skill_sh4re_28_Description: Shadow Rend deals more bow damage to damaged enemies. When used with a bow, Shadow Rend moves you forwards instead of backwards.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_29_Description: Shadow Rend has an additional charge.
Skills.Skill_sh4re_30_Description:
You have a chance to throw '{'Shurikens'}' or '{'Umbral Blades'}' at a nearby enemy when you jump and when you land, consuming 70% of the skill''s mana cost each time.

The skill chosen is your most recently directly used skill among them, or else random.

Bladestorm''s base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold, but not increases to physical damage.

GameGuide.+SkillLevelAffixes_Paragraph_0: Body Armor, Helmets, Relics, Uniques and Sets can all have affixes which grant additional levels to certain skills. These affixes can exceed the normal 20 level limit of skills.
GameGuide.+SkillLevelAffixes_Paragraph_1: Any skill levels currently granted by items will be shown in blue above a skill''s XP bar inside its skill tree.
GameGuide.+SkillLevelAffixes_Paragraph_2:
Unequipping an item which grants levels to your skills will remove points from them, unless you have a number of unspent points greater than or equal to the levels lost.

Nodes which have lost points in this way will be highlighted in red when you next view that skill''s tree.
GameGuide.IdolAltars_Paragraph_1: Idol Altars are equippable items that have special <link="idols">idol</link> related modifiers, changing the shape of the Idol Grid. Idol Altars often include differently colored Refracted Slots that provide benefits to idols placed inside them. The effects depend on the modifiers of the Idol Altar.
GameGuide.IdolAltars_Paragraph_3: Idol Altars can be found by completing <link="omen windows">Omen Windows</link>.
GameGuide.ForgingPotential_Paragraph_0: Forging Potential is a property that all normal, magic, rare and exalted equipment items have, which is used at the forge to perform crafting actions. Once an item runs out of Forging Potential, it can no longer be crafted on but is still able to be used. Higher rarity items will generally drop with more Forging Potential.
GameGuide.ForgingPotential_Paragraph_2: Each time you use a shard or rune in the forge, the Forging Potential of the item affected is reduced by a random amount inside a range. The amount of Forging Potential used can be modified through the use of <link="runes and glyphs">Glyphs</link>. As long as you have any amount of Forging Potential remaining, you are able to craft on the item in the forge.
GameGuide.BossWard_Paragraph_0: Certain enemies have small notches at the bottom section of their health bar, indicating that they are benefitting from the Boss Ward system.
GameGuide.BossWard_Paragraph_2: When enough damage is dealt to these enemies and their health bar reaches a notch, it is consumed and the enemy is granted ward based on their maximum health. When a notch is consumed that grants the boss ward, they will also be stunned for a short duration.
GameGuide.BossWard_Paragraph_3: Unlike the <link="ward">player ward</link> which decays faster the more ward you have, the rate at which the Boss Ward decays speeds up over time.
GameGuide.BossWard_Paragraph_4: While only Bosses are able to benefit from the Boss Ward mechanic, not all Boss enemies have it.
GameGuide.EchoChains_Paragraph_0: Sometimes <link="echoes">Echoes</link> spawn linked to each other, creating an Echo Chain. When these Echo Chains occur, each echo contains mechanics and rewards similar to all other echoes in the chain. These linked echoes have a purple effect around them, a chain icon and an additional information in their tooltips.
GameGuide.EchoChains_Paragraph_2: For example, each echo in a chain could include an <link="omen windows">Omen Window</link>, leading up to a final echo where you must complete a Greater Omen Window, a more difficult and special version of the Omen Window. As a reward for completing this Greater Omen Window you have the opportunity to spend Timeglass Fragments for various different options, such as creating a new special echo chain.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_0: Curses are special Ailments with their own scaling tag, do not usually stack with themselves, and have different effects. Some of them do damage which can be increased, while others might just be a debuff on the target, and some having both properties. Some curses are also specific skills with their own <link="skill specialization">specializable skill trees</link>, such as Bone Curse and Spirit Plague.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_2: Spirit Plague is a specializable curse skill for Acolyte. It curses an enemy with an effect that deals 90 necrotic damage over time and spreads to another nearby enemy if it dies. Does not stack and lasts 3 seconds.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_4: Bone Curse is a specializable curse skill for Acolyte. It curses enemies with a debuff that causes them to take physical damage when they are hit. Damage dealt by Bone Curse is trippled if you inflicted the hit. Does not stack and lasts 8 seconds.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_6: Marked for Death is a curse that reduces all resistances by 25 and lasts 8 seconds. Does not stack.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_8: Decrepify is a curse that causes enemies to take 15% more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers), deals physical damage over time based on your flat missing health and lasts 10 seconds. Does not stack.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_10: Torment is a curse that deals 120 necrotic damage over time, reduces movement speed by 18% (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts 3 seconds. Does not stack.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_12: Acid Skin is a curse that deals 50 poison damage over time, adds a +25% chance to be critically hit and lasts 5 seconds. Does not stack.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_14: Penance is a curse which deals 20 fire damage to a target when hit and lasts 15 seconds. Penance also gains 5% more damage per 1% of Damage Reflected. Flat reflect does not increase the damage of Penance. Does not stack.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_16: Anguish is a curse that reduces the damage over time dealt by enemies by 15% (multiplicative with other modifiers). When you kill any enemy, enemies cursed by Anguish take 40 necrotic damage. Does not stack.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_18: Withering causes affected targets to take 10% increased Curse Damage Taken, and lasts 3 secnods. Can stack up to 10 times and has 60% less effect against players and bosses.
GameGuide.Curse_Paragraph_20: Exposed Flesh is a curse which reduces cold resistance by 15%, reduces armor by 15 per point of inflicter’s dexterity, and increases chance to be frozen by 30%.
GameGuide.CircleOfFortune_Paragraph_0: Circle of Fortune is an Item Faction that grants powerful benefits towards finding more and better items. You’ll be able to align with the Circle of Fortune for the first time during Chapter 9. Unlike the <link="merchant''s guild">Merchant''s Guild</link>, items found while aligned with Circle of Fortune will always be untradable (they can still be <link="item gifting">gifted</link>) and if found from Prophecies or through Rank rewards, will also be bound to Circle of Fortune, making it impossible to equip them if aligned with the Merchant’s Guild.
GameGuide.CircleOfFortune_Paragraph_3: When aligning with the Circle of Fortune for the first time, you’ll start at rank 1. As you gain Reputation from gaining experience or spending Favor with the Faction by either purchasing Prophecies at the Observatory or spending at the Faction’s representative, you’ll gain higher ranks which yields greater benefits from the Faction. For more details on the benefits from ranks gained while aligned with Circle of Fortune, you can open the Factions panel (bound to Y by default).
GameGuide.CircleOfFortune_Paragraph_5: The Observatory is a town area where players aligned with Circle of Fortune are able to seek out Prophecies from Telescopes for Favor. Prophecies cause certain items to drop when completing a specific event, like slaying the boss of a specific <link="dungeons">Dungeon</link>.
GameGuide.CircleOfFortune_Paragraph_6: The Observatory also contains a Faction representative that can be used to spend Favor by purchasing equippable items and Lenses. Lenses are items that can be used to customize the Prophecies to further target what items are rewarded and types of events Prophecies require to complete. Higher ranks within the Faction allow deeper customization of the Telescope with Lenses.
GameGuide.TheWoven_Paragraph_0: Members of The Woven faction are devoted to a mysterious being known as The Weaver. Not much of her is known, other than her goal to weave a new, perfect world.
GameGuide.TheWoven_Paragraph_2: The Faction can be joined by talking to Masque inside the Haven of Silk after the completion of a <link="terminology">Cemetery of the Erased</link>.  You can further improve your rank by earning and spending <link="terminology">Memory Amber</link>, which is most commonly found inside <link="terminology">Tombs</link> and Cemeteries of the Erased, or by slaying the Weaver''s creations.
GameGuide.TheWoven_Paragraph_4: Echoes containing a Tomb or a Cemetery will always have <link="terminology">Silken Cocoons</link>. These destructible objects are found inside and around the entrances to Tombs and Cemeteries. The cocoons can be smashed open to either release a Soul of the Erased, which will empower a nearby enemy, or instead release an enemy trapped inside.
GameGuide.TheWoven_Paragraph_6: Ranks within the Weaver Faction provide two things; Points to spend in the <link="weaver tree">Weaver Tree</link>, and the ability to purchase new <link="woven echoes">Woven Echoes</link> from Masque. Spending points in the Weaver Tree allows players to tailor their preferred rewards and content inside the <link="monolith introduction">Monolith of Fate</link>.
GameGuide.OmenWindows_Paragraph_1: Omens are reflections from the moment Orobyss fell into despair. They manifest as windows to these moments, and touching them will unleash waves of enemies reinforced by the Omen.
GameGuide.OmenWindows_Paragraph_3: Should you survive the onslaught of enemies, the previously shielded Omen becomes vulnerable and will attack you. Completing Omen Windows can yield different rewards such as <link="corrupted items">Runes of Corruption</link>, corrupted items, <link="idol altars">Idol Altars</link>, and Timeglass Fragments.
GameGuide.OmenWindows_Paragraph_5: Timeglass Fragments are small pieces of the window and are accepted as currency to purchase items from the Oracle, located in the <link="monolith introduction">Monolith of Fate</link>. Fragments can also be used to create <link="echo chains">Echo Chains</link> as a reward when completing a more difficult Greater Omen Window at the end of an Omen Echo Chain in the Monolith of Fate.
